text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You guys gonna take it down again?

text.Morgana: I guess that’s our only choice ...  But wait, this might be a good time ...  Okay, I’ve decided! I’m going to teach you two a special way to fight enemies!
Something like that! Let’s go!
First, knock down all the enemies! Everything starts with that crucial step!
All right! Now rush on in for an All-out Attack!

text.ACTION: All-out Attacks are better and more stylish than they’ve ever been, and in this game every character gets a unique pose for starting one that defeats all enemies. It’s awesome.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wh-What was that super-move thing you just did!?

text.Morgana: I told you, it’s called an All-out Attack. If you manage to knock all the enemies down, you might be able to use it to beat them all at once.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Yeah ...  That was over quick ...

text.Morgana: It’s a concentrated attack on defenseless enemies, after all. Now as I mentioned before, I want you to be the head of our command. You can decide when we use this.

text.ACTION: That last bit is important; if Maaku or everyone but Maaku are incapacitated for one reason or another, no All-out Attacking.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Kamoshida’s ...  Training Hall ...  of Love ... ? What kinda bullshit is this!?

text.ACTION: The slaves are repeatedly beaten with sticks by the guards.

text.Morgana: How many times do I have to tell you to keep your voice down!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: But this is beyond messed up! How do I open this ... ?
Huh!?
You’re tellin’ me you wanna stay in a place like this!?

text.Morgana: Wait a minute ...  Were you planning on taking these guys out of here?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We can’t just leave ‘em here!

text.Morgana: How stupid can you be ... ?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What!?

text.Morgana: These are only humans in Kamoshida’s cognition. They aren’t real humans that have entered from reality. They’re different from you two.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Cognition ... ?

text.Morgana: It means there’s no point in saving them! They’re different from the real ones in the real world. You could say that these are extremely similar-looking dolls.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The hell!? Why’s it gotta be so complicated!? So the school’s a castle, and the students are slaves ...  It’s so on point that it makes me laugh. This really is the inside of that asshole’s head ... !

text.Morgana: Still, this is horrible. It must mean he treats them as slaves in the real world too.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: In the real world too ... ? Wait, I know these guys ...  They’re members of the volleyball team—the one Kamoshida coaches for!

text.Morgana: They must be physically abused every day ...  There’s no way they’d be so beat up normally.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Don’t tell me ...  They’re going through similar shit in reality!?

text.Morgana: Most likely. I mean, this proves that Kamoshida thinks of them as slaves.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So it might be for real ...  I heard that Kamoshida’s usin’ physical punishment. They’re just rumors, but ...  If they’re true, wouldn’t this be somethin’ to report to the police ... ? I’ll use these guys as evidence.
We can use the navigation app, but the camera’s a no go!?

text.Morgana: A navigation app?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That’s what we used to come here. What about yours?

text.Joker: My camera app won’t open.

text.Morgana: Whatever you do is fine, but we’re gonna get caught if we stand around like this. We need to head back!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hang on a sec! There’s no other way ...  I’ll just memorize their faces before goin’ home!

text.ACTION: Students run on a treadmill towards a pot.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Not givin’ athletes water even for tough trainin’ is a common thing in the real world too ...  That sack of shit ... ! I’m gonna try and memorize all these guys’ faces before we go back ...  Mkay, I’m done. Let’s check and see if there’re any more!

text.ACTION: A cannon repeatedly fires explosive volleyballs at a student.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The hell ... ? This ain’t trainin’ at all ...  It’s just violence! This means he’s been doin’ something similar in reality too, right ... ? Damn that bastard ... !

text.ACTION: What, exactly, is similar to this? This is just insane.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I know, I know ...  Just gimme a sec. I’ll memorize ‘em quick.

text.Morgana: Hey, are you done yet!? We’re cutting it close here!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Don’t freak me out like that, you goddamn moron! Anyways, I got all of ‘em!

text.Morgana: Then let’s stop wasting time! We need to scram!

text.Shadow: Chances of intruder activity are extremely high! All personnel, increase security measures!

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: To think you’d make the same mistake again. You’re hopeless!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The school ain’t your castle! I’ve memorized their faces real good. You’re goin’ down!

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: It seems it’s true when they say "barking dogs seldom bite." How far the star runner of the track team has fallen.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The hell are you gettin’ at!?

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: I speak of the "Track Traitor" who acted in violence, ending his teammates’ dreams. Oh, I can only imagine the pain of the others who were dragged under with your ...  selfish act.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Ngh...

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: What a surprise. So you’re accompanying him without knowing anything at all? He betrayed his teammates and crushed their hopes, yet he still carries on as carefree as ever.
You’ve come along with this fool and are now going to end up dead. ...How unlucky of you. Go. Kill them all. Don’t sully my castle with garbage.

text.Morgana: Ryuji, move!

text.ACTION: And swiftly enough, so does Maaku.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: No ...

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: What a worthless piece of trash, getting emotional so quickly ...  How dare you raise your hand at me. Though it was only temporary, have you forgotten my kindness in supervising track practice?

It was nothing but an eyesore! The only one who needs to achieve results is me! That coach who got fired was hopeless too ...  Had he not opposed me with a sound argument, I would’ve settled it with only breaking his star’s leg.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...What?

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: Do you need me to deal with your other leg too? The school will call it self-defense anyway!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dammit ...  Am I gonna lose again ... ? Not only can I not run anymore ...  the track team is gone too ‘cause of this asshole ... !

text.Morgana: So that’s why ...

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: Once these two are dealt with, you’re next. Hahahaha ... !

text.Morgana: Ryuji!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...You’re right. Everything that was important to me was taken by him ...  I’ll never get ‘em back ... !

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: Stay there and watch. Look on as these hopeless scum die for nothing because they sided with trash like you.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: All you think about is using people ...  You’re the real scumbag, Kamoshida!

text.Captain Kidd: Since your name has been disgraced already, why not hoist the flag and wreak havoc ... ? The "other you" who exists within desires it thus...

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: Ugh ...  This one as well!?

text.ACTION: Kamoshida must be getting real sick of these fucking teenagers bleeding face blood all over his castle.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: This effin’ rocks! Now that I got this power, it’s time for payback ...  Yo, I’m ready...

text.ACTION: The guard transforms into another Shadow.
So, Ryuji’s joined our party now, and he brings with him maybe my favorite Persona design. Maybe. There’s some good ones.

Captain Kidd was a Scottish pirate (or maybe not, there’s apparently some debate about this). He is, notably, not fictional, but the legend that he left behind treasure after his death inspired works such as Treasure Island and motherfucking One Piece.

Ryuji fills an interesting niche we haven’t seen bef—He’s Kanji. He’s Kanji almost exactly, down to the Electricity/Physical affinity and shit SP pool. And he’s the good Kanji from Golden, not the bad one from vanilla. The only meaningful differences are that Kanji got the Elec buffs and Ryuji gets multitarget physical attacks, but that’s kinda it.

Part 7: 4/12-4/13: Pirates Are In This Year
	Part 7: 4/12-4/13: Pirates Are In This Year
We just got Ryuji. Time to fight.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Kamoshida’s cognition ain’t changin, right? Then I’ll act like the troublemaker I am!

text.ACTION: Ryuji uses Electric and Physical skills, as I said last update. He doesn’t actually know any physical strikes at the moment, though, leaving just plain ol’ Zio to knock down these enemies. We won’t be using Zio all that much because of Ryuji’s garbage SP pool, but it’s handy nonetheless.
This is not a very trying fight.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...How ‘bout that!?

text.Morgana: Whoa ...  So Ryuji had the potential too...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Even if you apologize now ...  I ain’t forgivin’ you!

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: I told you that this is my castle. It seems you still don’t understand...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What’s going on ... !?
Yeah, now that you mention it ...  But why is she even here!?

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: How many times must I tell you until you understand? This is MY castle—a place in which I can do whatever I want. Everyone wishes to be loved by me. ...That is, everyone besides slow-witted thieves like you.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Takamaki! Say somethin’!

text.Morgana: Calm down, Ryuji! It seems that girl isn’t the real one. She’s the same as those slaves—a being made from Kamoshida’s cognition of her!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dammit ... !

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: Clean them up this instant!

text.Morgana: We’re outnumbered ...  Let’s scram before we get surrounded!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We’re not gonna do anything and just run!?

text.Morgana: Thank god you’ve got a level head.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Ngh ...  Fine. We’ll expose what you really are, no matter what! You better be ready for us ... !

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: Hahaha! I was beginning to get bored of torturing the ones here! Come at me whenever you want, if you don’t care about your life! Haaaahahahaha!

text.Morgana: Ignore him. Let’s go!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: (pant) Anyways! I don’t remember changin’ into this!
Uhh ...  Should I be happy about that?  ... Then again, it ain’t as bad as yours.

text.Morgana: Quiet!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So what’s goin’ on? I’m completely lost, man ... !

text.Morgana: I told you before. When a Persona-user opposes a Palace’s ruler and becomes a threat to them, this happens. It’s to prevent you from being affected by distortions.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Is this ...  a skull?

text.Morgana: Your appearance reflects you inner self. It’s the rebel that slumbers within ...  ...Not that you’ll get it.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Nope...

text.Morgana: Then stop asking questions and accept what you see for what it is.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Easy for you to say. (gasp) Wait, we’re in deep shit!

text.Morgana: I said to be quiet!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We might’ve gotten away here, but we’re still screwed with Kamoshida at the real school...

text.Morgana: That’s quite sharp of you! ...For being an idiot. Relax. The Kamoshida in reality can’t possibly know about what happens here. A Shadow is the true self that is suppressed—a side of one’s personality they don’t want to see.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...So we’re OK?

text.Morgana: Did the Kamoshida in reality remember about the execution?
There you have it.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: All right! Now that we know that, all we gotta do is--

text.Morgana: Wait. I guided you as promised. It’s your turn to cooperate with me.
That’s why I was super nice about teaching you idiots everything.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Huh? Cooperate?

text.Morgana: Don’t you remember? I originally came here for an investigation. I need to erase the distortion from my body and regain my real form! That’s why we must delve deep into Mementos and--

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Whoa, hold up. What’re you goin’ on and on about? We never said anything about helpin’ you out.

text.Morgana: Huh? Don’t tell me ...  Are you not going to repay the hospitality I showed you? Especially you! You’re going to up and leave, even though you’re already part of my master plan!?
Is it because I’m not human ... ? Because I’m like a cat ... ? Is that why you’re making a fool of me!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We’re busy! Thanks for everything, cat. You’ve got guts, bein’ a cat and all! See you around!

text.Morgana: Hey! What the hell!? Ugh, seriously! Why’re you wrapping this up like everything’s hunky-dory!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...Thank god. We’re back. I dragged you around a lot, huh? ...Sorry, man. Ugh, I’m dead tired ...  How you holdin’ up?

Me too ...  Man, I’m gonna sleep like a rock when I get home. But damn, if what we saw was for real, this is gonna get good! I totally remember the faces of the guys Kamoshida was treatin’ like slaves. Once we make ‘em fess up to any physical abuse, Kamoshida will be done. So ...  wanna help me look for those guys or any witnesses?

Now that’s what I’m talkin’ about! Hey, so ...  If you’re thinkin’ of layin’ low ‘cause you got a record, I don’t think that’ll help ...  Everyone already knows. They totally got you pegged as a criminal.
Kamoshida opened his damn mouth!

No one else besides a teacher could’ve leaked it that fast! It doesn’t matter if it’s a student or a club; that asshole just wrecks things he doesn’t agree with. Just like he did with me ... ! No one’ll take anything I say seriously. Still, those rumors about him gettin’ physical might be real. And after seein’ Kamoshida’s distorted-heart thing in person, there’s no way I can just sit back!

text.ACTION: We should know what we’re getting into, man. I’m not saying don’t do it, but this could have unforeseen consequences.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You gotta do this! I’ll help out too!

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I’m countin’ on you! Don’t worry; I’m hyped about this too!

text.Sae Niijima: However, you did not. There are merits to having associates ...  That’s what you decided. Am I wrong?

text.ACTION: So, we’ve unlocked our first Confidant. These are just a themed version of the Social Links from 3 and 4. The tarot motifs return and everything. Speaking of which, Ryuji is not, in fact, the Magician, as one might think from his similarity in role to Junpei and Yosuke. He is instead the Chariot, which symbolizes concepts like determination and will power, but also a lack of control and aggression when reversed.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Right. I haven’t eaten anything since lunch. It’d be weird splittin’ off now, so why don’t we grab a bite somewhere?
Just follow me. I mean, I totally gotta hear about your past!
The hell, man! How much shittier can that asshole get!?

Are you for real? If it was me, I wouldn’t calm down until I punched that dick in the face. So ...  you left your hometown, and ...  you’re livin’ here now, huh? We might be more alike than I originally thought.

I don’t got a record like you do. I mean, that’s not the point. I guess it’s how we’re treated like a pain in the ass by the people around us, like we don’t belong. I did something stupid at school before, too.

text.ACTION: Ryuji shovels the entire bowl into his mouth and slams it onto the counter.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The place you’re livin’ now is in ...  Yongen, right? It’s rush hour on the subways. I suggest you kill some time before headin’ home.

text.ACTION: Ryuji places more of… something into your bowl.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Just lemme do it. I gotta thank you for helpin’ me. Anyways, I got your back like you got mine from tomorrow on. As long as we do something about Kamoshida, I’m sure we’ll both feel better about bein’ at school. Oh, yeah!

text.ACTION: By “occasionally” they of course mean “constantly.” The deluge of messages in this game never ceases.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Just you wait, Kamoshida ...  We’re gonna start right away tomorrow. First, let’s hit up those guys that were kept as slaves. The volleyball rally’s tomorrow, huh? Shit’s recommended by Kamoshida. Makes me wanna gag. But thanks to that, we got no classes in the afternoon, and we can walk around unnoticed. Well, I guess we can work out the details tomorrow ...

text.Shiho Suzui: I-I haven’t been sleeping well lately ...  Whenever I close my eyes, I keep thinking about too many things ...

text.Ann Takamaki: Shiho...

text.Shiho Suzui: Nationals are coming up soon, so I keep thinking ...  Should someone like me really be on the starting lineup ... ?

text.Ann Takamaki: Don’t worry. Just be confident in yourself! Your skills have been recognized! It’s all because you work harder than anyone else!

text.Shiho Suzui: ... .. Yeah ...  Volleyball’s all I have, after all ...

text.Ann Takamaki: More importantly, was that injury OK? It looked really swollen.

text.Shiho Suzui: No, it’s nothing. It’s normal ...  Especially because a meet’s coming up...

text.Shiho Suzui: Huh? What does he want ... ?

text.Yuuki Mishima: He didn’t say...

text.Ann Takamaki: ... .. It’ll be fine! I bet it’s a meeting about the starting lineup or something.

text.Shiho Suzui: ... .. ...Yeah. Well, I better go...

text.Ann Takamaki: Yup. Good luck!

text.ACTION: Shiho and the quiet student leave.

text.Ann Takamaki: Hang in there, Shiho ... !

text.Sojiro Sakura: I take it you actually went to school today?

I guess you learned your lesson after what happened yesterday. Eh, as long as you’re not getting into trouble, it’s fine by me. I don’t know what you’ve been up to, but trust me, you’ll be gone if you start causing problems. In case you forget, your life is not a free one right now.

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You’re a bro, man ...  Welp, seeya tomorrow! Let’s save those guys who’ve been getting abused. You and me.

text.Sojiro Sakura: ...Sheesh, are you even listening to me? Just stay away from bad influences, OK? Hey, I’m gonna head home for the night. I’ll lock the store up. Don’t go wandering out.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We ended up at that weird place when we used this nav app, right?
I deleted it earlier, but it came back ...  Think it’s being downloaded on its own somehow?
Basically, it’s gonna depend on how we use it. But first we gotta find evidence for the beatings. I’m counting on you, all right? Don’t go ditching school on me.

text.Igor: I thought about resuming our previous conversation tonight. That is why I have summoned you. What are your thoughts? Are you becoming accustomed to this place?

Ah, glad to hear it. It seems you have nerves of steel. Your rehabilitation determines if ruin can be stopped. Yet, such a feat cannot be done by you alone. But today, you entered a partnership with someone who awoke to the same power, haven’t you?

Involving yourself with others is an important foundation for your recovery. You’ve done well. That said, I am not advising the formation of superficial relationships. It must not be of frivolity, but a ring of those, who would, by morals or faith, lend you their strength. In other words, they are bonds with those who have been robbed of their places to belong. The expansion of said ring will, in return, help you mature as well.

text.Justine: Personas are the strength of heart ...  The stronger the bonds that surround you, the more power your Personas will gain.

text.Caroline: There are countless people in the city who have talents that a weakling like you doesn’t. You better rack that noggin of yours and get them on your side. We’ll change that into power.

text.ACTION: So yeah, just Social Links under a new name. But, there’s more, and that’s where this gets way more compelling.

text.Igor: Indeed. You should be prepared to use even myself, or your ambitions will not come to fruition. (chuckle) We have a deal then.

text.Joker: It feels like Igor has high expectations of me...

text.ACTION: Igor is Fool, for the record, which symbolizes beginnings and free-spiritedness, but also naïveté. It applies more to the protagonist than to Igor, which is why it’s actually the protagonist’s Arcana. The Fool Arcana is special because it’s the number 0, which on its own symbolizes emptiness and possibility. All the protagonists of the more recent Persona games were of the Fool Arcana, and it grants special abilities to those blessed with it. I could be coy about it but there’s really no point: it’s the power to control multiple Personas.

What really elevates the Confidants above Social Links is that each of them provides specific abilities. Wild Talk lets us negotiate with enemy Shadows during a Hold Up instead of proceeding into an All-out Attack, while Arcana Burst gives bonus experience from fusion based on the Confidant Rank of the resulting Persona’s Arcana. We’ll go more into what those mean for us when we get to them.

text.Igor: Well, you will understand it all in due time ...  Continue devoting yourself to your rehabilitation.

text.Caroline: Now this conversation’s over! Get lost, Inmate!

text.Dissatisfied First-Year: And why are they pitting us against the teacher team? Kamoshida’s gonna crush us.

text.Sadayo Kawakami: As you all know, today is the volleyball rally. Head to the gymnasium once you’ve changed. Got it?

text.ACTION: So, if I’m understanding this correctly, this volleyball rally is just an excuse for the teachers, primarily Kamoshida, to dunk all over every student in school. What the hell is the stated point of this?
They show this spike from three different angles, because Kamoshida’s just that good.
The same student takes the spike right to the face.

text.Suguru Kamoshida: Someone! Take him to the nurse’s office!

text.ACTION: And Kamoshida continues on without breaking stride.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Get to know each other better, my ass. It’s just a one-man show for him to stroke his ego. And how he acted like he was worried about Mishima? What an abusive d-bag ... ! ...Well, anyways. Now’s our chance to go look for the guys we saw were slaves yesterday. Let’s look for the faces we saw at the castle. All the members of the team should be here today. I’ll be sure to find someone to spill about Kamoshida’s physical abuse. Just you wait, asshole.

The first one that popped out was a guy from Class D, so let’s start from there. That’s your class. Hopefully you can get him to talk without any issues. People have been avoidin’ me lately, so ...  Oh, but you’re kinda in the same boat, huh.

text.ACTION: Returning from Persona 4 is the incredibly useful ability to warp around the map. The areas in P5 are generally a lot bigger, so it’s a life-saver.
The rumors are only getting worse. Now we’ve got multiple convictions for murder and pull knives on people.
Let’s see if newspaper girl knows anything.

text.Newspaper Club Member: I can’t ...  Every time I try to look into them, the higher-ups of our school pressure me out of it.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The hell!? So Kamoshida’s pullin’ strings behind the scenes?

text.Newspaper Club Member: ...Can we stop this? I’d rather not get in trouble for talking to you guys.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Tch, fine...

text.Injured Student: Are you skipping out on the volleyball rally? I guess I expect it from you, transfer.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey, that’s the guy who was over at the castle.

text.Injured Student: You too, Sakamoto!? What do you guys want ... ?
What!? Wh-What are you saying? Of course not.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: It’s Kamoshida, ain’t it? Look, I ain’t gonna tell anyone you squealed. Just tell us about how Kamoshida’s abusin’ you.

text.Injured Student: I-I don’t know what you’re talking about!
I’m not! You guys are talking complete nonsense!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Don’t try n’ hide it! We already know!

text.Injured Student: You ...  You know? You have proof?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Well, uh ...  I...

text.Injured Student: This is ridiculous. Please, leave me alone. You’re really bothering me!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...All right, that’s enough. C’mon, let’s go.
Crap. If we keep goin’ at this pace, the ball game’s gonna end...

Guess that’d be faster. I’ll check the Practice Building for people before clubs start. You handle the Classroom Building. There’s a third-year on the volleyball team that I remember. I think he’s in ...  3-C? He might be around his classroom. The third-year classrooms are on the first floor. He was gettin’ beat pretty badly at the castle. He might have some injuries here too ...  Anyways, I’ll hit you up if I find anything. Seeya!

text.Ann Takamaki: I know. I hate rumors already, but they’re only getting more and more complex as time goes on.

text.Shiho Suzui: I wonder if he’s all right ...  I hope he’s not letting it get to him too much.

text.Ann Takamaki: That’s just like you, Shiho. Always worrying about other people before yourself. Kinda like when you were there for me ...

text.Volleyball Player: Hey, I know who this guy is. He’s that transfer student who’s been hanging out with Sakamoto...

text.Injured Student: Oh, I get it. You’re trying to snoop on Mr. Kamoshida, right? Look, our volleyball team performs at a national level. Of course our practices are gonna be tough. Mr. Kamoshida’s just dedicated to training us. Don’t believe everything Sakamoto says.

text.Volleyball Player: Hey, we should stop talking to him. What if he loses it and starts attacking us? I heard he even carries a knife around. Who knows what he’s capable of.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Him too ... ? Man, everyone’s too freaked out about Kamoshida. But I still got a lead. A first-year, new member. He just joined, so he might not be all wrapped up in Kamoshida’s web of bullshit yet. Pretty sure he’s in class 1-B. Try the first-year classrooms. They’re up on the third floor!

text.ACTION: Up on the third floor, we find our target.

text.Injured Student: Wh-What ... !? Why would you say something like that? I mean, sure Mr. Kamoshida’s strict, but it’s like this for all the other sports teams, right? Though, the special coaching he gave Mishima-senpai was prolly too far ...  O-Oh, uh ...  I seriously don’t know anything! Sorry!
P-Please ...  just stop talking to me ...  Ask someone else if you wanna know anything more...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So you didn’t have any luck either ...  Mkay, let’s regroup for now. See you in the courtyard?

text.Ann Takamaki: It’ll be quick. Anyway, what’s with you? Like, how you were late the other day was a lie and all.  ... There’s that weird rumor about you too.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Whaddya want with him?
...We just happened to get to know each other.

text.Ann Takamaki: What’re you planning on doing to Mr. Kamoshida?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Huh!? ...I see. I getcha. You’re all buddy-buddy with Kamoshida after all.

text.Ann Takamaki: This has nothing to do with you, Sakamoto!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: If you found out what he’s been doin’ behind your back, you’d dump him right away.

text.Ann Takamaki: Behind my back ... ? What’s that supposed to mean ... ?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You wouldn’t get it.

text.Ann Takamaki: Anyway, people are already talking about you two. I don’t know what you’re trying to pull, but no one’s gonna help you. I’m warning you, just in case. That’s all.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We just went to the same middle school. Anyways, that’s not what we’re here to talk about. I had no luck on my end. What about you? Did anything like someone’s name turn up?
Huh? I don’t get where you’re goin’ with that...

text.Joker: It might have been a different name...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Huh ... ? ...Special "coaching," huh? True. I always see the guy covered in bruises. Let’s go talk to him before he leaves then.

text.Yuuki Mishima: Sakamoto ... ? And you, too ... !?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: C’mon, we just wanna chat. Kamoshida’s been "coaching" you, huh? You sure it’s not just physical abuse?
What’re you talkin’ all polite for? Anyways ...  We saw him spike you today. Right in the face.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Still, that doesn’t explain all the other bruises you’ve got.

text.Yuuki Mishima: They’re from practice...!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Is he forcin’ you to keep quiet?

text.Yuuki Mishima: That’s...

text.Yuuki Mishima: I-I’m not feeling well today...

text.Suguru Kamoshida: What? Maybe you’re better off quitting then. You’re never going to improve that crappy form unless you show up to practice.
Well, Mishima? Are you coming to practice or not?

text.Yuuki Mishima: ...I’ll go.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Bastard...

text.Suguru Kamoshida: Same goes for you. Didn’t the principal tell you to keep in line.

text.ACTION: Nothing beats some hot, fresh, spicy sass towards an authority figure.

text.Suguru Kamoshida: Hmph. Just don’t get in the way of my practice. All these unsettling rumors are making the students anxious after all.

text.ACTION: I’m sure you’d know all about that, huh?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That’s your own goddamn fault.

text.Suguru Kamoshida: This won’t get us anywhere. Let’s go, Mishima. Shujin Academy is a place where those with aspirations come to learn. Unworthy students like yourselves don’t have any right to be here. Get with the program!

text.Yuuki Mishima: Yes, sir.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That asshole ...

text.Yuuki Mishima: ...There’s no point.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Huh!?

text.Yuuki Mishima: ...Don’t be a pain. You don’t understand what I’m going through. Shouldn’t you of all people know that nothing’s going to help ... !?

Yeah ...  It’s basically because Kamoshida made the volleyball team famous, yeah? Even so, that don’t give him the right to do whatever he wants!

Ann Takamaki. You met her in the courtyard, remember? You should know her. I mean, she’s in your class, dude. Ugh! What a load of bull! I can’t let it end like this. I’m gonna try and find someone who knows about what’s going one with Kamoshida during break tomorrow. Just you watch. I ain’t giving up!

text.Ann Takamaki: It’s probably just my part-time job ...  I think.

text.Shiho Suzui: I ... should get going.

text.Ann Takamaki: Shiho ...  ...Are you sure you’re OK?

text.Shiho Suzui: Uh-huh...

text.ACTION: Shiho leaves. Ann’s phone continues to ring.

text.Ann Takamaki: Today won’t work ...  I’m ...  I’m not feeling so good ...  Sorry ...  Bye.

text.ACTION: Ann hangs up and leaves. Two male students enter the courtyard at the same time.

text.Dull Male Student: Rumor has it she’s dating Kamoshida.
I heard people saw them in his car together.

text.Bored Male Student: You know ...  she seems pretty easy, huh? You think I’d have a chance, too?

text.Dull Male Student: C’mon dude, you can’t go after Kamoshida’s bitch!

text.ACTION: This is a really messed up school.

text.Shiho Suzui: ...What? Oh ...  I’m in the way, aren’t I? Sorry...
I really am sorry though. I must have spaced out ...  Hm, you don’t look familiar. Could you be that transfer student from Class D?

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Shiho Suzui: Uh, this might not be any of my business, but don’t let the rumors get to you, OK ... ?

I’m glad to hear that. ...My best friend is often misunderstood too, all because of her looks ...  Ah, sorry. I didn’t mean to drag on like that. Anyway, I have to go to practice ...  I’ll see you around.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Is that what it looks like? All of ‘em kept sayin’ the same shit Mishima was talkin’ about ... !
At this rate ...  it looks like we’ll have to go to him directly...
I know ...  But seriously, isn’t there something we can do? No way I’m gonna give in like this! Can you think of anything?

text.ACTION: Let’s go straight for the insane option.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That’d be fine if we could do it without gettin’ caught, but ...  if we did, we’d be seriously done for. You got any other ideas ... ?

text.ACTION: And now for the insanely pointless option.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So you wanna tell ‘em about the castle? They’d never believe us ...  Have any other ideas ... ? What do we do ... ?
The king ... ? You mean that other world’s Kamoshida? I didn’t think of that, but ...  Is there any meaning to--
...You say something?
That voice ...  Is that you, Morgana!?

text.Morgana: How dare you, up and leaving me the other day!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The cat’s talkin’!?

text.Morgana: I am NOT a cat! This is just what happened when I came to this world! It was a lot of trouble finding you two.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wait ...  You came to our world!? Does that mean you’ve got a phone!?

text.Morgana: You don’t need one when you’re at my level. I did get pretty lost making my escape though...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That aside, why can you talk!? You’re a cat!

text.Morgana: How should I know!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You hearin’ this too ... ?
This is no time to be jokin’ around!

text.Morgana: You guys are having a rough time of this, hm? I heard you mention something about witnesses.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Oh, shuddup.

text.Morgana: You know, I could tell you a thing or two about what to do about Kamoshida. You were pretty close just a moment ago.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: God, that condescendin’ attitude! This thing’s gotta be Morgana!

text.Morgana: You were still doubting me!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Ack ... ! Quiet down!

text.Boy 3: I just heard a meow somewhere near here. Didn’t you hear it?

text.ACTION: Oh shit, sorry guys. That was me.

text.Teacher 1: Make sure you check every nook and cranny around.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Meow ... ? Does that mean only us two can understand what you’re sayin’?

text.Morgana: Looks like it.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What the hell’s goin’ on ... ? Anyways, what you were talkin’ about earlier ...  is it for real?

text.Morgana: You’re quite the skeptic for being an idiot.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey, tell us more. Then again, this probably ain’t the best place...
Enough of that! You said you know how we can do something about Kamoshida, right?

text.Morgana: It has to do with what this guy was talking about earlier. You’ll need to attack his castle.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What do you mean ... ?

text.Morgana: That castle is how Kamoshida views this school. He doesn’t realize what happens in there, but it’s deeply connected to the depths of his heart. Thus, if the castle disappears, it would naturally impact the real Kamoshida.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What’d happen?

text.Morgana: A Palace is a manifestation of a person’s distorted desires. So, if that castle were no more...
Precisely! You sure pick up things fast!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: For real!? H-He’s gonna turn good!? But ...  is that really gettin’ back at him?

text.Morgana: Erasing a Palace essentially means forcing the owner to have a change of heart. However, even though their warped wants disappear, the crimes they committed remain. Kamoshida will become unable to bear the weight of those crimes, and he’ll confess them himself!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You for real!? That’s possible!?

text.Morgana: And since the Palace will no longer exist, he’ll forget what we did there as well. Not only will we be able to bring Kamoshida down, but there won’t even be a trace of our involvement.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That’s amazing! You are one incredible cat!

text.Morgana: True, except for the cat part!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So? How do we get rid of the Palace!?

text.Morgana: By stealing the Treasure held within.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Stealing ... ?

text.Morgana: I’ll tell you more once you agree to go ahead with this. It’s my most valuable, secret plan, after all. If you want to help me out, I’ll gladly teach you. What’s your call?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Our luck’s runnin’ dry lookin’ for witnesses. Guess we have no choice but to go along ...

text.Morgana: ...Good. Oh, right. There’s one more thing I should tell you. If we erase a Palace, there is no doubt that the person’s distorted desires will be erased as well. But desires are what we all need in order to survive. The will to sleep, eat, fall in love—those sorts of things.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What’re you gettin’ at?

text.Morgana: If all of those yearnings were to vanish, they’d be no different than someone who has shut down entirely. They may even die if they’re not given proper care. So...
Will you listen to everything I have to say first?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Would their death be our fault ... ?

text.Morgana: Aren’t you determined enough to face those kinds of risks?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey ...  What do you think?

text.ACTION: This seems like a little much, even for that piece of shit.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: O-Of course not...

text.Morgana: Sheesh ...  I come all this way, and this is what I get. It’s not like anyone will ever find out.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That’s not the point! If we just go around secretly doin’ whatever we want, we’d be no different than that effin’ Kanoshida...

text.Morgana: Isn’t this your only option? ...I’ll come back later. Make sure you’ve made your decision by then.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I’ll try and see if I can figure out another way ...  C’mon, let’s get outta here.
About that Suzui girl ...  Looks like rumors are going around about her and Kamoshida.

It’s just impossible. I’ve known Takamaki and Suzui since middle school. There’s just no way Kamoshida’s their type, y’know? So ...  I gotta wonder where those rumors came from. Well, whatever. I’ll try asking around some more.

text.Ann Takamaki: This has nothing to do with Shiho!

text.ACTION: The person on the other end abruptly hangs up.

text.Ann Takamaki: Ah...
Shiho’s ...  starting position ...

text.ACTION: Maaku walks closer. Ann notices him and backs away.

text.Ann Takamaki: Wait ...  Were you listening?
Haven’t you heard of privacy?  ... .. ...No, I was out of line. Sorry.
So how much did you hear ... ?
Shiho ...  It’s nothing at all. Nothing...

text.ACTION: Time to pursue an emotionally fragile teenager over something that’s none of our business. This should go well.
Ann eventually stops near these pillars.

text.Ann Takamaki: Why ...  Why do you keep worrying about me? (sob)
What the heck ... ? I really don’t get you ...

text.ACTION: Then why are we even here?

text.Ann Takamaki: It was just an argument...

text.Joker: It seems like she’s really stressed out...

text.Ann Takamaki: About Mr. Kamoshida. Everyone says we’re getting it on. But ...  that’s so not true ... !
I avoided giving him my number ...  for the longest time ...  He told me to go to his place after this...
If I turn him down, he said he’d take my friend off as a regular on the team...
I can’t take it anymore...
But still ...  Shiho’s my best friend.
Tell me ...  What should I do ... ?
Sorry ...  I shouldn’t have asked. It’s not your problem.
...You might be right. ...You’re so weird. Usually everyone just ignores me. Are you really a bad person as the rumor says ... ? You just don’t seem like it...

Is that supposed to be a joke? I kinda had a feeling they were all just exaggerations. You seemed lonely—almost like you didn’t belong anywhere ...  We’re the same in that regard. Maybe that’s why it was so easy for me to talk to you. Is there really no way for me to help Shiho ... ? I wish he’d just change his mind ...  Like, forget about me, and everything ...  As if something like that would ever happen...
I wasn’t asking for a serious response. But I do feel a bit better now. ...I’m gonna head home.
I’ll try and think of a way to persuade Kamoshida. Well ...  thanks.

text.Yuuki Mishima: Are you leaving ... ?

text.Shiho Suzui: What is it ... ?

text.Yuuki Mishima: Mr. Kamoshida’s asking for you ...  He’s in the PE faculty office.

text.Shiho Suzui: What did he say?

text.Yuuki Mishima: ...I don’t know. Well ...  I have to go.

text.Shiho Suzui: Ann ...

text.ACTION: Shiho ignores the call and walks off.

text.Sojiro Sakura: ...By the way, you haven’t been hanging around any bad influences, have you?

Huh. They’ve gotta be pretty strange to want to spend time with you. Just make sure you’re careful who your friends are, if you don’t want them ruining your life. (yawn) Look at the time. Seriously, think about how I feel having to stay up here waiting for you. Hey, I’m leaving. In the future, try not to come back so damn late. Understood?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I dunno if I get all that stuff about stealing desires ...  And Kamoshida’s gonna turn like, brain dead if we mess up, right?
For sure. I mean, maybe I’m just freaking out, but I don’t wanna end up a murderer cause of this shit. Oh well ...  I’ll try and see if I can come up with some other way tonight.

text.ACTION: One thing I’ve been neglecting to do every night is sit on the sofa. Depending on changes in the story, you’ll have new brief ruminations. It’s not much, but it’s cool all the same.

text.Joker: Anyway, I should get some sleep.

text.Worried Volleyball Player: Mr. Kamoshida asked to see her...

text.First-Year Volleyball Player: You know, I’ve been hearing rumors about how Mr. Kamoshida and Suzui-senpai stay late ...  She always shows up to meetings though. It’s weird she wasn’t at the one yesterday...

text.Ushimaru: The National Diet is legislative, the Cabinet is executive, and the Supreme Court is judiciary. This division of power provides checks and balances, which ensures no one branch becomes unstoppable.

text.Morgana: No matter how much thinking you do, there’s only one option. You’d be better off just listening to me.

text.Ushimaru: Hm? Did I just hear a cat just now?

text.Morgana: M-Meow!

text.Ushimaru: Could that rumored cat be somewhere nearby ... ? Settle down! We’re in the middle of an important lecture!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I can’t deal with that shit right now. I mean, what’re we gonna do about Kamoshida? Do we just gotta go along with what that cat says? Urgh, that damn furball ...

text.Morgana: If he only knew I’m reading this too...

text.Ushimaru: Enough! This is a classroom!

text.Yuuki Mishima: Suzui ... ?

text.Ushimaru: Hey! Stay in your seats! Do not step foot outside of this room!
Calm down! Back to your seats!

text.Ann Takamaki: No ...  Why ... ?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: There’s no way we’re gonna get past all these goddamn people ...  C’mon, let’s try goin’ through the practice buildin’!
Outta the way, man! Please!

text.Ann Takamaki: Shiho ... !

text.Paramedic: We need someone to go with her ...  Are there any teachers around?

text.Teacher 1: We should leave this to Principal Kobayakawa...

text.Ann Takamaki: I’ll go!

text.Shiho Suzui: Ann ... ? I’m sorry. I ...  I can’t take this ...  anymore...

text.Ann Takamaki: Shiho ... ?

text.ACTION: Shiho says something to Ann that we cannot hear.

text.Ann Takamaki: ...Huh? ...Kamoshida!?

text.Shiho Suzui: Ngh...

text.Teacher 2: Return to your classrooms at once!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That guy ...  Hey, wasn’t Mishima acting weird?
...We’re gonna make him talk this time.
Why’d you run like that? Huh!?

text.Yuuki Mishima: I didn’t run...
... L-Leave me alone...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: He’s right! We ain’t tryin’ to get you busted. We won’t say you talked either!

text.Yuuki Mishima: Suzui ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wait, what!?

text.Yuuki Mishima: I was called by him a number of times too ...  to the teacher’s room. It wasn’t just me or Suzui either. He’d nominate someone when he was in a bad mood ...  and hit them.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So the physical punishment thing was for real...

text.Yuuki Mishima: But yesterday, he called Suzui out of the blue. She didn’t make any mistakes or anything ...  Mr. Kamoshida seemed really irritated that day, so it must’ve been ...  worse than usual...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: He didn’t ... !

text.ACTION: Maaku follows, and ultimately so does Mishima.

text.Yuuki Mishima: Mr. Kamoshida’s probably in the PE faculty office on the second floor.
He went into the PE faculty office! Let’s hurry, we have to go after him.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You bastard! The hell did you do to that girl!?

text.Suguru Kamoshida: What are you talking about?

text.ACTION: Ryuji kicks a chair over in rage.

text.Suguru Kamoshida: That is enough!

text.Yuuki Mishima: What you did ...  wasn’t coaching ... !

text.Suguru Kamoshida: What did you say?

text.Yuuki Mishima: You ...  You ordered me to call Suzui here ...  I can only imagine what you did to her ... !

text.Suguru Kamoshida: Basically, you’re simply making these claims because you can’t be a regular on the team, right?

text.Yuuki Mishima: That’s not what this is about ... !

text.Suguru Kamoshida: We just received a call from the hospital. Suzui’s in a coma, and her chances of recovery are slim ...  How would someone like that make a statement?
There’s no chance of her getting better, I hear ...  The poor girl.

text.Yuuki Mishima: No ...  That can’t be ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You goddamn ... !

text.ACTION: Ryuji is physically shaking at this point.

text.Suguru Kamoshida: This, again ... ? Does this mean we need to have yet another case of "self-defense"?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You shut your mouth, you son of a bitch!
Why’re you stoppin’ me ... !?
But still!

text.Suguru Kamoshida: Oh? You’re stopping him? What a surprise. There’s no need to hold back. Why not attack me? ...Ohhh, you can’t. Hahaha, but of course you can’t. Everyone present right now ...  will be expelled. I’m reporting all of you at the next board meeting.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wha--

text.Yuuki Mishima: You can’t make a decision like that ... !

text.Suguru Kamoshida: Who would seriously consider what scum like you say? You threatened me too, Mishima, so you’re just as responsible.

text.Yuuki Mishima: Huh ... ?

text.Suguru Kamoshida: To think you didn’t know why I kept someone as talentless as you on the team. You act like you’re a victim, but you leaked his criminal records, didn’t you? It’s all over the internet, correct? How terrible.
Now, are we finished here? You’re all expelled! You’re done for; your futures are mine to take. Now get out of my sight.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I can’t believe this asshole’s gettin’ away with this ... !

text.ACTION: And he does. The rest of this game takes place in jail.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Huh ... ? ...Oh right. We have that!

text.Suguru Kamoshida: I don’t understand what garbage like you are thinking, but go ahead and try. All you can do is wait for your disposal though ...

text.ACTION: I bet he thinks that was a really clever line. He’s been waiting weeks to use that one.

Part 9: 4/15: Wild Card, Bitches
	Part 9: 4/15: Wild Card, Bitches
Kamoshida’s got us on the ropes. Seems like we only have one option left...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We gotta hurry up and go to that world and beat the shit outta that asshole!

text.Morgana: ...We’re not beating him up. We’re simply stealing his distorted desires. Can I assume that you’ve made up your minds about this—about how he might suffer a mental shutdown?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...I have. Someone almost died because of him! I don’t give a rat’s ass what happens to him anymore!

text.Morgana: And you?
There you have it.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: By the way, is gettin’ rid of a Palace hard ... ? You’ve tried it before, right?

text.Morgana: ...When did I ever say that?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...Eh? WHAT!? Were you just pretendin’ to know!?
That asshole’s at it again ... ! So you came all this way to tell us that?

text.Ann Takamaki: If you’re going to deal with Kamoshida ...  let me in on it too.
I can’t just sit back and do nothing after what happened to Shiho!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: This has nothing to do with you ...  Don’t butt your head into this ...

text.Ann Takamaki: But it does! Shiho’s my--

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I said don’t get in our way!

text.Morgana: ...That was harsh.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We can’t take her somewhere like that...

text.Morgana: I hope that she doesn’t torment herself over this. When it comes down to it, women don’t hesitate.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We just gotta hurry up and deal with Kamoshida. Let’s go already!
Huh? Phantom thieves?

text.Morgana: Those who covertly sneak in and stylishly steal Treasure—that is what we become!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That sounds kinda cool! So we just gotta say the school, Kamoshida’s name, and ...  castle? Then we end up in bizarro world.
True. There’s no point in thinkin’ about it now. We’ll show that effin’ Kamoshida!

text.Morgana: Let’s go!

text.Ann Takamaki: They’re doing something on their phone? A name ...  School ... ?

text.ACTION: Music- King, Queen, and Slaves (Another Version)

text.Ann Takamaki: That voice ...  Sakamoto!? And ...  are you Hamiru-kun!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wh-Wh-Why are you here!?

text.Ann Takamaki: How should I know!?

text.ACTION: Uh-oh, the cat’s making googly eyes.

text.Morgana: I see. Perhaps she was dragged in because of that app thing. If multiple people can enter with the person who uses it, it stands to reason it’ll pull anyone nearby.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: For real ... ?

text.Ann Takamaki: Wait, so THIS is related to Kamoshida!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Anyways, you gotta leave!

text.Ann Takamaki: No!

text.Morgana: The Shadows are going to find us if you make a scene.

text.Ann Takamaki: No way! It talked!? Oh my god, it’s a monster cat ... !

text.Morgana: Monster ... ?

text.Ann Takamaki: You better explain what’s going on! I won’t leave until you do!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Looks like we gotta force her. But ...  how’re we supposed to do that?

text.Morgana: Just take her back to where we came in. That’s how it worked last time, right?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: O-Oh, yeah. Can you lend me a hand?
We can’t deal with Kamoshida if we don’t!
We’ll explain after everything’s over!

text.Ann Takamaki: Hey! And just where are you touching!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Whoa, sorry, I didn’t mean-- ...That’s not important!

text.Ann Takamaki: You guys seriously-- Ah!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We’d better be careful from now on when we use that app...

text.Morgana: You should’ve checked the tools you used! Why do I—the one who was just watching—know more about it than you two!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Sh-Shuddup! Geez, Takamaki found out right when we were startin’off ...  We gotta deal with this fast!

text.Morgana: That girl’s name is Ann Takamaki, right? Lady Ann ...

text.ACTION: Oh jeez. I’m not liking where this is going.

text.Morgana: We’re counting on you, Joker!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Joker? That a nickname?

text.Morgana: Don’t refer to it in such a lame way. It’s a code name.

text.ACTION: It’s cool to have a code name, I guess. It’s not that weird.

text.Morgana: What kind of stupid phantom thief would use their real name!? I’m not down for that! And there’s no telling what kind of effect yelling our real names will have on the Palace. It’s just a precaution.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So, why’s he Joker?

text.Morgana: Because he’s our trump card when it comes to fighting strength.
Just go with it! You’re Joker!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: It ain’t too bad, yeah?

text.Morgana: Next up is you, Ryuji. You’ll be ...  Let’s see ...  "Thug."

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Are you pickin’ a fight with me!? I’ll choose it myself! Hm ...  When it comes to me, it’s gotta be this mask. Honestly, I actually kinda like it. What if we named me after this?

text.Morgana: Fine ...  Why not "Skull" then?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Ooh! That sounds awesome! I’m Skull! What do we do about this one’s code name?
How ‘bout "Mona"?

text.Morgana: Well, if Joker thinks it’s easier to call me that, then I’ll go with it. All right. From here on out, we’re Joker, Skull, and Mona. We need to be absolutely thorough about using those code names from now on!

text.ACTION: We can run faster, but at the risk of making ourselves easier to detect. Simple stuff that’s really only useful for specific moments.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Looks like they don’t know ‘bout this way in yet.

text.Morgana: Joker, Skull ...  Are you ready? Let’s go!

text.ACTION: “Entertaining” is certainly a word you could use to describe what happened, sure.

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: However, I can’t allow that trash to ransack my castle! Strengthen the security! Kill them on sight! I’ll reward whoever brings me their heads.

text.Morgana: Look at all those soldiers, idiot! It’d be suicide. And I’m sure you don’t want a repeat of last time. Besides, don’t you want him to confess his sins? There’s no point beating him up. We need to steal his materialized desires ...  The Treasure.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Fiiiine. So, where is it?

text.Morgana: It has to be somewhere in the depths of this castle. Let’s infiltrate further in while he’s out here!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Whaddya wanna do? Should we kick its ass?

text.Morgana: Hold on ...  Hmmm ...  This might be a good opportunity to teach you something ...  All right, Joker! Are you ready to take it down?

text.Joker: Let’s go.

text.Morgana: There’s another use for Hold Ups besides simply defeating enemies. Shadows are beings born from people’s hearts, so naturally, they can talk too. In other words, you can communicate with them. Get it? If you talk to them when they’re cornered, they might offer money or items since they don’t want to die. In fact, talking has a better chance of scoring something great, as opposed to just offing them.

text.ACTION: *This isn’t true. Well, it’s not true yet. We don’t have the Confidant abilities that make going for rare items or lots o’ cash possible, so most of what we get from these guys is going to be junk. Keeping in mind that the battle immediately ends after a successful negotiation, and that enemies left undefeated because of this don’t give money or experience, there’s really only one reason we’d want to talk at this point in the game instead of just launching into an All-out Attack. We’ll get to that in a second.

text.Morgana: Well then, let’s do the first step: Knock all the enemies down, and do a Hold Up!

text.Pixie: It can’t get worse than this ...  What’re you going to do with me!?
Huh? So you’ll let me live if I just give you money?

text.Morgana: Well, something along those lines ...  Now let it be money or items. Just cough it up!

text.Pixie: But, this happened so suddenly ...  I actually don’t have anything on me ...  I-I usually do though, you know!?

text.Morgana: W-Wait, what? Oh ...  This isn’t how I was planning this to go. Uh ...  Anyway, it can’t be helped if that’s the case. Time for you to go to hell.
Sorry, but we’re in a hurry.

text.Pixie: No, wait up! Can’t we work something out? Don’t kill me, please! Won’t you let me go?

Ugh! Sorry, but that sounded really lame. That was the best one-liner you could come up with? I say cheesy stuff like that all the time too, though. I guess I’m more like you than I thought. Whoa, I feel different! Something’s happening!

text.Morgana: What the ... !? What’s going on!?

text.Pixie: I’m an existence that drifts about in the sea of humanity’s souls ...  My real name ...  is "Pixie"! I’m Pixie! From now on, I’ll live on inside your heart!

text.Morgana: What was that just now ... ? What happened!?
I-I have no idea! I wasn’t expecting that either...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Crap, they noticed us!

text.ACTION: We can hold multiple Personas, just like in 3 and 4. Having a specific Persona active means gaining that Persona’s respective skills and elemental affinities. We can only switch once per turn, though.
Pixie is strong against Electricity and Blessed and weak against Gun, Ice, and Curse. Stats aren’t great, but all we want is that Zio.

text.Morgana: I-Is that the Shadow from earlier!? Don’t tell me ...  Did you take in the Shadow’s appearance and powers as a Persona!?

text.ACTION: Let’s try to get this one on our side.

text.Bicorn: So that’s yer move? ...Then I guess I’ll talk first. I’ll decide if I’m gonna help you after. I gotta say, you’ve been a pretty inconsiderate host. You oughta show more hospitality. Couldn’t you at least make me a cup of tea or somethin’? Hell, that’d be real polite.

text.ACTION: Red veins are bad news, as you might have guessed.

text.Bicorn: ...Hey. Won’t you listen ta my dyin’ request? I wanna have some of yer "hospitality." What kinda "hospitality" will you show me at the end of my life?
Well, I guess I’ll try to worry more like a young person ...  while I’m runnin’ away!

text.ACTION: And just like that, we’re ejected back into the fight because we failed miserably. In addition to red veins for displeasure, there are also yellow notes for answers Shadows will accept and blue sweatdrops for neutral. Neutral gives items and notes lead to the Shadow joining. A Shadow’s reaction to specific answers is determined by its nature.
These are the kinds of answers each personality likes. The real challenge, then, is just figuring out what answer from the selection is “vague” or “kind,” which isn’t always as easy as it sounds.
I should also mention that we can only recruit Shadows that are at or below Maaku’s level, so no recruiting powerful enemies.

text.Morgana: He sealed the enemy’s appearance and powers into his mask, and made it his new Persona ...  I’ve never seen anyone do that before ...  didn’t even know it was possible!

Of course it is! Only one heart exists per person, so normally a person can only have one Persona! But this ...  this is incredible! That ability will give us a huge advantage in battle! All right, try to do that even more if the opportunity arises! You better help out too, Skull!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hell yeah! We’ll hold every last one of ‘em up!

text.ACTION: It’s worth noting now that we’re free that Maaku and his Personas level separately and at very different rates. Personas require quite a bit more experience to level, in fact. We can only hold six at the moment, so there’s incentive to get rid of old ones. But that’s not really relevant quite yet.

text.Morgana: There’s nothing we can do here right now. Let’s try elsewhere.

text.ACTION: In that chest we find a new knife for Maaku. It’s good to upgrade when we can, even if it only affects our melee attack.
We get some new Personas while we’re here, but the real reason I took this picture is because they changed Pyro Jack’s name to Jack-o’-Lantern and I’m not over it.

text.Morgana: A safe room. We can discuss our strategy inside. There are a lot of places even I don’t know about in here ...

text.Ann Takamaki: I just said the words Sakamoto said, and I ended up--
Huh?
Aaaaaaaah!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Just gettin’ this far’s been a real pain in my ass!

text.Morgana: It’s all because you guys provoked Kamoshida, you know. Still ...  he seems to be awfully on guard...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Anyways, how’re we supposed to steal that Treasure thing?

text.Morgana: Don’t be so hasty. First, we’ll need to secure an infiltration route.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: A what ... ?

text.Morgana: A path to the Treasure’s location. But honestly, I think we’ll need a little more manpower in order to accomplish this. At the very least, one more person would be nice ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey, you say you don’t have your memories and all, but somehow you still know about that kinda stuff? Do you think this thing’s really got amnesia?

text.ACTION: I should really stop making the cat sad.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You sure talk big, but what if it turns out you’re just some stray cat in the end?

text.Morgana: That can’t be...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Princess ... ?

text.Shadow: It doesn’t matter now. We must take her back to King Kamoshida!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Who’s this princess they’re talkin’ about ... ?
And yet another question goes unanswered ...  Stuff like the castle and that navigation app are mysterious ...  but Morgana’s got ‘em both beat.
Crap, sorry! What was I again? ...Oh yeah, Skull!

text.Morgana: This is bad!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That was fast!

text.Morgana: Your friend ...  Lady Ann! She’s been taken by Shadows...!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wait, what? We sent her home earlier.

text.Morgana: If Lady Ann does indeed have the app, it could be possible.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Oh no ...  Don’t tell me it got put on hers just like mine ... !? Dammit! We let her out for her own safety, and she just came back in by herself ... !

text.Morgana: We need to hurry and rescue her! Follow me! I’ll guide you!

text.ACTION: On our way back through the dining room, we see Morgana’s All-out Attack finisher. It’s one of the better ones.
Along the way, Ryuji learns Lunge, a light Physical strike.

text.Ann Takamaki: Look, I’ll apologize for touching the armor without permission!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: She totally doesn’t get what’s goin’ on!

text.Morgana: Let’s hurry! We have to save her!

text.ACTION: Like in previous games, they’ll warn you before big fights, which is always nice.

text.Morgana: OK, let’s go!

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: So, this is the intruder.

text.Ann Takamaki: Who’s that...? More importantly, what is this place!? Why’s the school turned into something like this!?

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: I can’t believe you mistook my Ann for someone like her. Are you afraid?

text.Ann Takamaki: What is that outfit ... ? Have you lost your mind?

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: I do as I please here. After all, this is my castle ...  The world of my desires.

text.Ann Takamaki: What the--!? Wait ...  Is this some red-light district!?

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: What a lively slave.

text.Ann Takamaki: This isn’t funny! Enough of the bullshit, Kamoshida!

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: In that case ...  she should be executed.

text.Ann Takamaki: Are you kidding me ... ?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Is that what he thinks of the girls on the volleyball team ... !?

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: Just when I was about to start enjoying myself...

text.Ann Takamaki: What’s the deal with this guy ... !?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You little ... !

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: ...How many times are you gonna come back?
I bet you’re just like those thieves. You came because you’re pissed at me, huh? But, ah ...  I forget that chick’s name, but it’s your fault she jumped, you know.

text.Ann Takamaki: Huh ... ?

text.ACTION: ...Holy shit. That’s… okay, we need to repave this dude’s face.

text.Ann Takamaki: You bastard!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: No!
Dammit ... !

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: Just sit back and enjoy the dismantlement show.

text.Ann Takamaki: No! Don’t!
(giggle) You’re such a perv!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: H-Hey, what’re we gonna do!? Takamaki!

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: That’s more like it. You should’ve looked like this from the start.

text.Ann Takamaki: Shiho ...  I’m so sorry...
Huh ... ?  ... You’re right. Letting this piece of shit toy with me ...  What was I thinking ... !?

text.Shadow Suguru Kamoshida: It’s like I always say. Slaves should just behave and--

text.Ann Takamaki: ...Shut up! I’ve had enough of this ...  You’ve pissed me off, you son of a bitch!
Urgh ... !

text.Carmen: Tell me ...  Who is going to avenge her if you don’t?
Such is the scream of the other you that dwells within ...  I am thou, thou art I...

text.ACTION: Ann kicks the guard’s sword into the air...

text.Ann Takamaki: You know what? I’m not some cheap girl you can toy with ...  you scumbag.
No one’s gonna stop me now!

text.ACTION: Sadly, Carmen is not named after Carmen Sandiego. From the Megami Tensei wiki:

"Carmen is a fictive female [Romani] created by Prosper Mérimée. She first appeared in Mérimée's eponymous novella that was first written and published in 1845. The novella was adapted into a variety of different genres, most notably the opera Carmen by French composer Georges Bizet which diverges in significant points from Mérimée's original story.

Whatever the version, Carmen is generally depicted as a classic femme fatale who would take advantage of her beauty and charm to make men fall for her but quickly break the relationship once she is bored of her wooer and then looks for the next victim. Carmen is also usually seen smoking tobacco because she had once been working in a tobacco factory. She is later slain by a spurned ex-lover driven to a jealous rage after she leaves him. Though she knew he would be fated to kill her, she declares that she would rather die than allow herself to be bound to the will of another and that "Carmen will always be free".”

Ann is… interesting. She’s Yukiko in a lot of ways, but the ways in which they’re different honestly kind of kill her. She’s got the fire affinity as well as healing, and her stats and skills make her probably the party’s most effective magic user. However, she has odd limitations in her skillset. Not only does she never learn any form of multitarget healing, which is a real bummer, even the niche spells she learns aren’t as useful as what other party members bring to the table. Ann can do a lot of damage, but she’s one of the less flexible party members in a game that really rewards flexibility. This isn’t to say she’s not useful, because she learns skills like Tarunda (enemy attack down) and Dekaja (gets rid of enemy buffs) very early on. It’s just that especially in the late game her limitations come into focus. She’s not as much Yukiko, who was an excellent all-rounder, as she is Chie from Golden, who can technically do tons of damage but becomes hopelessly outclassed in actual utility at certain points in the game. But hey, nuking shit with fire’s always good.

Part 10: 4/15-4/17: A Serious Health Code Violation
	Part 10: 4/15-4/17: A Serious Health Code Violation
Now Ann has a Persona. Time to go to work.

text.Ann Takamaki: That dirtbag just sees women as sexual outlets! Don’t make me laugh with that "love" bullshit! C’mon, Carmen! Let’s give ‘em hell!

text.ACTION: This is Belphegor, and yes, that is a toilet. He’s one of my favorite SMT demons because all he wants to do is take a shit. He’s my friend and I love him.
He’s weak to fire, so he goes down real quick. Minibosses can’t be talked to, so there’s no reason to do anything but All-out Attack.

text.Ann Takamaki: Pff, outside of school, that guy’s nothing but a pathetic loser!

text.ACTION: Morgana also learns Patra, which cures Dizzy/Forget/Sleep/Hunger for one ally. We’ll go more into status effects later.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Why’d you come here, man!? And more importantly, how!?

text.Morgana: Hey! Is that how you speak to a woman!? Are you all right, Lady Ann!?

text.Ann Takamaki: Lady Ann ... ? Wait, what is this thing? Is it alive ... ? How can it talk? And ...  where in the world are we ... !?

text.Morgana: J-Just calm gown. Everything’s going to be OK; don’t worry.

text.Ann Takamaki: Huh? What are you talking about!? What the hell are you thinking!?

text.ACTION: Yeah, in retrospect that probably wasn’t the best thing to say.

text.Morgana: Well, I’m stumped ...  A search party will be coming for us soon. There’s no time to explain. We don’t have a choice. Let’s retreat for now!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We were just gettin’ fired up, and you had to go and get in the way ...  Rgh, fine...
You take the other side.

text.Ann Takamaki: Whichever’s not carbonated.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Uh, they’re both actually.

text.Ann Takamaki: Then...

text.Morgana: What about me?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Huh? But you’re a cat.

text.Ann Takamaki: (giggles)
Um ...  Morgana, right? I really am talking to a cat ...  This feels so strange ...  Oh, sorry! You’re not a cat, right?

text.Morgana: It’s only natural that you’re confused. Demanding that you understand all of this right after what you went through is asking too much.

text.Ann Takamaki: Honestly, I still can’t believe what happened ...  And that power ...  my Persona...

text.Morgana: It’s the will of your rebellion, Lady Ann. With it, you’ll be able to fight in that other world.

text.Ann Takamaki: So if what you told me is true, we can make Kamoshida have a change of heart, right? Is it really possible ... ? Can we actually force him to confess his crimes?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The volleyball team’s keepin’ quiet about this, while teachers and parents turn a blind eye. If guys like us try and complain, they’re just gonna shoot us down. Goin’ all in on this plan is the only choice we got.

text.Ann Takamaki: Then let me help too. I want to make him pay for what happened to Shiho. He just keeps going like nothing happened, even after what he did to her ...  I’ll never forgive him.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wait, did you just say, "let me help"? You mean, you want us to take you along?

text.Ann Takamaki: Don’t act like I’m going to drag you down. Weren’t you watching? I can fight too.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey, what should we do?

text.ACTION: Ann is actually probably my least favorite party member in the game for a few reasons, including her overall lack of utility and her battle character design which manages to be both oversexualized and also just not that visually interesting, but, uh, sure, yeah, she’ll be great. I guess.

text.Morgana: I agree as well. We are lacking in manpower, after all. Don’t worry, I’ll protect her.

text.ACTION: This game needs an option to bust out laughing at that.

text.Ann Takamaki: Even if you said, no, I’d just go in alone.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Oh right, she can go by herself ...  I guess it’d be more dangerous turnin’ her down ...  Rgh, fine...

text.Ann Takamaki: Then it’s decided. Well, I hope we get along! I’m going to make Kamoshida atone for what he did. Not just for Shiho’s sake, but for everything he’s done. I won’t let any more people suffer because of him. I’ll do whatever it takes!

text.Joker: I sense a strong fighting resolve from Ann...

text.Sae Niijima: It wouldn’t be odd if you had someone that was proficient in deceiving the eyes of others ...  ...If you’re listening, then answer me!

text.ACTION: I guess this relates to Ann because… she’s a model? I guess?
The Lovers Arcana represents relationships and choices, but also disharmony and inner conflict.

Ann learns Baton Pass from the first rank of her Confidant. This is a skill all of our party members will eventually learn at early ranks of their Confidants. It lets us pass the additional turn gained from a 1 More over to someone else who knows Baton Pass, dealing increased damage in the process. It’s one of the best new additions to the combat in this game over previous entries. The only downside is that not knowing it is a severe hindrance to any new party members you haven’t progressed through the Confidants of.

text.Ann Takamaki: Hey, give me your number and chat ID. And, um ...
I’ll be counting on you, then. Same goes for you, Morgana.

text.Morgana: The pleasure is all mine, Lady Ann.
And the innocence to cast herself into the jaws of death to achieve her goal ...  She cares about her friends, and she’s beautiful to boot ...  What a girl! She’s captured my heart...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dude.

text.ACTION: I’m with Ryuji, this is getting mighty uncomfortable.

text.Morgana: True. Our best option would be to make a secret hideout where we could discuss these things.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: A hideout, huh ... ? I like the sound of that.

text.Morgana: The school rooftop would work ...  It seems like nobody goes up there. For the time being, that will make the perfect hideout. I can’t contact you from inside a Palace, so I’ll stay in this world. That being said, I’ll need someone to take care of me. I’m personally nominating you. You should feel honored.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...This’s all you. There’s no way I can at my place. Well, we now have our hideout, so let’s meet there tomorrow!

text.ACTION: Ryuji runs to board the train.
Hm? Who’s this? Let’s talk to her.

text.Sojiro Sakura: Hey, lay off the customers. Sorry if he was rude, Doctor.

text.Tae Takemi: ...I don’t mind.

text.Sojiro Sakura: Come on, you’re getting in the way. Go on upstairs.
Come back again.

Oh, that customer just now? She’s the head doctor over at that clinic down the street. Rumor has it she gives pretty crappy examinations, and sells some weird homemade medicines on top of that. At least, that’s what I’ve heard. I haven’t been there myself. They should really just leave her alone. It’s not like she’s getting in the way of their lives ...

text.Morgana: Hey, are we there yet?

text.Sojiro Sakura: Well, I’ve gotta get home and start making dinner...

text.Morgana: What the ... !? What is this place!? Is this some kind of abandoned house ... !?

text.Sojiro Sakura: I was wondering why I heard meowing ...  What did you bring it here for!?

Not my problem. Look, this place is a restaurant. Animals are a no-go ...  Though I guess you might stay on good behavior if you’ve got a pet to take care of ...  Fine ...  But keep it quiet when we’re open for business. And don’t let it roam downstairs, or I’ll toss it out. Oh, and I’m not gonna take care of it. That’s all on you.

text.Morgana: He seemed pretty understanding for someone who keeps you cramped up in this dump. Then again, I suppose to normal people I just sound like a meowing cat.

text.Sojiro Sakura: Make sure you wash that dish. By the way ...  have you decided on a name?

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Sojiro Sakura: Morgana? Huh ...  I was hoping I’d get to name it.

text.Morgana: And to be honest, this place is heaven compared to Kamoshida’s cells. ...Remember how you guys asked me before about what I am? To be honest ...  I don’t remember anything about my birth. I think the Metaverse’s distortions made me lose both my memories and my true form.

I already told you! I’m an honest-to-god human! If I were originally just a cat, how could I talk!? It doesn’t make any sense! There’s no doubt that the distortions were what caused me to lose my real self. I’m sure that once they’re purged, I’ll finally be able to get that self back. And I have a pretty good idea on how to do it too. That’s why I was in the castle in the first place.
Let me make myself clear: Your taking care of me won’t be for nothing. It’ll be give and take. Due to my knowledgeable and dexterous nature, I have a lot of intel on infiltration tools.
Whoa, I can’t tell you more unless we settle on a deal. In exchange for you keeping me here, I’ll teach you about these tools. How does that sound?

text.ACTION: Still not too jazzed about living with this smug cat but I’ll take what I can get.

text.Morgana: I take it that means you accept?

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Morgana: Hehehe ...  Then it’s a deal.

text.Joker: Morgana seems rather happy...

text.Sae Niijima: There’s even the possibility that you used special tools and had someone who manufactured them ...  ...Answer me!

text.ACTION: The Magician Arcana represents action or skill, but also trickery and manipulation. It’s generally associated with the beginnings of journeys, which is why it’s typically the Arcana of Your Dumb Friend Who Doesn’t Know Anything in 3 and 4.
Morgana gives us the ability to craft infiltration tools, which are items that will help us out within dungeons.

text.Morgana: By the way, the power you used in the Palace was seriously amazing. The stronger that power gets, the more reliable it’ll be as a trump card. All right, I’m gonna stick with you wherever you go from today on. Personas are the strength born from one’s heart. Depending on what kind of life experience you gain, I bet it’ll affect that power as well!
And if you become acquainted with capable people, you might learn various, useful skills too ...  This is all part of our deal, got it?
I expect great things from you. Don’t let me down, OK?

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Morgana: Getting around in cat form sounds pretty inconvenient, though ...  Well, it is what it is. I’ll just have to deal with being carried in that bag of yours.

text.Ann Takamaki: I can’t. Anyway, I wanted to let you know at least. See you tomorrow.

text.Morgana: You guys send messages to each other with that thing, right? I want in too, so I’m gonna have to ask you to type for me. At any rate ...  Is this really a place for someone to live in?

text.ACTION: In addition to sitting on the couch, we can also talk to Morgana for some more flavor text related to what we’re currently doing.

text.Joker: Is this the stress of Kamoshida’s threat weighing on me ... ?

text.Morgana: ... .. While we’re riding the train, we’ve got some downtime. I wonder if we could put it to good use...

text.Ill-looking Girl: I haven’t been feeling well lately. My head’s all foggy, and I have no energy ...  I’ve tried every drug at the pharmacy, but nothing works. Do I have some new virus? ...Is this the onset of a psychotic breakdown? Wh-What should I do? Am I going to die!?

text.Concerned Girl: Calm down, calm down! Let’s go to the clinic. Come on. I’m sure the doctor can prescribe something that’ll fix you right up!

text.Morgana: Doctors have the best medicine, huh ...  Hey, wasn’t that one customer back at Leblanc a doctor?
That’s not what’s important here! Though she did have an interesting fashion sense ...  Anyway, it might be nice to have some strong medicine to use in the palace...

text.Ann Takamaki: Don’t text now. We’re in class.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Whoa! You mean you’re actually listening to all this crap?

text.Ann Takamaki: Yeah, but none of it is really sticking today...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I know, right? Anyways, hideout after school?

text.Ann Takamaki: Where exactly is this "hideout"?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The school roof.

text.Ann Takamaki: Wait, we can still go up there?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I’m gonna fine you if you’re late!

text.Ushimaru: You! Pay attention! Is that how you listen when someone’s talking to you!?

text.Joker: I feel a murderous intent ... !

text.ACTION: Mr. Ushimaru throws a piece of chalk that hits Maaku square in the forehead.

text.Girl 6: Ooh ...  That looked like it hurt.

text.Boy 5: (snicker) He hit him right in the forehead...

text.Ushimaru: That’s what you get for daydreaming! Kids these days have no respect for their elders.

text.Morgana: Good grief ...  Looks like you need more Proficiency to completely dodge that.

text.ACTION: Considering that we haven’t seen even a single opportunity to raise Proficiency at this point, that check is unwinnable. It’s entirely meant for New Game +, and even then it just gives you Charm, making it kind of pointless at that stage.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Mkay, let’s get goin’!

text.Morgana: Hold on, it’s still too early for us to head to the Palace.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: But why? Don’t we just gotta steal that Treasure thing?

text.Morgana: Don’t underestimate the dangers of that place. We need to prepare.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Ain’t that Persona shit we got enough to deal with it?

text.Morgana: That’s exactly what I mean when I say don’t underestimate it. You’ll die if you mess up in there. So again, we need to prepare before we head in.

text.Ann Takamaki: But ...  how exactly are we supposed to do that?

text.Morgana: I’m glad you asked, Lady Ann. First, we’ll need to find better equipment for all of you.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You talkin’ about weapons? I know a kick-ass place!

text.Morgana: In that case, you can handle that side of things. The only other thing would be stocking up on medicine. Fatigue is unavoidable in a Palace...

text.Ann Takamaki: And where can we get medicine?

text.Morgana: Don’t worry, I know just the place. I hope you look forward to it, Lady Ann! Now then, Maaku and I have some business in Yongen, so let’s head off for today!
Just come with me! I won’t be able to get close enough by myself!
The doctor who prescribes medication after a quick examination? She was sitting at the booth...
I just realized something. If she’s the kind of doctor who gets sketchy rumors like that, maybe she’ll help us out. She’s somewhere in the neighborhood, right? Take me to her.
...Well, I guess that’s the only choice we have. We’ll just have to go for it. All right, let’s step inside.

text.Tae Takemi: Hm? I feel like I’ve seen you somewhere before...
Hmmm ...  Well, whatever ...  So, what are you here for today?
... .. ...Fine. Please head to the exam room.
