text.Ann Takamaki: The day Haru’s going to get sent off is almost here ...  We took the Treasure, so all we have to do is wait. Still, I wish we could do something in the meantime. Why don’t we go to Mementos today?

You have something else to do? Well, I won’t force you. If the president has a change of heart, maybe our reputation will go up and we’ll get more requests. So I want to get the requests we currently have out of the way at least.

text.School Intercom: ...Ahem. Ms. Usami, please come to the faculty office at once.

text.Usami: ...What could it be? ...Everyone, make sure to study on your own while I go to the faculty office.

text.ACTION: How does it take so long to go to the faculty office?
We’ve unfortunately already maxed Kindness, but we need to finish this book anyway.

text.Morgana: Did you want me to call you "Chief" now? I’m just kidding.
Did you learn more about chiefs and their big hearts? Even in the underworld, there’s kindness ...

text.ACTION: Maaku gains Kindness +3, which is really +4 because it’s one of the longer books.

text.Ann Takamaki: Hey, you know how I said I was gonna take the world by storm with my modeling? Well, I was thinking of getting in shape first. And who better to help with that than Ryuji, right? He said he’d be glad to train with me. What about you, Maaku? Do you wanna join us?
All right, let’s go work up a sweat! It’s pretty close by. Oh, and I’ll let Ryuji know.

text.ACTION: Oh shit! A Confidant interaction acknowledged! Perhaps the only time in the entire game that’ll happen!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: It’s pretty sweet, huh? Not too many people gettin’ in your way. Anyways, uh ...  what’re you tryin’ to do here?
Huh. You tried joggin’?

text.Ann Takamaki: Aerobics alone aren’t enough! I want to tone up too, so I need to start lifting weights. Plus my shoulders are drooping, I wanna make my biceps leaner, and I need to straighten my back out!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Uh, what the hell’s that even supposed to mean ... ? Anyways, motivation’s good n’ all, but you’re not gonna be able to move tomorrow if you do all that shit.

text.Ann Takamaki: Then you come up with a training regimen for me.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Ugh, you’re such a pain.

text.ACTION: There are many things I find offputting about this pose, but the one that sticks out right now is the way her hand clips through her sweatpants.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Quit thinkin’ you’re some sexy character in an anime. It’s sad watchin’ you like this.
First off, one of them sexy characters’d never come to the gym in their PE uniform.

text.ACTION: This failed seduction is one of the best character beats in the entire game, and makes me like both characters way more. It’s a shame the animated cutscene leadtime led to Ryuji just being Horny All The Time in those because it’s way more interesting to see him like this, rejecting her attempts to play him because he knows her too well.

text.Ann Takamaki: How am I supposed to know that!? I’ve never even been to the gym before today!
Huh ... ? It fell through? Yeah ...  Uh, I guess that’s OK ...  Mm-hm ...
It was a black-and-white shoot, so they said I wouldn’t stand out. It sounded like fun though. It was about the everyday life of models ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Guess you just gotta find somewhere you do stand out then.

text.Ann Takamaki: Huh ...  There has to be somewhere my vibrant charm will shine, right!?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Uh, where ... ?
Hey, speakin’ of magazines, there was a real pretty girl in that one you said you were starrin’ in. She’s got this innocent vibe, but she’s sexy too. Now that’s what real charm looks like to me.

text.Ann Takamaki: ...Were there photos of me too?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Uh, yeah.

text.Ann Takamaki: ...And did she have long, brown hair?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Yup, that’s the one! You know her!? You gotta introduce me, dude!

text.Ann Takamaki: Of all the girls you could have been talking about, it just HAD to be Mika! Urghhhh, I’m so pissed!
Come on, which machine are we using first!? I’m gonna break it!

text.Joker: The three of us trained until we had reached our limits ...

text.Ann Takamaki: But for some reason ...  I feel ...  satisfied ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That’s what workin’ hard feels like. Not bad, huh?

text.Ann Takamaki: Yeah, that was actually ...  pretty fun. I think it was because the two of you were here with me. I had to prove I was working extra hard.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: It’s simple stuff like that that’ll help you keep pushin’.
Dude, cut me some slack!

text.Ann Takamaki: You thought you were being so cool too ...

text.ACTION: I actually thought it was pretty cool and don’t know why that option was even there, but far be it from me to ignore an opportunity to dunk on Ryuji.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Mom forgot to buy stuff for dinner, so I guess I gotta head home now. Seeya, guys.

text.Ann Takamaki: ...I’m actually a little jealous of the relationship they have.

I mean even growing up, my parents were super busy. They always told me I was strong, that I’d be fine on my own. I was free ...  but I was lonely. I’d make friends, but we moved a lot ...  and every time, I had to start all over again. I actually got used to the loneliness ...  But all that changed once I met Shiho ...  The world seemed so hopeful ...

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Ann Takamaki: I heard her rehab is going well ...  She’s going to be officially transferring schools soon too ...  I need to show her that I’m working hard ...  and that she doesn’t need to worry so much about me.
She needs to see how much I’ve learned from her ... !

text.Joker: I can sense a strong resolve from Ann...

text.Ann Takamaki: Come on, let’s head home. ...I might have trouble moving though. My legs are killing me.
Well, see you later.

text.Haru Okumura: Nothing, unfortunately. Father is still indisposed.

text.Ann Takamaki: How are things with you, Haru? Has anything happened with the media?

text.Futaba Sakura: I hope they haven’t been horrible to you.

text.Haru Okumura: Thank you. They will surely say a great deal about my father, but I am determined to push through it.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Society doesn’t care what may be going on as long as it is enough to kill their perpetual boredom. They don’t even consider how their words may hurt others.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: They think caring about people is someone else’s job. It makes me wanna puke.

text.ACTION: Man, the people we’re doing this all for sure are shitheads!

text.Haru Okumura: There’s nothing we can do about that though. And ...  everything they say about Father is true.

text.Makoto Niijima: But it’s important to remember there was someone else in the shadows behind the shutdowns.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Yeah. It’s gonna be a hella good victory when we expose that criminal for who he really is.

text.Makoto Niijima: We’ll have plenty of time to ask him about it then.

text.Morgana: The one behind the mental shutdowns ...  It has to be someone dangerous. Now that we’re getting closer to the truth, we need to be ready for absolutely anything.

text.Newscaster: The popularity of phantom thieves is as strong as ever. More people are becoming fans every day. Some, however, might be going too far with comments like, "I want them to destroy all evildoers."

text.Morgana: I’m glad that we have fans, but not if they’re genuine fanatics.

text.Hifumi Togo: And so ...  Oh, do you have some time? ...I’m feeling a bit anxious.
Thank you ...  ...After I confessed, I was scorned by the media. I bet everyone wants me to lose. However, I’m not going to give them the satisfaction. I’m going to win ...  with these very hands.
I will! Well, it’s time. I have to go to the venue. You won’t be able to go inside the match room, but you can watch over the internet, if you’d like. Well then, I’m off.

text.ACTION: The men at the table in the background, a journalist and his editor, discuss the match.

text.Shogi Magazine Editor: She’s getting pushed back quite a bit. It’s only a matter of time now ...

text.Joker: Hifumi is biting her lip. She doesn’t seem to be doing so well...

text.ACTION: There’s a large commotion throughout the room.

text.Shogi Magazine Journalist: Perhaps her skills ARE of genuine article?

text.Shogi Magazine Editor: Oh, no, that’s not good. The next move will surely result in checkmate.

text.Joker: Hifumi looks troubled as she’s being pushed around the board ...  She hasn’t made a move ...

text.Shogi Magazine Journalist: I’m thinking "Phony Princess, Real Defeat" as the headline for our next article.

text.Hifumi Togo: It was as if an ant had challenged an elephant. A shogi player should know her limits.
I was so ashamed of myself. I didn’t want to hurt the pieces any longer ...

One must lose with grace ...  With dignity until the very end, as a queen should ...  But I confess I am confused ...  I mean, naturally I am disappointed that I lost ...  ...But I still feel happy ...  as if a demon has been purged from me. The moment I realized that victory was impossible ...  I felt a strange peace. What’s important is what I do from this point on ...  I played so disgracefully in front of you ...  Perhaps you can just view it as an example of what not to do ...  ...And understand that there are times which require one to forfeit with valor and grace.

text.Joker: I feel Hifumi’s trust in me ...

text.ACTION: Touryou lets us instantly escape any normal battle. We already had the ability from an earlier skill of Hifumi’s to escape from ambushes instantly, but this extends that to everything. It’s useful even if you’ll pretty much never run from a fight, especially at this late stage of the game.

text.Hifumi Togo: Um, I’ve been thinking about this for a while ...  Let’s make today your last lesson ...
Spending time with me has only brought you pain ...

text.Joker: Hifumi is thinking hard...

text.ACTION: This message appears when we arrive at a crucial dialogue option. I’m sure you all know what I mean by “crucial”: girlfriend time. During each Rank 9 Confidant event with a romanceable Confidant, we may get this popup, meaning we have to pick the right option or set of options to start dating that girl. We didn’t see it with Kawakami last update because I decided not to even entertain that option and picked a choice that bypassed the process entirely. Also, yes, Kawakami was dateable, fuck me.

text.Hifumi Togo: ...So this is goodbye.

text.ACTION: ...Shame we won’t be picking her romance option. Part of me wishes Hifumi had actually won, but it seems it was not to be.

text.Hifumi Togo: The things you say sometimes ...  Perhaps I should take a lesson from that ambitious nature of yours ...

text.ACTION:
Part 128: 10/6-10/8: The Hero Yuuki Mishima
	Part 120: 10/6-10/8: The Hero Yuuki Mishima
I actually fucked up here by not immediately purchasing the next book from Jinbocho, so we go for Cry of Cthulhu to compensate.

text.Morgana: This is very detailed for a story about a fantasy world ...

text.Inui: Having executed the royalty, the revolutionaries proceeded to take the courts under their control ...  All who opposed the revolution were executed. However, the revolutionaries, too, were then reviled as depots and executed by the public. All in all, more than two thousand nine hundred people were executed over the course of the revolution. The fac that this many executions were possible was actually due to one specific invention. Hamiru-kun. Take a look at this.

text.ACTION: This might be my pick for easiest question in the game. You don’t have to know any metaphors or anything, just what that thing Caroline and Justine use to fuse Personas is.

text.Inui: That’s correct. By the way, the name "guillotine" comes from Joseph-Ignace Guillotin, the doctor who proposed the idea.
It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that it embodied the French spirit of equality.
Revolution is sometimes a bloody thing ...  The revolutionaries that rose up for freedom became despots themselves ...  It’s a common tale.

text.Morgana: Our social reform doesn’t hurt anybody in the real world ...  It’s a bloodless revolution!

text.ACTION: And it will all go perfectly as a result!
We already have max Charm, so this book won’t really help us. We still buy it, though. We want the one available after it.

text.Shinya Oda: After our training, I want to talk about the rumors surrounding Takekuma.
I mean, I couldn’t do anything to him ...  There’s just no way.

text.ACTION: It is pretty weird that this kid couldn’t even seem to hit Takekuma, but there’s plenty of reasonable explanations for that. Still, let’s play along.

text.Shinya Oda: I’ve been practicing a lot, after all. I’ve heard rumors about Takekuma! People say he uses cheat armor! You know what that is, right? He totally broke the rules by equipping it ...  I bet that’s why my usual shots didn’t work against him! That has to be the reason! But the next time we play ...  I’m definitely ...
I’m gonna win next time! Just watch! The thing is ...  I told my mom about what happened with Takekuma ...  But ...
She didn’t ...  really care. All she said was, "OK."

text.ACTION: Well, to be fair to her, most parents don’t really give two shits about the video games their children play.

text.Shinya Oda: It’s probably because I lost ...  She doesn’t like kids who lose.

My mom once told me that ...  We need to be strong, because it’s just the two of us. She said no one helps the weak. They just get preyed on ...  That’s why I wanna get stronger. Strong enough that we won’t get preyed on ...  Strong enough that WE’D be the predators ...

That’s exactly who the Phantom Thieves are ...  the strongest ...  who can prey on anyone. Once I become the strongest, my mom will be able to count on me ...  The only way I can win is through games ...  That’s why I can’t lose.  ...  ...  What should I do about Takekuma’s armor ... ? The strategy I used last time didn’t work ...
...Thanks. ...You’re kinda like a big brother to me. I can talk to you about anything ...  I heard that that’s what it’s like to have a sibling ...

text.Joker: I feel Shinya’s brotherly affection...

text.ACTION: This one is straight-up incredible. It increases everyone’s number of bullets by a hell of a lot:

Maaku goes from 16 bullets to 32.
Ryuji goes from 8 to 16.
Morgana goes from 15 to 25.
Ann goes from 36 to 60.
Yusuke goes from 24 to 48.
Makoto goes from 12 to 24.
Haru goes from 6 to 12.

Now, it doesn’t improve anyone’s clip sizes, but it’s still really great. We haven’t been using guns too much because they’re honestly kind of lame for anything other than hitting weaknesses, but this is a great excuse to whip them out (uh, phrasing) more often. It’s also a great way to justify using Down Shot more often.

text.Shinya Oda: Takekuma better watch out ...

text.Joker: Interacting with Shinya has made my heart grow ...  I feel like my Kindness has increased ...

text.Shinya Oda: See you later!

text.Newscaster: Today, we take an in-depth look into Kunikazu Okumura, the man who made the chain what it is today. Mr. Okumura is well-connected in various industries, and it’s even rumored he may enter politics.

text.Morgana: The news is talking about Haru’s dad. It seems he’s got influence in all sorts of different areas ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: Ugh, my head hurts ...

text.Joker: Sojiro seems concerned about Futaba’s uncle ...  Is it OK for me to stick my nose into Sojiro’s and Futaba’s problem ... ?

text.ACTION: It’s never stopped you before, man.

text.Sojiro Sakura: ...Hm? You look like you have something to say.
Well, I guess there’s no point in worrying. Help me clean up.

text.ACTION: Whoa, what in the hell are you wearing, young lady!? Cover yourself up, good heavens!

text.Sojiro Sakura: ...How’d you get your hands on this stuff?

text.Futaba Sakura: Hacking, of course! Uncle’s in loads of debt! He’ll never win in a suit against us now that we have all this data!
But ... !

text.Sojiro Sakura: I’ve known all along how badly in debt he is. He’s not gonna try and take custody back, so don’t go doing stupid crap like this, OK?

text.Futaba Sakura: But Sojiro ... ! I-I only did it ‘cause of all that stuff he said to you!

text.Sojiro Sakura: About that ...  I’ve been thinking. When push came to shove, I wasn’t there to help you ...  So, you know ...  maybe there’s somewhere better for you out there ...

text.Futaba Sakura: S-Somewhere better ... ? Am I not supposed to be here ... ? Am I just in the way ... ?
You don’t want me either, Sojiro ... !?

text.Sojiro Sakura: That’s not what I meant! I just think it might be better, for your own sake ...

text.Futaba Sakura: You can just stay here and play with your stupid coffee beans!

text.ACTION: Hey! You get back here and apologize to the coffee beans right now! They are not stupid, and they’ve done nothing to deserve lip from you!

text.Sojiro Sakura: Makes sense though ...  You’re the ones who saved her, after all. ...Where did I go wrong?

I really did try to care for Futaba. ...Look where that got me though. I told myself she was the reason I kept making Wakaba’s curry here ...  but deep down, I think that was just an excuse to stay distant ...  At the end of the day, the coffee and the curry people love so much are both just ...  excuses.
I’m gonna go out for a smoke, try to cool off a bit. Sorry to lay this on you ...  but can you go after Futaba for me?

text.Futaba Sakura: Yeah ...  Thanks ...  Y’know, Mom used to talk about Sojiro tons when I was little. How good he was at making curry, how interesting he was to talk to ...  I remember everything. I even remember how she smiled when she talked about him ...  Mom really liked Sojiro ...   ...  ...  I said some real mean stuff tonight. It’s not his fault Mom’s incident happened ...  It’s not his fault I shut myself away from the world ...  And because of me ...  Sojiro lost a crapton of money ...  I just thought I’d be able to stay here with him if my hacking worked ...
Yeah ...  Yeah, you’re right.
Mm-hm ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: Look, I’m sorry about what I said just now. And well ...  if it’s OK with you ...  I want you to stay here, forever.

text.Futaba Sakura: Forever ...   ...  ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: I know it might be more fun living with people your age like Maaku ...  But I’ll do my damnedest to see things from your perspective. So ...  will you stay with me?
H-Hey ...  Quit your laughing! (sigh) You’re as exhausting as ever.

text.Futaba Sakura: I know I’ve caused you a lot of trouble ...  but I really do wanna be here. So, let’s keep living together.

text.Sojiro Sakura: Futaba ...

text.Futaba Sakura: Sorry for not saying that sooner. Oh, and ...  thanks for taking in someone as horrible as me.

text.Sojiro Sakura: ...Are you sure I’m good enough?

text.Futaba Sakura: I wouldn’t want anyone else.

text.Sojiro Sakura: Heh, no hesitation ...  Don’t come complaining to me if you regret it.  ...  ...  Actually, I’m not gonna let you regret it. If you ever need help, just tell me. I might not be graceful ...  but I’ll be there to protect you. And you can stay with me for as long as you’d like. Forever, if you want.

text.Futaba Sakura: Mm-hm, I will. ...Forever. I can’t wait to keep sorta living with you too, Maaku!

text.ACTION: One big weird fake family we’ve got going on here. It’s fucking great.

text.Futaba Sakura: I’m outta here! Byeee!

text.Sojiro Sakura: I didn’t stand up for Wakaba when I knew something was off ...  and I didn’t stand up for you either.

Instead, I went on and on about how you can’t fight back against the laws of our society ...  How you should just accept the hand you’re dealt in life ...  But those were mere excuses I made to keep myself in line. They gave me the easy way out I wanted so badly ...  ...Maybe instead of all that coffee crap, I should’ve been teaching you not to make the same mistakes I did. There I go, ranting again. But ...  I feel like I managed to put a lot behind me today. ...Thanks, for making me realize what’s really important in life.

text.Joker: I feel like my bond with Sojiro is growing deeper...

text.Sojiro Sakura: All right, I better head home too. Don’t stay up too late, OK? I don’t want you oversleeping.

text.ACTION: And that’s one of my favorite Confidant events in the entire game. Except for this part:

text.Joker: I can see the compassion hidden beneath Sojiro’s actions ...  I feel my Kindness growing ...

text.ACTION: Motherfucker, I needed max Kindness just to get here. Maaku gains Kindness +3.

text.Chatter: Really though, who are they?

text.Whisper: If I met them, it would be love at first sight!

text.Murmur: What are they waiting for? Hurry up and do it already!

text.Whisper: Heroes have an obligation to rescue the weak.

text.Tae Takemi: It’s easy to get sick in that in-between period as the seasons change, so be careful. You came because you saw my messages, right?
I’ve made progress with the medicine. Could you tag along for a bit?
I’m going to meet someone at Inokashira Park. It’s close, right? Let’s go.
Let me know if you need anything else.

text.Miwa-Chan's Physician: Based on what I read in the findings summary you sent me, the results are truly amazing. We’ll perform one final exam with our equipment and we’ll be ready to treat Miwa-chan with it.

text.Tae Takemi: ...Excellent. Then the rest is up to you.

text.Miwa-Chan's Physician: So, this is the kid from your study, hm?

text.Tae Takemi: Yes, he’s my little guinea pig.

text.ACTION: Still sends a chill down my spine even after all this time.

text.Miwa-Chan's Physician: You certainly walked a dangerous line, but I’m sure you implemented the strictest of safety protocols.

text.ACTION: I passed out several times, dog!

text.Miwa-Chan's Physician: Please put some thought into the offer we discussed, will you ... ? All right, I’ll call you later.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: All I did was add some ...  how do I put it ...  aesthetic simplicity by balancing the color placement. Furthermore, Haru chose the flowers herself. It will surely be a great bed no matter the arrangement.

text.Makoto Niijima: Hm, I’m looking forward to it.

text.Futaba Sakura: Why don’t we plant you, Mona?

text.ACTION: It’s cloudy, Morgana. That wouldn’t work!

text.Ann Takamaki: That’s not gonna make a difference!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey, y’know how we’re thinkin’ of the school festival as our celebration party? Anyone else think we should have a real celebration on top of that?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I must agree. It would be not only a celebration, but a welcoming as well. I’d like to do something among ourselves.

text.Ann Takamaki: Let’s do it then! A joint party to celebrate and to welcome Haru!

text.Haru Okumura: Oh, you don’t have to do that. The school festival is more than enough.

text.Morgana: How is everyone else supposed to get excited if the star of the party’s not into it?

text.Haru Okumura: Well then ...  how about a night party? At Destinyland.

text.ACTION: Now, this is an obvious riff on Disneyland (specifically Tokyo Disneyland), but Destinyland actually has some history. In the very first Shin Megami Tensei, Destinyland is where the alignment lock occurred.
Also Makoto’s dialogue here is incredibly awkward and stiff. It’s like she turned into a five-year-old upon hearing about this theme park.

text.Haru Okumura: It would be a bit late, but there are someplans that allow us to rent out the park for the night.

text.Ann Takamaki: You’re talking about THE Destinyland, right ... ?

text.Haru Okumura: Didn’t you say you’d like to do something amongst ourselves ... ?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I did, but ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The heck’s she gonna check?

text.Ann Takamaki: We’re really gonna have it at Destinyland ... ? Not like, one of the restaurants, but ...  the entire park?

text.Futaba Sakura: Even just for one night ...  the price is insane ...

text.Haru Okumura: Oh, that won’t be a problem. We had originally booked it for a company party, then had to call it off because of the scandal ...

text.ACTION: What kind of company party books an amusement park?

text.Haru Okumura: We’d barely get anything back if we canceled the reservation, so why not take advantage of it?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Wouldn’t that be oddly conspicuous though?

text.Haru Okumura: It’s still officially under the company’s name. We needn’t worry.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: In that case ...  let’s do this. We’ll just celebrate twice as hard today!

text.Haru Okumura: I’m sorry for disrupting everyone. You did come to help me, after all. Well, let’s get back to it!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: For real!?

text.Joker: It seems like we’ll be having our celebration at Destinyland tonight ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: The food was arranged on my plate as though it were paint on a canvas.

text.ACTION: Oh god, half the cast’s got weird novelty headgear.

text.Haru Okumura: I thought if we were going to dine together, it would be better to do it somewhere with a view.

text.Ann Takamaki: The VIP life is incredible! Not that I’d expect anything else from a private rental!

text.Makoto Niijima: There really is no one else here.

text.Futaba Sakura: We are the rulers of the kingdom of dreams!

text.Haru Okumura: That’s right.

text.Futaba Sakura: That’s the kinda stuff couples say, right?

text.Ann Takamaki: Almost anyone would fall for that line in front of a sight like this!

text.Morgana: Lady Ann, this view is not as beautiful as--

text.ACTION: Oh, too bad, cat. You missed your chance. Better luck next time.

text.Ann Takamaki: You say that like you’re not tapping into your inner child too, Ryuji.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: This is just ‘cause Futaba kept naggin’ me to put ‘em on!

text.Futaba Sakura: I did not!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...You said somethin’ like that!
What was that!?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: (chuckle) My, this is so heartwarming ... !

text.Haru Okumura: Honestly, I would’ve liked to see the parade as well. But given how sudden the request was, they couldn’t get enough staff together to do it.

text.Makoto Niijima: Perhaps that will have to wait until next time.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Either way, this party’s totally the best one so far! It’s freakin’ amazing!

text.Haru Okumura: I’m glad to see you’re enjoying it.

text.Morgana: Be careful, Haru. You’ve shown these guys what luxury means. This’ll really raise the bar for our next celebration party.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: You’re already talking about our next party? Don’t you think that’s somewhat premature?

text.Haru Okumura: Still ...  How do I put this ... ? I met Mona-chan, I got to know you all ...  Isn’t everything going a little too perfectly? It’s actually a bit frightening ...

text.Morgana: You worry too much.

text.Haru Okumura: ... I must just be overly cautious because of my circumstances up till recently. I’m sorry for bringing it up.
Father ...

text.Kunikazu Okumura: Today, I’d like to elaborate upon the whole truth behind my company’s labor situation.

text.ACTION: Sanitation? That’s not even one of the things we heard about!

text.Kunikazu Okumura: And how my corporation acted as a whole to ...  cover up every facet of this scandal. For all of this, I wholeheartedly apologize.

text.Calm Journalist: Furthermore, these happened to be officials who stood against your proposal for overseas expansion. The same thing also happened to executives at competing companies who were looking to expand abroad. Is all of this true?

text.Morgana: Okumura’s going to say who’s really behind the mental shutdowns.

text.ACTION:
Part 130: 10/11-10/12: The Foregone Conclusion
	Part 122: 10/11-10/12: The Foregone Conclusion
When last we left off, Okumura finally bit it like two full weeks after his Shadow died, goddamn.
Good to see in this shocking, heartbreaking scene that our cast is still wearing the fucking animal ears.

text.Ann Takamaki: Wh-Why did he collapse?

text.Makoto Niijima: That didn’t look right at all ...  Don’t tell me...!

text.Haru Okumura: Mona-chan, what’s going on ... ?

text.Morgana: No ...  That’s impossible!
I want to know that myself! We made sure we just took the Treasure too ...

text.Haru Okumura: (gasp) I should call home!

text.Ann Takamaki: This-- This isn’t our fault ...  is it? It’s been OK all four times so far—ever since Kamoshida!

text.Makoto Niijima: If we let the Shadow live, the real person won’t undergo mental shutdown ...  right?

text.Morgana: That’s how it should work ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Yeah ...  it’s gotta be.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: What’s wrong?

text.Futaba Sakura: I remember now ...  It’s just like ...  what happened to my mom ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: So this is the moment when mental shutdown occurs ...

text.Makoto Niijima: But why did they target Okumura-san ... ?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dammit! The hell’s goin’ on here!?

text.Haru Okumura: I’ll talk to the staff before I leave. Feel free to take your time ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: This ain’t our fault, right ... ?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I’d like to think so ...

text.Ann Takamaki: Some welcoming party, huh ...

text.Makoto Niijima: I’ll get in contact with Haru later. But for today, I think we should all return home.

text.Goro Akechi: What are you watching?

text.Sae Niijima: This is just a hypothesis ...  But perhaps Okumura was bitten by his lapdog.

text.Goro Akechi: Are you implying that the Phantom Thieves triggered a sudden mental shutdown on Okumura?

text.Sae Niijima: There might have been a falling out of sorts, so the Phantom Thieves abandoned a useless employer. ...And to cover their tracks, they dealt with Okumura.

text.Goro Akechi: I hate to bring this up, but I’m actually here about that.

text.Sae Niijima: Did you find any evidence?

text.ACTION: Aww, Akechi believes in us! Well, sort of! Whatever!

text.Sae Niijima: How do you mean? You were suspecting the Phantom Thieves as well.

text.Goro Akechi: It is still hypothetical at this point ...  but I don’t want to rule it out.

text.Sae Niijima: We’re searching the Okumura residence tomorrow. Same with Shujin and its principal. We will find evidence on this ...  no matter what it takes.

text.Goro Akechi: Yes?

text.Sae Niijima: ...You haven’t looked at my laptop or taken files from it without my permission, have you?

text.ACTION: Uh-oh, looks like Makoto fucked up somehow.

text.Goro Akechi: That’s quite out of the blue.

text.Sae Niijima: There were traces that someone transferred data from it. It was only a small error pop-up ...  But I noticed it immediately after I had that argument with you last month.

text.Goro Akechi: And that’s why you suspect me ... ? Oh please, give me a break.

text.Sae Niijima: Are you saying you didn’t?

text.Goro Akechi: As a detective myself, I honor the value of information—as well as the effort invested in it.

text.ACTION: For someone who values information so much you’d think you’d be better at conveying it in a reasonable way. Jesus christ, this argument is stilted.

text.Goro Akechi: I take pride in what I do. I thought you of all people would understand such values, Sae-san.

text.Sae Niijima: ...I apologize.
I let my guard down. They’re mine ...  I’m the one who will catch them ... !

text.Whisper: Did you see? He collapsed during the interview ...  This is serious!
That was gruesome ...  Wish they put some sort of warning on the video.

text.Murmur: They said President Okumura died!
Really!? Whoa, you’re right! I just saw a news report about it!

text.Anon: Too bad! It had to happen
good shit for us plebs lol
That was all an act, right?

text.Ann Takamaki: The news said it was a cardiac arrest ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: There’s a chance he’ll pull through, right ... ?

text.Makoto Niijima: I hate to say this ...  But usually after such a report, the only thing that follows is a confirmation of death ...

text.Futaba Sakura: Haru ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Why is this happening!? Can someone die simply from having a mental shutdown!?

text.Makoto Niijima: I don’t know! I suppose it’s possible that the shock could kill a person ...  Haru did mention how her father wasn’t in the best of health ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: But ...  for him to just up and die? This has gotta be some kinda joke ...

text.Futaba Sakura: Haru ... !

text.ACTION: Futaba, you gonna say anything other than Haru’s name?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: ...Are we responsible for his death?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: But I thought it was supposed to be fine as long as we didn’t kill their Shadow! Ain’t that what you said, Morgana!?

text.Morgana: It should’ve been OK!

text.ACTION: Well, it wasn’t! It was very much not!

text.Morgana: It ...  should’ve been ...

text.ACTION: Great, the cat’s not even sure anymore.

text.Ann Takamaki: We did everything the same as always too ...

text.Makoto Niijima: In any case, let’s compose ourselves for now. We need to act normally in public. But keep Haru in our minds ...

text.Morgana: Dammit, this doesn’t make any sense ...  Why he suffered a mental shutdown is one thing ...  But what are we supposed to do from here on out ... ?

text.Newscaster: The president of Okumura Foods collapsed during his conference and was taken to the hospital. However, we just received confirmation that he passed away. Truly a shocking turn of events.

text.Morgana: I can’t believe he died ...

text.Justine: Our master has an important matter to discuss with you. Heed his words well.

text.Igor: ...Or so I’d like to say, but something odd seems to have happened.

text.COMMENT: Protag: Oh god, Igor, we fucked up big time, man. We need a place to lie low for a while, you dig?
Igor: Yeah, you really botched that one, my dude.

text.Igor: Who knows ... ? However, don’t you sense it? The malicious will of another ...  It seems a contingency has occurred.

text.ACTION: Why does everyone in this game talk like a fortune cookie?

text.Igor: At this rate, your rehabilitation cannot be completed ...  though I doubt that will be the case. I truly look forward to seeing how you overcome this predicament ...

text.Joker: I feel like my bond with Igor is growing deeper...

text.Igor: ...We shall meet again.

text.Caroline: Time’s up, Inmate! Hurry up and return to your world!

text.ACTION: And our approval went down, but that’s kind of to be expected, isn’t it?

text.Energetic-Looking Guy: He collapsed during his press conference, right? I wish I’d been watching when it happened.

text.Dissatisfied First-Year: You’re probably better off. It was a total disaster. I never imagined seeing a heart attack would be so unsettling ...

text.Energetic-Looking Guy: The news says it was because of illness, but either way you spin it? Still bizarre. Damn. Wish I’d seen it live ...

text.Boy 5: Did you see that interview? I thought it was gonna be some hidden-camera show at first.

text.Female Student: I was so scared I changed the channel ...

text.Boy 5: He really looked like he was in pain ...  That was sick.

text.Sadayo Kawakami: Will you quiet down!? We’re in class right now! Not to mention, you have midterms starting on Monday! Focus on studying!

text.Morgana: ...Things are getting pretty bad.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The police? What for?

text.Ann Takamaki: Your sister hasn’t told you about any of this?

text.Makoto Niijima: Nothing at all.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Could this be related to Okumura’s death in some way?

text.Makoto Niijima: But there’s no connection between our school and Okumura Foods.

text.Futaba Sakura: Think they came to talk to Haru?

text.Makoto Niijima: She’s ...  absent today.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Then seriously, what’re they here for?

text.Makoto Niijima: I can’t even begin to fathom the reason. Anyway. let’s be particularly careful not to stand out. And head straight home once school ends. Understand that, everyone?

text.Sae Niijima: I see.

text.Tired Investigator: We were hoping to find something more than the calling card too.

text.Sae Niijima: We’ve confirmed the victim’s connection to the Phantom Thieves at least.

text.ACTION: I’d have assumed Okumura would have already turned the calling card over to the police, but whatever.

text.Sae Niijima: Thank you for your cooperation.
Yes ... !

text.Haru Okumura: That’s right ...

text.Sae Niijima: Please contact me if something catches your attention. It doesn’t matter how trivial it seems. ...You don’t have to force yourself though. Just anything that comes to mind.
And even the death of Shujin’s principal, who we found a calling card for, was the work of another?

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Sae Niijima: (sigh) You don’t sound like you’re lying ...  If you wanted to deceive me, you could’ve easily woven up a much simpler lie than this "Metaverse." Moreover, your account coincides with my own investigation. Is that even possible if it were made up? And I hate to admit, but ...  with my line of work, I know a false testimony when I hear one. Still, if you set your sights on Okumura based on my intel, it’d be before his name was even ranked. You could’ve ignored him and targeted some other famous person. Why would you go so far as to further investigate and pursue this criminal?
Heh ...  simple enough. There’s still no proof that another suspect exists. That said, it’s safe enough to say that you aren’t the murdering type.

text.ACTION: Is it really? That’s kind of a big leap there, Sae.

text.Joker: I feel like my bond with Sae is growing deeper...

text.Sae Niijima: Pressed to prove your innocence, your next objective was ...

text.Joker: (shakes head)

text.Sae Niijima: What in the world did the police inject into you?
Maaku Hamiru! You need to stay focused!
If what you’re saying is true, you must tell your side of the story to the end. We’ll both be in trouble if your testimony becomes unreliable.

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Sae Niijima: (sigh)
At last we arrive at your most recent crime.
You know what I mean, don’t you? This calling card was delivered to your latest target—the one you had decided would prove your innocence.
Now, explain everything to me.

text.ACTION: Maaku, do you just spend all your unoccupied time sitting on your bed staring at Morgana until someone texts you? That’s kinda weird, man.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: No luck here.

text.Ann Takamaki: Me neither.

text.Futaba Sakura: She won’t pick up.

text.ACTION: I mean, if you were her, would you trust us right now? We might have killed her dad, and unbeknownst to all of us she now thinks we murdered the principal too.

text.Makoto Niijima: It doesn’t look like she’s seen any of our chats either.

text.Ann Takamaki: I’m worried about her ...

text.Morgana: She wouldn’t, right? ...Right?

text.ACTION: I’m surprised the cops aren’t already here, cat.

text.Newscaster: Today, the police investigated President Okumura’s home and other places he visited. They’re looking into whether this was a crime or an accident, but what caused his death is still unknown.

text.Morgana: Sounds like the police even went to your school ...  What are they going to do?

text.Murmur: Is there an illness that could cause that ... ?

text.Whisper: Nah, no way ...
So it was murder? That’s terrifying ...

text.Murmur: This might be the biggest event of the century!

text.Anon: That was all an act, right?

text.ACTION: We’re dropping precipitously at this rate...
Maaku, you need to get dressed, buddy! You have school today!

text.Haru Okumura: Yes ...  Thank you. Um, there’s actually something that’s caught my attention. I think I need to discuss it with everyone though. We should meet at the hideout after school.

text.Morgana: It looks like Haru is managing ...  somehow. All right, let’s meet up with everyone after school.

text.Whisper: But that was a live broadcast, wasn’t it?
If it wasn’t an illness ...  then it has to be murder!

text.Chatter: Didn’t he kinda deserve to die anyway?

text.Whisper: Still, I feel bad for him, going out like that ...

text.SIU Director: The public has praised them as "allies of justice," before they strike them back to the ground ...  Now then, she’ll be next ...

It will be a heavy responsibility, but I’m certain it’d be an honor for her. The culprits behind the mental shutdown cases she’s been pursuing all this time ...  ...Haha, indeed. They’ll become the criminals we’ve set them up to be ...  just as you instructed.

text.ACTION: There’s a muffled-yet-loud voice coming from outside, seemingly that of a man giving a speech.
Summoning the cops to beat our asses down, I assume!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: She’s the one that called us, so she’ll show up eventually.

text.Ann Takamaki: Well, even though things have calmed down, she must be occupied with what happened to her father ...

text.Futaba Sakura: Wh-What’s up?

text.ACTION: Okay, Yusuke’s completely stonefaced for two in a row? That’s funny and weird. Maybe they just forgot to set his reactions properly?
Still, this was inevitable due to the circumstances, we shouldn’t be all that shocked.
Something about his completely deadpan “shocked” face is hilarious.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: So it’s begun already ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What!?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Think about it. The CEO collapsed the way he did, during an apology conference that our group caused.

text.Ann Takamaki: Still ... ! They were raving about us so much ...  and now they just treat us like murderers ... ?

text.Futaba Sakura: What a lightning-fast change of attitude!

text.Makoto Niijima: Calm down. Not everyone is necessarily saying that ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: But there’s no way to vindicate ourselves.  ...  ...

text.Haru Okumura: I’m sorry I’m late. I’m the one who asked you all to make time for me too ...

text.Makoto Niijima: ...My condolences. It must be rough.

text.Haru Okumura: I’m OK now.
Did you all target the principal?

text.ACTION: Yusuke, man, react to something here, you’re freaking me out!

text.Ann Takamaki: Huh? The principal? ...You mean ours?

text.Haru Okumura: Yes.

text.Morgana: What makes you say that?

text.Haru Okumura: Yesterday, a public prosecutor came to my home. Um ...  it was a woman named ...  Niijima-san.

text.Makoto Niijima: That’s--

text.Haru Okumura: I overheard her saying that a calling card was found in the principal’s office. Considering that this was right after what happened ...  It’s got to be Shujin’s.

text.Makoto Niijima: It may just be my imagination ...  But I feel as if ...  things are escalating far too quickly after President Okumura’s incident.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...Whaddya mean?

text.ACTION: It’s Yusuke! Yusuke did it! I don’t know what he did, but it’s the only explanation for why he’s so goddamn chill about all this!

text.Futaba Sakura: That could be ...

text.Ann Takamaki: Then we need to catch them as soon as possible.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Hold a moment. Can we assume we’ve been set up though? We don’t even know their objective.

text.ACTION: I’m going to assume it was “ruin our reputation and prevent Okumura from spilling the beans,” dude. You know, the two direct consequences of his death thus far?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What else are we supposed to do then!?

text.Makoto Niijima: Let’s all calm down for a moment. From what Haru said, even the police are suspecting that the Phantom Thieves are murderers ...  It wouldn’t be wise to carelessly make a move at the moment. We need to act as normal students for now. In addition, we have midterms next week.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Exams? At a time like this ... ? Rgh ...  I envy you, Futaba ...  ...Futaba?

text.ACTION: Everyone turns to look at Futaba.

text.Futaba Sakura: Got something on my mind. Gonna go home and look into it.

text.Makoto Niijima: At any rate, we need to behave and not draw attention to ourselves. Understood?

text.ACTION: For some reason, probably just because she’s not facing the camera, Haru doesn’t nod. Morgana doesn’t either, but he’s a cat.

text.Murmur: They’re heroes! They would never do that!

text.Chatter: I’d be disappointed if they just turned out to be criminals ...

text.Murmur: It has to be some kind of trick! They would never do that!
...I can’t think of any other explanation. That has to be it!

text.Anon: they’re in a tough spot now
we need dox on these guys

text.Morgana: But that’s impossible!

text.Yuuki Mishima: Why are people doubting the Phantom Thieves over what happened to President Okumura?

Yeah, I trust them! Anyway, it seems like everyone’s forgotten all that they’ve done up to this point. That won’t stop me though. I’ll continue cheering them on. Make sure you tell them that! Well, see you later!

text.Morgana: Mishima is a bit narrow-sighted, but he’s a good person deep down. We can’t betray him ...
You have to be kidding me! How could they accuse us of that!?

text.Newscaster: Stock prices are low—it’s almost certain Okumura Foods is pressured to restructure their management. The public is watching to see how they handle the issues Mr. Okumura addressed in his press conference.

text.Morgana: What’s going to happen to Haru’s company? I’m worried about that, too.

text.ACTION:
Part 132: 10/14: Strictly Platonic Massages
	Part 124: 10/14: Strictly Platonic Massages

text.Haru Okumura: I won’t be able to respond for a little while longer.

text.Makoto Niijima: You don’t need to mind us.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: More importantly, are you doing all right?

text.Haru Okumura: I’m more worried about the people at the company, to be honest. It seems everyone’s having difficulty with not only clients, but the press as well. They’re even handling the preparations for my father’s funeral. I just feel so guilty that I’m unable to help out at all ...

text.Makoto Niijima: You shouldn’t. Everyone understands this is a trying time for you.

text.Haru Okumura: Thanks. Talk to you later.

text.Morgana: Bless that girl, worrying about others even at a time like this ...

text.Angry Businessman: Why else would they kill him during a press conference?

text.Angry Parent: I read somewhere that Okumura raised his daughter alone. Maybe he wasn’t a great manager, but as a parent I feel for him ...

text.Angry Businessman: Murdering someone to make a point is textbook terrorism. Like Shido and that Akechi kid say, the Phantom Thieves are a menace.

text.Whisper: It has to be a setup! The Phantom Thieves aren’t like that ...

text.Murmur: They’re not heroes! They’re just criminals!

text.Chatter: I believe in the Phantom Thieves! They wouldn’t do that ...

text.Whisper: I’m really disappointed ...  Were they just lying?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Does anyone have any idea?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Course not.

text.Makoto Niijima: If I were to guess, I would say the culprit behind the mental shutdowns.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wait, how do we even know we got set up to begin with?

text.ACTION: Is Ryuji even paying attention? God damn.

text.Makoto Niijima: They found a calling card in Principal Kobayakawa’s office.

text.Ann Takamaki: Someone else had to have planted that, obviously.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: In the worst case scenario, it’s possible they know our identities.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: How’re we gonna do that though?

text.Makoto Niijima: It looks like our only choice now is to find the true culprit. Although, we don’t have any leads ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dammit, why’s this gotta happen to us ... ?

text.Morgana: We’ll just have to keep laying low and wait. Let’s not do anything conspicuous, OK?

text.Yuuki Mishima: I know it’s been tough after what happened to President Okumura and all ...  But this is the perfect time for smaller changes of heart to restore your reputation. Anyway, here’s the info I have ...  If true, this one is pretty crazy. Apparently an ex-mercenary who works as an assassin is hiding out in the Shibuya underground.

text.ACTION: It’s not… it can’t be!? Our buddy Homeless Man!?

text.COMMENT: https://lparchive.org/Persona-5/Update%20132/23-Homeless_Man.jpg: Never thought you’d have to change my heart, did you sonny? Ohohoho!

text.Yuuki Mishima: Right!? I can’t breathe easy knowing he’s out there. Well, according to the rumors, his name is Yohei Kiritani. I’m pretty scared. I don’t want anything to do with this ...  I’m leaving this to you, #Millennials!

text.Morgana: Mishima really does get some amazing info for us sometimes ...

text.ACTION: I’m starting to wonder how that nerd lovable scamp gets his hands on this information. That guy would probably kill to keep that quiet.

text.Morgana: Our reputation may have taken a hit after Okumura’s death, but we can still prove our justice in Mementos. We should discuss this with everyone when we have time. Oh, and we have to meet up with Haru before we can go in!

text.Energetic Student: They’re murderers! Someone needs to capture them already!

text.Calm Student: We should never have turned our backs on Akechi-kun. All we can do now is ask him for help ...

text.ACTION: It’s a rainy day, so we can’t hang out with anyone at all (besides Takemi, who isn’t ready) or even go to Chihaya to boost a Confidant. So, we decide to go to the hideout for a Mementos visit, because why not?

... Oh, right. Because we actually can’t. See, the "unanimous consent to change a heart" rule is still in effect, and Haru isn’t here. Considering that our number of unconfirmed requests is >0, we can’t go to Mementos until she gets back. The game actually ingeniously uses this against us by enforcing it; Mishima just so happens to give us a text message we can’t ignore with a new request today, meaning it’s impossible to go to Mementos no matter what, even if we’d already confirmed all these other requests before. It’s an interesting way of getting around not having Haru here for story reasons.
So instead, let’s do something we’ve never done before: go to the library and read a book during the day.

text.Joker: I feel a strong bond with Kawakami...

text.ACTION: We’ll go into the perk in a second.

Sadayo Kawakami is… interesting. I’ve made it clear I don’t really care for some of the overtones of this Confidant, but she’s a good character. She’s voiced by Michelle Ruff, who was Yukari in Persona 3, and in this last Confidant rank she really sells this infectious renewed enthusiasm that makes me like the character a lot more.
Ughhhhhh, why is this so sexual!? I turned her down, game! I turned her doooooown!

The massage is actually incredible and most people blitz her Confidant for it ASAP because if you’re going into the Metaverse with any frequency you’re lamenting that lost time. Also worth noting- because Kawakami is no longer a maid, this and all other services from her are now free.

text.Sadayo Kawakami: I don’t want you to flunk your exams. I’m going to go the distance with you!

text.Sick Girl: Really!? Then why did she say that?

text.Tae Takemi: It’s likely because she’s jealous of you. Just be cateful because it might result in pandemonium.
She even comes in on days she doesn’t have to. It appears she’s nearly fully recovered.
Which reminds me, the new medicine will be completed soon.
You’ve been a splendid guinea pig ...  I mean, participant.

text.ACTION: Yep, still gives me the willies, even after all this time.

text.Tae Takemi: So, thanks again. By the way, how have I been doing? Have I been helpful?

text.ACTION: Goddammit, me! I cannot fucking believe we’ve tripled Ryuji’s count for people we accidentally let figure out we’re Phantom Thieves!

So, yeah. If you haven’t figured it out by now, every non-party Confidant ends with the person stating that they’ve realized you’re a Phantom Thief. Really, it just makes Tora that much more impressive because he’s the only one who figures it out without us needing to change anyone’s heart. He’s just that cool.

text.Tae Takemi: ...Come on. You and I both know that you were lying about needing to prepare for the entrance exams.

text.ACTION: No, really! It was for my exa--*snicker*--exams!

text.Tae Takemi: I visited Oyamada in jail. A swing of fortunes like that could only have come at the hands of the Phantom Thieves. And to have it happen when it did ...  Isn’t the only logical conclusion to think that it’s you?

The point is that without you, I wouldn’t have been able to complete my mission. I would’ve never finished the new medicine ...  while I was being deceived by Oyamada. And I would’ve never met any of the townspeople ...
So, I’ll go out on a limb for you. I’ll have even more powerful medicine ready for you ...  I trust that you’ll use them appropriately.

text.Joker: I feel a strong bond with Takemi...

text.ACTION: Resuscitation adds a few new items to the clinic’s selection. They’re great items but they’re also exorbitantly expensive even in comparison to the SP Adhesive 3s, so we’ll go into them some other time.
Takemi is a terrifying human being, but a good character. She’s voiced by Kirsten Potter, who I’ve literally never heard of.

text.Tae Takemi: So you better make some money in the name of "justice."
(giggle) Now, go. Take care.

text.Haru Okumura: But I think I’m going to go back to school, starting tomorrow. I’m sorry for worrying all of you until now.

text.Ann Takamaki: Are you really OK though?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Be sure not to push yourself too hard in this time of grief.

text.Haru Okumura: No, I actually need to push myself. My mind always wanders if I have nothing to do ...

text.Futaba Sakura: Yeah, I totally get you.

text.Haru Okumura: Besides ...  there’s nothing I can do while I’m at home.
Um ...  To be completely honest ...  When I ended up alone ...  I did doubt you all a tiny bit.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: We cannot blame you for that.

text.Haru Okumura: But it’s so horrible for me to doubt you. I mean, I’m the one who asked you all to do this.

text.Makoto Niijima: Your father just passed away, Haru. It’s natural to feel a flood of emotion at such events.

text.Futaba Sakura: Yeah, it’s really hard when you lose someone like that ...

text.Haru Okumura: But I’m OK now. You’ve all helped me out so much.

text.Futaba Sakura: Right back at ya!

text.Haru Okumura: Thank you. Those words are truly reassuring. Well then, I’ll see all of you at school.

text.Morgana: Haru ...  I’m not surprised she seems down. You should keep her in your thoughts, Maaku.
Still, despite how she looks, Haru has quite the backbone. I’m sure she’ll be OK.

text.Sojiro Sakura: You wanna help out?
I’ll make a snack for you. Futaba said she’s coming too.

text.ACTION: Let’s help Sojiro. Now, you may notice that for the last couple of weeks we haven’t been buying any aojiru. Well, there’s a good reason for that: I forgot We don’t really need to anymore. We’ve only got one parameter left to max out, Guts (and while the me playing the game believes us to be pretty close to maxing that out, the me who went back and checked realized we have a lot further to go), so buying into the rotation is just going to be a waste of money most of the time at this point.

text.Futaba Sakura: Hmmmmmm ...  Maybe curry spaghetti! And curry udon! Oh, and curry croquettes, and curry pizza!

text.Sojiro Sakura: You really like curry that much ... ? Well, I guess it’d be pretty easy given the current menu. I’ll give it some thought. How about you? Anything you’d wanna add to the menu?

text.Futaba Sakura: Of course he is! That stuff’s super addicting, man!

text.Sojiro Sakura: ...Leave now, or else I’ll be forced to contact the police. I’m not giving you a penny.

text.Futaba's Uncle: What was that ... ? Quit fucking with me!
Shut your mouth, brat! It’s your fault I’m in this mess!

text.ACTION: Really making a good case here, buddy.

text.Sojiro Sakura: We can take it to court if you really want. Don’t underestimate how hard I’m willing to fight.

text.Futaba's Uncle: What ... !?

text.Sojiro Sakura: Not only do you have massive debt, but I heard you failed in your most recent business venture. How do you think the court would respond if they knew how wasteful you were with your money ... ?

text.Futaba's Uncle: Goddammit ... !

text.Sojiro Sakura: What are you talking about? You clearly fell down on your own.

text.Futaba's Uncle: This cafe’s finished, you hear me!? I won’t let you get away with this!

text.Sojiro Sakura: God damn ...  What a pain in the ass. Don’t you have enough problems already?
Are you OK, Futaba?

text.Futaba Sakura: Mm-hm ...  But Uncle said he’s gonna sue ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: Don’t worry ...  No matter what ends up happening to me or this store, I won’t let them lay a finger on you two. I’m your guardian, after all. I have a duty to protect the both of you. So don’t go doing anything like that again, you hear? I appreciate the spirit you showed though.

text.Joker: I feel like my bond with Sojiro is growing deeper...

text.Sojiro Sakura: Anyway, I’m done for the day. Take care of closing up for me. Let’s go, Futaba.

text.Futaba Sakura: I’ll message you later ...
I looked up my uncle’s name in Mementos ...

Really!? Thanks a bunch! My uncle’s name is Youji Isshiki. Let’s go to Mementos and change his heart. But, uh ...  I have a favor to ask. I don’t really wanna tell everybody about the time I spent living with him ...  Maybe someday, sure ...  but today’s not that day. So I was thinking ...  can we maybe go just the two of us? I really need your help here, Maaku! Pleeeeeeeeeeeease!

text.ACTION: This kinda breaks the whole “unanimous consent” thing… but what the hell. Anything for family.

text.Joker: I need to take care of Futaba’s uncle and help Sojiro ...

text.Anon: tbh i just wanna troll, lol
p quick to switch sides lol
There was no need to kill.

text.Procrastinating Girl: At least the school festival’s soon. It’s the thing I’m looking forward to most right now ...

text.Calm Girl: Yeah, but ...  Are they still going to hold it? It might get canceled ...

text.Procrastinating Girl: Don’t say that! You’re bummin’ me out before the exams ...  Things are bad enough as is. If they cancel the festival, the students will riot!

text.ACTION: I’d explain what the culture festival is, but all of you have definitely been exposed to enough anime (read: any) that I don’t actually need to.

text.Chatter: Did you hear those rumors?

text.Murmur: I wonder if they really are from our school ...
Really? No way ...

text.Whisper: But what if ...

text.Excited Student: I thought they were gonna change that CEO’s heart ...  but they ended up killing him instead.

text.Boy 6: Haven’t people been saying they killed Principal Kobayakawa too? I thought they were bad, but I never expected they’d turn out to be murderers ...

text.Excited Student: Oh man, does this mean anyone who gets targeted is screwed!?

text.Morgana: That sounds about right.
This looks tough, but let’s calm down and think it through.
First of all, who proposed the idea of the guillotine?
Yeah! I think he was named Joseph-Ignace Guillotin. So, from his perspective, what was the advantage of the guillotine?
There were thousands of people executed during the Revolution ...  Looks like ...  "they needed a method of execution that was quick and impartial." You finished in time!

text.Thieves-loving Student: That doesn’t mean that criminals should be left to do whatever they want ...

text.Bandwagoning Student: Still, couldn’t they have at least left the principal to the police? And I mean, did you see that press conference? No way allies of justice would do that.

text.Thieves-loving Student: I wonder if Akechi-kun has been right all along ...

text.Bandwagoning Student: He’s so admirable, sticking to his guns even though so many people were against him.

text.Morgana: That sounds about right.
That sounds about right.

text.Obsessive Female Student: Isn’t this insane!? There are murderers among us!

text.Chatty Female Student: Now that you mention it, there was a guy in Shibuya who told me he’s a Phantom Thief the other day.

text.Obsessive Female Student: For real!? You gotta report that.

text.Chatty Female Student: Oh crap, you think so? I snapped a pic, so I should probably put it online just in case. I hope the cops catch him!

text.Morgana: That sounds about right.
That sounds about right.

text.Anon: meh i dun care either way

text.Morgana: Well, it shouldn’t be a problem for you. This has been so easy I might start yawning.  ...  ...  You did perfectly. I can’t wait to see your score.

text.ACTION:
Part 135: 10/20-10/22: From Bad To Worse
	Part 127: 10/20-10/22: From Bad To Worse
Well, exams are done, time to rela--

text.Boy 5: Yeah, seems like it’s for real this time. Apparently one of our students is a Phantom Thief.
I read the same thing online. Apparently Public Security is already on the move ...

text.Futaba Sakura: There’s something I want to talk to everyone about. I’ll be at the hideout ...  I mean, our place.

text.Haru Okumura: There’s still some time until we meet though, so I am going to go take care of my flowers first. See you later.

text.Morgana: I suppose plants do need watering, after all ...  Ah, I know. You should go help Haru, Maaku. I’ll let the others know.

text.Haru Okumura: You, um ...  heard that, didn’t you? I’m not worried about the garden, in case you were wondering. It’s just ...  so much has happened to me lately.

...  ...  Well, perhaps I could share this with you ...  I mean, it would be nice to have someone who is aware of my current situation in life. The source of my worries is my father’s company. Dealing with the aftermath has been ...  difficult ...  Given how unexpected the accident was, my father didn’t have a will. All of his stocks transferred to me ...  Which means suddenly, I’m the biggest shareholder in a company of over one thousand employees. But ...  I don’t know the first thing about business direction or fund management ...

text.ACTION: Sounds like a B-tier Disney Channel sitcom.

text.Haru Okumura: I am. Sorry, I didn’t mean to worry you. It’s just ...  I know I’m the president’s daughter, but I never thoughts I’d actually end up involved in company business ...  Because of that, I’ve been meeting with all the various officers and lawyers my father employed lately. They’ve been giving me advice on all the things I’m not entirely sure about. Assets, stocks ...  (shakes head) It’s clear some people only want to get on my good side though. I don’t know who I can trust ...  They try to sound comforting by saying things like "don’t worry," or "leave it to me," but ...  It feels like they’re really only being nice so they can get their hands on my bank account. I ...  I never realized I could be this distrustful of other people ...

Ah, I’m sorry for ranting on about this matter. I feel as though doing so has helped me calm down a bit though. The only people I’ve consulted up to this point have been employees ...  But I think what I really needed was someone closer to my own age ...  closer to my own viewpoint.  ...  ...  Um ...  if it isn’t too much trouble, could we speak about this again some other time?

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Haru Okumura: In return, I’ll ...  Hm ...  What can I do to help you ... ? I don’t have any unique talents ...

How about this? You know, gardening. I’m actually quite skilled at it. A few years ago I even managed to grow a tropical fruit on the balcony at my house ...  To be honest ...  this is what I do when I’m alone to take my mind off of everything that’s happened ...   ...  ...  Oh, that’s right. I stored some vegetables in the refrigerator down in the home economics room. ...You still have some time, yes? Would you mind waiting here a moment?
There’s not much consistency to their colors or shapes, but ...
(giggle) You like vegetables, Maaku-kun? That’s good to know. ...But to tell the truth, I have a favor to ask of you.
I’d like to get Sakura-san’s opinion on my vegetables.

text.ACTION: Have you even met Sojiro? I mean, I guess you must have talked to him once or twice on the way to the hideout, but we never saw any of that.

text.Haru Okumura: Do you think I could bring my next harvest over to your cafe?
Thank you. I’m sure Sakura-san will give me his honest opinion. I’ll make sure this next harvest is particularly good.

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Haru Okumura: Well then, shall we head over to the hideout?

text.ACTION: So, despite all that dialogue and Haru’s promise of aid, we have not formed a Confidant yet. A bit annoying, but whatever. Also we never actually ended up helping Haru, oops.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: (sigh) I think I’m screwed for real this time. I couldn’t concentrate at all ...

text.ACTION: The same speechgiver from the other day continues outside.

text.Ann Takamaki: More importantly, what’s this you want to talk about?

text.Haru Okumura: You said that something was on your mind before, but were you able to figure out what it was?

text.Futaba Sakura: The Medjed that I banned ...  wasn’t the real one.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Huh? Aren’t you the real one though?

text.Futaba Sakura: Oh, uhh ...
The code written by that guy the other day is different from any of the past Medjed.
A code is like your fingerprints. No matter how you try to disguise it, your own quirks appear in it. The one from the other day was all cut and pasted with no consistency. No skill at all.

text.Makoto Niijima: But aren’t there multiple people across the world that are part of Medjed? Couldn’t it have been done by someone that joined recently?

text.Futaba Sakura: How do I put it ... ? That code was so not done by anyone interested in cracking. At all. At the very least, there’s no way it was an official Medjed member.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: So someone used the Medjed name to provoke the Phantom Thieves ... ? For what purpose?

text.Ann Takamaki: Could they have been doing it for fun ... ? It was around the time our group started getting popular, so maybe they wanted in on the hype ...

text.Makoto Niijima: Wait a moment.

text.Haru Okumura: Hm?

text.Makoto Niijima: Perhaps they used the Medjed name to make the Phantom Thieves known ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What? That makes no sense.

text.Futaba Sakura: I actually thought the same as Makoto.

text.Ann Takamaki: Why’s that?

text.Futaba Sakura: Know how I just said that code is like fingerprints? I found those same fingerprints somewhere completely different.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Where’s that?

text.ACTION: It was Mishima! I knew it! You son of a bitch!

text.Futaba Sakura: There were traces of it being illegally tampered with from the outside.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: For real ... ?

text.Futaba Sakura: Before summer vacation, the access counter was made to be much higher than the actual number. Same with the rankings. Particularly the time when President Okumura ranked first.

text.Haru Okumura: So then, the one who provoked the group and the one who tampered with the site are the same person?

text.Makoto Niijima: ...I think I’m starting to see the big picture. Both Medjed’s provocation and the tampering of the website brought attention to us as a result. On top of that, our reason for targeting Okumura was influenced by the public and the rankings ...  The perfect timing, and the perfect target. If both of those had been set up ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: ...It would all make sense.

text.Ann Takamaki: No way ...

text.Makoto Niijima: This is all hypothetical. We lack any hard evidence ...

text.Morgana: But if all your deductions happen to be correct ...  That would mean we’ve been playing right into their hand for the past two months or so ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: W-We gotta be overthinkin’ things. I mean, we’re talkin’ both the rankings AND Medjed ... ! Everyone made a big deal about it! If this was all set up ...  Then ...  what kind of guy did we make an enemy of ... ?

text.ACTION: The group takes a moment to ruminate on this.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: ...There’s no point in getting anxious over speculation. Regardless, we’ll be falsely charged at this rate, and with murder. We must overcome this.

text.Haru Okumura: But, we don’t even know who we’re up against ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey ...  you think we’re fallin’ into another trap, even at this very moment?

text.Morgana: Yeah. This doesn’t mean that we’ve lost yet.

text.Makoto Niijima: Even if this is the actions of a meticulous enemy, we’ll just have to get back at them. We need to find clues ...  No matter what.

text.Sae Niijima: I was told you recommended this reassignment yourself, sir. Why would you choose someone as inexperienced as myself ... ?

text.SIU Director: When the case of the Shujin principal was ruled a suicide, you thought to reopen it ...  And you proved its connection to the Phantom Thieves. This is based primarily on that achievement.

text.Sae Niijima: ...I’m honored, sir.

text.SIU Director: The Phantom Thieves issue is now a national crisis. Expectations are exceedingly high for us public prosecutors, as we are the executors of justice. Personnel and planning will be up to you on this case. You will also have the police under your command.
I’d like you to oversee this operation.

text.Sae Niijima: (in disbelief)

text.SIU Director: You’ve yet to give an answer ...  Will you accept the task of eradicating the Phantom Thieves?

text.Sae Niijima: I will give it everything I have.

text.SIU Director: We’ll have to prepare a higher position for you as well in the event that you succeed. I don’t wish to apply extra pressure on you ...  But I assume your odds of success are high. Naturally, failure to accomplish this task is unacceptable ...  Do you understand?

text.Sae Niijima: Of course! I will live up to your expectations, no matter what it takes!

text.SIU Director: That is all then. I expect good results from you.

text.ACTION: Welp, we’re boned, the SIU is after us. ...Wait, what is the SIU and what exactly do they do? It’s not really clear, game.

According to a quick Google, the "Special Investigation Teams" (SIT) are groups of specialized detectives armed with cutting-edge technology and tactics to capture criminals in serious and often lethal cases such as bombings, aircraft hijackings, and kidnappings. So uh, a bunch of supercops with all the gear, weapons, and training they need to find us and kick our shit in. Great. The SIU in P5 is, I guess, a fictionalized version of this, though they don’t seem to actually do anything as of yet and their director is not just hopelessly corrupt but an active member of a political conspiracy. So just like real life! I also have no idea why Sae, a public prosecutor, seems to answer directly to this chucklefuck, but whatever.

I also just learned that Japanese prosecutors have the ability to direct police for investigation purposes and conduct investigations themselves, Ace Attorney-style. I guess that series was even more accurate than I give it credit for.

text.Makoto Niijima: Should I warm up dinner for you?

text.Sae Niijima: No, it’s OK.
No need. I just came home to get a change of clothes.

text.Makoto Niijima: Are you going to stay at work then?

text.Sae Niijima: I’ve been entrusted with a very important task.

text.Makoto Niijima: You look awful though ...  Aren’t you tired?

text.Sae Niijima: As an adult, there will be times when you will accept an assignment for which failure will not be tolerated. It’s all over for me if I can’t win this.

text.Makoto Niijima: Still, if you were to collapse from exhaustion ...

text.Sae Niijima: ...  ...  I heard detectives have been coming to your school. That must make it hard to focus on your studies. Don’t worry though. It will all be over soon.

text.Makoto Niijima: What do you mean ... ?

text.Sae Niijima: I’m going to catch the Phantom Thieves myself.

text.Makoto Niijima: Is that the important task you mentioned?

text.Sae Niijima: It’s none of your concern.

text.ACTION: Sae then immediately turns around and walks back into the black void directly outside the front door. Didn’t she need a change of clothes?

text.Makoto Niijima: Sis has her sights set on the Phantom Thieves ...  and on Shujin Academy in particular ...  This is bad ...  I need to let everyone know ... !
Just try to stay calm.

text.Haru Okumura: What’s wrong?

text.Makoto Niijima: Sis told me she’s been entrusted with an important task regarding the Phantom Thieves.

text.Ann Takamaki: Wait, weren’t they already investigating us though?

text.Makoto Niijima: The police were doing so in secret. This operation is on a much different scale.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hold on a sec. What’s this SIU thing anyways?

text.Makoto Niijima: The Special Investigations Unit. An elite team that deals with huge cases like government scandals.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I have heard that name on the news. They make headlines often.

text.Futaba Sakura: The real insane part is, they haven’t lost a case against a suspect in like fifty years. If they come after you, you’re screwed. They’re the best investigation force in Japan.

text.Haru Okumura: Are we going to be arrested ... ?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Hm, doesn’t this countermeasure seem somewhat extreme?

text.Makoto Niijima: Right or wrong, I think we’re just way too famous at this point. As this is a country governed by laws, they can’t afford to ignore us for any longer.

text.Haru Okumura: We may be the Phantom Thieves ...  but this is miserable ...

text.Futaba Sakura: They probably have a pretty narrow suspect profile by now too.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey, don’t scare us like that!

text.Futaba Sakura: It’s OK though. They don’t have any evidence.

text.Makoto Niijima: Yes, I expect they’re frantically searching for some as we speak.

text.Futaba Sakura: No way they’re gonna find anything though.

text.Makoto Niijima: It’s only a matter of time. We have to hurry and do something about this ...

text.Morgana: ...E-Everything’s going to be fine. Unless they know about the Metaverse, there’s no way they’ll get any info on us.

text.ACTION: Yeah, it’d really suck if that was the case!
I’m always in the mood to go out, you just never let me!

text.Newscaster: The cause is thought to be discontent with how the government is dealing with #Millennials. Evidently, Mr. Okumura’s death has had severely adverse effects on the government as well.

text.Morgana: I can sympathize. Our approval rating has gone way down, too ...
We’ve gotta get through this, no matter what it takes!

text.Arrogant Youth: The government and the police are useless. Are they even trying? I wish they wouldn’t spend tax dollars just to sit on their asses ...

text.Dissaffected Youth: A mysterious group of murderers, an inept government ...  What’s the world coming to these days?

text.Morgana: Everyone’s talking trash about us ...

text.Whisper: How many times has this been, now?

text.Chatter: Our school’s gotten famous.
Yeah, in a bad way.

text.Whisper: I wonder if the culprit really is from our school ...

text.Boy 5: Yeah ...  Who do those damn cops think they are? They can’t just stare us all down like that.

text.Scared Student: Maybe the rumors are true? Maybe there’s a Phantom Thief at our school ...

text.Sadayo Kawakami: The police are here at the school, so be sure not to get in their way. Oh, and ...  For various reasons, the school festival got moved to the 25th. There was talk of canceling it, but we couldn’t just do that. I’m sure the preparations will be rough, but don’t push yourself too hard.

text.Male Student: Really? On a weekday? What kinds of reasons are there?

text.Female Student: With all this stuff about the principal and Kamoshida this year, I guess it can’t be helped ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Seriously!?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: The police are at Shujin? They haven’t come to my school.

text.Makoto Niijima: It seems they’re calling students individually out of class to speak with them.

text.Ann Takamaki: Wait ...  Does that mean we’re gonna get called in too!?

text.Makoto Niijima: Second-years will start in the afternoon. Make sure you prepare yourselves mentally for this.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: They’ve gotta be looking for the culprit, right ... ?

text.Makoto Niijima: Who knows ...

text.Futaba Sakura: Be careful, guys. You should probably try to not say much. They’ll see through any lies you try and make.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I know.

text.Makoto Niijima: In any case, don’t tell them anything unnecessary.

text.Sadayo Kawakami: You two will go together.

text.Ann Takamaki: Huh? Why together ... ?

text.Sadayo Kawakami: Why ... ? They’ll probably have one of you wait outside. That’s how they’ve been doing it so far.

text.Ann Takamaki: Oh yeah, right ...

text.Sadayo Kawakami: Those are the instructions the detectives gave us. Just don’t say more than is necessary, and try and get it over with quick.

Protag: Fuck, you know what? I give up. Gimme a deal, I will rat out every last one of those motherfuckers, especially the cat! My teacher’s a maid! I help a sketchy ex-yakuza dude make and smuggle illegally modified airsoft guns! Mishima runs the Phan-Site, which you should probably actually know already if you’ve done any research whatsoever!

Protag: Let’s just start over.

text.Nice Detective: Ah yes, you’re the one currently under probation. It says here you had a dispute with Mr. Kamoshida?

text.COMMENT: Protag: buuuuuuuuuuuh ...  ... ..yep

text.Nice Detective: You’re more hot-blooded than you look. ...You spend time with an interesting group. Yusuke Kitagawa and Haru Okumura? The more friends the better, right?

text.ACTION: How do they even know about Yusuke?

text.Nice Detective: ...I’m sorry to have taken your time. You’re free to go now. Oh, I almost forgot. There’s just one more thing I have to ask you. Do you think the Phantom Thieves are associated with this school?

text.ACTION: Oh geez, I sure hope those scary awful Phantom Thieves with rad superpowers aren’t involved here, that would just be awful.

text.Nice Detective: Don’t worry. We’re here to keep all of you safe, OK?

text.ACTION: Oh, thanks so much. Fuckin’ cops.

text.Nice Detective: Your responses will serve as great reference material. Takamaki-san is next. Could you ask her to come in?

text.Makoto Niijima: It seems we were all asked the same questions.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That’s how they get you. They do that on purpose, then wait for someone to slip up.

text.ACTION: Well, they weren’t asking very good questions, if so! One of them was about an event specific to me (and Ryuji), another was about who I hang out with (which the cop answered for me), and the last was just asking me to speculate. Correct.
In a 5x5 square, there are more than 200 million. Can you believe that?
