text.Makoto Niijima: There’s a possibility that both your names have come up during the course of the investigation.

text.Ann Takamaki: A number of the teachers had been questioned before, and even we were interviewed the other day too.

text.Makoto Niijima: Don’t let your guard down too much.

text.Morgana: It’s true that the initial members have been at this for a long time, making it easier to get tracked ...

text.ACTION: Like, you know, what Makoto did.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: All riiight ...

text.Haru Okumura: Now, now. Let’s leave it at that. We just need to be mindful about what we’re saying, correct?

text.Makoto Niijima: (embarrassed)

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: You seem to be having quite a lot of fun, Haru. You did mention that you were looking forward to this.

text.Haru Okumura: I want to go around with everyone and eat at the refreshment stands.

text.Makoto Niijima: Shall we head off to the stands then?
Oh right. This is your first time at our school festival.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: They’re pretty good. From what I’ve heard ...

text.ACTION: What does that mean? Did you skip your last one?

text.Ann Takamaki: I know a great one! Follow me.

text.Haru Okumura: "Maid Takoyaki" ... ?

text.Ann Takamaki: New customers! I’ll show you all to your seats.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...So it’s your class’s stand.

text.Ann Takamaki: It’s still a refreshment stand, isn’t it?

text.Futaba Sakura: It’s like a deserted island here ...

text.Makoto Niijima: Well, I guess it’s good for talking since there aren’t any people here ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: And it was all bullshit.

text.Morgana: Here she comes ...  Act normal.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Who cares ... ? There’s nothin’ "normal" about this anymore.
"Take my order"!? What happened to the maid atmosphere!?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: There are a lot of odd flavors ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Stick to a normal one. I bet they--

text.Student Maid: I’m so sorry. We sold our last normal one to the previous customer.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: The hell ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Well then ...  I’ll have the mentai cheese takoyaki.

text.Student Maid: I’m sorry. We’re out of cod roe.

text.Haru Okumura: Then, how about the squid--

text.Student Maid: Um ...  We’re currently out catching squid. It’ll probably be another five or six hours ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That doesn’t even sound remotely possible! Ain’t this whole menu just a sham!?

text.ACTION: Ryuji sounds angrier than he has for most of the rest of the game here.

text.Ann Takamaki: Actually, we spent most of our budget on making the maid costumes look nice. We didn’t put too much effort into the octopus.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I can see that!

text.Morgana: (whispering)

text.Haru Okumura: Then, what would you recommend with what you have now?

text.Student Maid: That would be the Russian takoyaki.

text.Haru Okumura: We’ll have that, please.

text.Student Maid: This will take a little time.

text.Morgana: I’ve even heard conjecture that the principal was targeted for reasons like "he knew too much."

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I kept hearing about Goro Akechi’s popularity.

text.Futaba Sakura: All thanks to the Phantom Thieves!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You know, did that Akechi guy agree to show up here ‘cause he believes we didn’t kill anybody ... ?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Or, he may simply love large gatherings.

text.Ann Takamaki: Oh, true. He didn’t seem like he minded being pampered by the media at all.

text.Morgana: We plan on stealing intel, but we might fall into another trap. I’m gonna be bummed if that happens ...

text.Makoto Niijima: You’re so carefree. ...Does it mean you have nerves of steel in any situation? Still, it doesn’t change the fact that we don’t know what Akechi-kun is planning.

text.Ann Takamaki: Ooh, it’s fresh made!

text.Futaba Sakura: Lies! I heard a microwave go off!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Well, it’s not like I was expectin’ crispy takoyaki at a school festival or anything. So, what makes this a "Russian" takoyaki ... ?

text.Haru Okumura: Could there be jam in it as a secret ingredient? That sounds quite delicious.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dude, don’t tell me the "Russian" part means ...

text.ACTION: Gotta admit, this is a really solid, dumb joke.

text.Morgana: I-Is that so?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I’d prefer the most beautifully shaped one ...  but all of them are misshapen.

text.Haru Okumura: Oh, aren’t you all going to eat? I think I’ll go for the "special" one.

text.Makoto Niijima: Wait ...  Is she honestly going for it?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: (to Maaku)
Uh ...  well, yeah.

text.ACTION: I love this line. He sounds so defeated by my idiocy.

text.Makoto Niijima: Th-The panel isn’t until tomorrow though ...

text.Goro Akechi: I came to check out the venue. I can’t make any mistakes since a lot of people will be present.

text.Futaba Sakura: Someone’s eager.

text.Goro Akechi: But people ended up recognizing me. Everyone bombarded me with questions.

text.ACTION: You’re wearing your normal clothes, dude. Not much of a disguise.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: (whispering)

text.Goro Akechi: I grew tired of the baseless rumors they kept bringing up, so I escaped to where there weren’t any people.

text.Haru Okumura: (gasp) The "special" one ... !

text.ACTION: That’s for Haru, you bastard! Put the takoyaki back in the box!

text.Goro Akechi: Let’s just call this my performance fee.

text.Ann Takamaki: But--

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: It’s fine.

text.Ann Takamaki: Eating it in one bite is a bad idea ...

text.Goro Akechi: Ohhh ...  Oh, my stomach ...  It burns ... !

text.Ann Takamaki: Are you OK? Do you need water?

text.Futaba Sakura: Hey, does he sound broken to you?

text.Goro Akechi: W-Well then ...  I’ll ...  I’ll see you ...  uh ...  t-t-t-tomorrow.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: It’s like he wants to get picked up for some commercial or something ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: But ...  did he truly come to simply check the venue? ...This isn’t good. I keep suspecting every little thing ...

text.Makoto Niijima: ...I know what you mean. I’m doing the same too. I need to do my best tomorrow. We need to somehow get him to be our source of intel ...  I’m gonna pull this off no matter what!

text.Futaba Sakura: That Akechi guy ...  When he got here, didn’t he say that everyone’s all here? "Everyone" ... ?

text.ACTION: He’s met most of us, minus Haru, before. Couldn’t he just be talking about that?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Yes, but the associated mental fatigue was extraordinary. Being cautious takes a lot out of you ...

text.Ann Takamaki: Seriously. I think I’m as tired now as I am after midterms.

text.Futaba Sakura: I didn’t mind any of that. I just loved seeing that detective gulp down the special takoyaki ...

text.Haru Okumura: I had fun as well, since I got to spend time with you all.

text.Makoto Niijima: What would you like to do now, Haru? Walk around a little more?

text.Haru Okumura: I appreciate the gesture, but I’m satisfied with stopping here. Why don’t we go home and rest up? We’ll have to deal with Akechi-kun again tomorrow, after all ...

text.Morgana: I have to agree. What will his next move be ... ?

text.Newscaster: Criticism against him is not only coming from the opposition, but from the ruling party as well. If the ruling party does split, then a snap election may be a real possibility.

text.Morgana: I don’t know much about politics, but it sounds like there’s a lot going on in the government.

text.Anon: got dox on the thieves yet?

text.Makoto Niijima: Our guest of honor is Goro Akechi.

text.Goro Akechi: I feel kind of bad, considering how many people have gathered ...  I’m sure you all would’ve been happier to have a singer or a mascot appear, wouldn’t you say?

text.ACTION: The crowd begins laughing and cheering raucously.

text.Makoto Niijima: We’d appreciate it if you could tell us about your experiences with the notorious Phantom Thieves.

text.ACTION: “You know, all those experiences you’ve definitely had.”

text.Makoto Niijima: It’d be wonderful if you could let us hear more about your actual investigative process.

text.Goro Akechi: I’m not used to being the one interrogated ...  so please go easy on me.

text.ACTION: This might be kind of a confusing scene because it involves multiple conversations happening in different parts of the same room. I’ll try to make it as clear as I can.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: He talks of how the Phantom Thieves are dangerous, yet he says they haven’t committed any murders ...  Either he has an idea who the true culprit is, or he has uncovered the identities of the Phantom Thieves.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: C’mon, Makoto ...  You gotta get it outta him ... !

text.Goro Akechi: Well, if it’s as much as I’m allowed to say, then everything on TV and the internet is all of it. We don’t have any leads yet, and the methods behind their crimes are still unclear.

text.ACTION: So you don’t know anything about them, and you couldn’t say anything even if you did! Wow, really interesting panel! I guess we should start with the audience Q&A, then, with riveting questions like “This is actually more of a three-part statement...” and “How do I break into games journalism?”

text.Makoto Niijima: Even with this country’s power, arresting them is proving to be difficult ...  Is that the case?

text.Goro Akechi: I wouldn’t phrase it that way ...  but well, something like that.

text.Makoto Niijima: Thank you for answering that question. By the way, it seems you’ve denied a correlation between the Phantom Thieves and the murders ...  Why the sudden change? Until now, haven’t you upheld your stance that the Phantom Thieves are dangerous? How are you so positive that they haven’t committed murder?

text.Goro Akechi: Aren’t you a little too comfortable interrogating people? Why, it’s as if you’re a prosecutor.

text.ACTION: The audience laughs once again. Is Makoto’s sister being a prosecutor common knowledge to the students?

text.Makoto Niijima: Ah, excuse me. This is something I’ve personally been interested in, so I couldn’t help it ...  But won’t you tell us? What reason is there that you’d claim their innocence when you previously stated they were unjust?

text.Futaba Sakura: She’s pelting him with questions.

text.Goro Akechi: Why, then, was he the only one who needed to be killed ... ?

text.Makoto Niijima: Why is that?

text.Goro Akechi: I must admit ...  I couldn’t deduce a reason. That’s why I believe that case should be thought of as if a different party is responsible. And if-- This is all hypothetical, mind you. If the Phantom Thieves are the ones I know of, I can’t possibly imagine they would kill anyone.
Oh, no. The police haven’t gotten that far yet. But I have my own conclusions about the true identities of the Phantom Thieves.

text.Ann Takamaki: Pipe down!

text.Haru Okumura: He’s lying, right ... ?

text.Futaba Sakura: But if it’s the truth ...

text.Goro Akechi: It’s only my personal opinion, so announcing that here wouldn’t pose a problem. However ...  ...There is a possibility that everyone present will hear the truth before the police or media.

text.Futaba Sakura: What’s he planning on saying ... ?

text.Makoto Niijima: If you’re so certain ...  then very well. I’d like to ask you then: Who do you think the Phantom Thieves are, Akechi-san?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: No ...  there’s no way he could have any evidence ...

text.Goro Akechi: Would you mind if I step away for about ...  ten minutes or so?

text.ACTION: God, you’re gonna give everyone in the audience blue balls, huh?

text.Makoto Niijima: I’m terribly sorry, everyone, but we’ll be taking a break. We’ll resume the panel in ten minutes.
There’s the PE faculty office.

text.Goro Akechi: Your friends from yesterday are here, aren’t they? Can you bring them too, if that’s all right?

text.Makoto Niijima: Did you set this up ... ?

text.Goro Akechi: We only have ten minutes, you know.

text.ACTION: Akechi places some photographs on the table.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: That’s gotta be ‘shopped!

text.Goro Akechi: I have video footage too.

text.ACTION: Well… fuck. I vote we kill him.

text.Goro Akechi: Please, let’s not feign ignorance. All of you can go to that other world too, yes?
It’s not just all of you. I am aware of that world too ...  I also know that when you traverse over there, your appearance changes as well. It’s because of those mysterious powers, isn’t it?
This had been installed onto my phone without my knowledge.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dude, it’s the Nav ...

text.Goro Akechi: When the app activated on its own, the scenery around me suddenly changed. Quite frankly, I still can’t believe it myself. But from the look of these photos, all of you seem quite used to it.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We’ve been listenin’ to you blab on for a while now, but cut the delusional--

text.Goro Akechi: All of you are acting as Phantom Thieves in the Metaverse. I can say so with conviction because I have the same power as you.
So you admit it then. In all honesty, I’ve been curious about you since the time of the Madarame case. But to think it would end up like this ...
I believe that as well.

text.Makoto Niijima: ...How can you be so sure?

text.Goro Akechi: Because I saw another—the real culprit.

text.ACTION: Okay, we’re all very shocked at these developments, we get it.

text.Ann Takamaki: Who was it!?

text.Goro Akechi: I couldn’t identify his face ...  He had a mask on, after all. Actually, when I took these photos, I entered that world too.

text.ACTION: This dude’s just so happy about murder.

text.Goro Akechi: He shot at me the moment he noticed me.

Most likely. At the very least, I was almost killed by him. "I can’t die here ...  I need to determine the truth..." When those thoughts overcame me, I awakened to that power—a most fortunate accident.

text.Ann Takamaki: Morgana. Our teammate who taught us about the Metaverse.

text.Goro Akechi: ...Really? This is unbelievable ...  But it IS true that you know things that I don’t ...  ...Say, Morgana. Were you also the one who instructed them on how to change people’s hearts? I experienced that world too, but I still haven’t solved that mystery yet.

text.Morgana: And those whose Treasure has been stolen have a change of heart.

text.Goro Akechi: Hahaha ...  There’s certainly no way anyone could figure out such an MO.

Although I don’t completely understand the method, all you do is simply reform people. Someone else is behind the murders. However, the police have decided that the Phantom Thieves did it ...  They’ll arrest you at this rate.

text.Haru Okumura: Th-They’re going to treat me as my father’s murderer ... ?

text.Goro Akechi: I can’t overlook such a grave mistake. Which is precisely why I want us to strike a deal. I may be able to save you from this situation.
I would like you to cooperate with me on investigating the truth.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: And if we decline?

text.Goro Akechi: Then I think I’ll have to inform the police about all of you, along with that video I mentioned.
The justice I uphold will not tolerate criminals who kill people at their leisure.

text.Haru Okumura: Justice ...

text.Goro Akechi: You’ve heard that Sae-san is the one spearheading the investigation about you Phantom Thieves, correct? The higher-ups are concerned only with settling the case. They want to capture the culprits behind the psychotic breakdown incidents and end the commotion. Those are the ones who are putting pressure on Sae-san. I can only imagine her impatience.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: What of evidence that we did it? How do they intend on proving it?

text.Goro Akechi: Even if there is no objective explanation to the method, it’s over once causality is established. Sae-san can’t make rational judgments at the moment. If she were to be cornered, well ...  she may even make up a confession.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So, they’re gonna make it all our fault!? Just ‘cause they feel like it!?

text.Ann Takamaki: ...And we’re still going to be arrested?

text.Goro Akechi: You’ll be found guilty if you’re caught, and it will be treated as a very serious crime.

text.ACTION: Alternate title for this update: “Ryuji’s Effing Pissed!”

text.Goro Akechi: Unfortunately, there’s nothing I can do alone anymore to stop the flow of things ...

text.Makoto Niijima: And that’s why you want our cooperation ... ?

text.Goro Akechi: Yes. In return, I’ll turn a blind eye to what you’ve done. Those are my conditions. That said, I ask that you disband the Phantom Thieves after this.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: What should we do about Akechi-san’s proposal ... ?

text.ACTION: I sadly must decline, for I am too young to—oh, you mean what he’s asking right now.

text.Goro Akechi: I see ...  I thought I was making a lot of concessions myself ...  Well, you don’t have to decide at the moment. Considering this is you we’re talking about, I believe you’ll come to a favorable reply.

text.Joker: I can sense a bond of trust coming from Akechi...

text.Goro Akechi: I’m glad we could talk. It’s been a while since I’ve been able to spend such a meaningful time like this. I look forward to your answer. It was definitely worth coming today—for various reasons.

text.ACTION: I can feel the fanfiction getting written as I type this sentence.

text.Goro Akechi: ...About that. I’m sorry. Would it be acceptable if we ended the panel here? The reason why you called for me in the first place was because you wanted intel, correct? My business is concluded as well.

text.Makoto Niijima: I’ll deal with it somehow.

text.Joker: My memory is a haze...

text.Goro Akechi: So, I truly apologize about this ...  But I’ll have to end things here today.

text.ACTION: The crowd is despondent. As they should be, because this fucking tease was about to tell them who the Phantom Thieves were!

text.Makoto Niijima: To make up for the time that was planned for this panel, the rakugo research club will instead be--

text.Goro Akechi: I can’t say anything in detail regarding the Phantom Thieves investigation ...  But I feel another great stride will occur again soon. I hope you all continue to pay attention to what happens.

text.Makoto Niijima: Let’s have a big round of applause for today’s guest, Goro Akechi.

text.Ann Takamaki: He totally used Makoto’s suggestion against us.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Indeed. We intended to get intel out of him, but to think it would play out like this.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: So what? We’ll just accept his deal?

text.Ann Takamaki: He’s got evidence on us. We really don’t have a choice ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dammit, what’re we gonna do!?

text.Morgana: Calm down, Ryuji.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: How am I s’posed to calm down!? What are we gonna do!?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: What’s done is done. We’ll have to cool our heads and think more on this. We must make up our minds by the time he contacts us again.

text.Morgana: We need to give this a lot of thought ...

text.Newscaster: Although things have quieted down until recently, several incidents have occurred once again. Furthermore, new information has come to light about the suspect who suffered sudden mental shutdown ...  He had received a calling card from the Phantom Thieves.

text.Advisor: If so, those occurrences back in spring can be attributed to them as well. Moreover ...

text.ACTION:
Part 138: 10/26: Catching Up With The Family
	Part 130: 10/26: Catching Up With The Family
Let’s just ignore all the catastrophic shit that went down and enjoy the rest of the culture festival.

text.Haru Okumura: I tried to think about what happened earlier, but that has gotten me nowhere ...  So, I could use a change of pace. How about it?

text.ACTION: We don’t actually get an option here, but if we had chosen a romantic partner by now, we would. If you have no romance options, you’re locked into Haru, but if you have any of the "school" options (read: Ann, Makoto, or (sigh) yes, Kawakami) you’ll be able to hang out with them. Weirdly, having a romantic partner is also a prerequisite for unlocking the last available option, Ryuji and Mishima, meaning you have to neglect your girlfriend in order to hang out with ...  them. Apparently, you just need Ryuji maxed to unlock Ryuji and Mishima as an option. Anyway, Haru is our only option right now.

text.Haru Okumura: I’ll be waiting at the gymnasium.

text.Joker: I should head to the gym...

text.Post-Festival MC: Everybody give them another round of applause!

text.ACTION: There are light, scattered smatterings of applause.

text.Haru Okumura: I’m sorry. I can’t stop thinking about what Akechi-kun said ...
(giggle) It feels like nothing bad could ever happen when you say that.

text.Joker: (nods)

text.Post-Festival MC: Round of applause, everyone!

text.Haru Okumura: Sharing ... ? I never knew we had such an event.

text.Post-Festival MC: All right, who has something to say? Anyone, anyone!? No, I’ll just have to pick someone then!

text.Haru Okumura: Ooh, he’s going to choose? I wonder who it will be ...

text.ACTION: Yes, I also wonder who ever it could be. *wink*

text.Haru Okumura: Is he ...  looking this way?

text.Post-Festival MC: Well then, come on up!

text.Haru Okumura: So it really is me ...

text.Post-Festival MC: Come, come. Everyone’s waiting!

text.Haru Okumura: Well, I’m going.

text.ACTION: The MC somehow didn’t recognize the only girl in school who wears a pink sweater over her uniform.

text.Haru Okumura: Um, yes ...

text.ACTION: The crowd starts cheering, saying stuff like “She’s so cool” and yelling “Senpaaaaaai!”

text.Post-Festival MC: U-Uhhh ...  I’m sure you’re, um ...  still grieving ...  My, um ...  deepest apologies ...

text.ACTION: Oh god, this is gonna be painful.
This scene has a disproportionate amount of the “sweating” emote, so I’ll just call them out in-text from now on instead of screenshotting all of them.

text.Haru Okumura: Oh, please don’t worry!

text.Post-Festival MC: So uh, do you have anything you’d like to share with us?

text.Haru Okumura: Something to share ...  I have too many things ...

text.Post-Festival MC: Err ...  Here, let me give you a question then ...  Do you think the Phantom Thieves are really Shujin students?

text.ACTION: What the hell, man? This is the worst culture festival ever!

text.Haru Okumura: Huh?

text.Post-Festival MC: I mean, they are ...  uh ...  your father’s killers ...
We’re all dying to know what Akechi-kun was going to say about their true identities. So, are they from Shujin? What do you think, Okumura-san?

text.Haru Okumura: Erm ...

text.Joker: Haru is in trouble ...  I need to change the subject ...

text.Haru Okumura: Well ...

text.Post-Festival MC: Now this is drama! A boy caught in the throes of bittersweet youth! A stunning confession of love!

text.ACTION: The crowd becomes lively once more, and Haru sweats… twice.

text.Post-Festival MC: I think it was him!
Sooo, Okumura-san! What’s your relation to this guy?

text.Haru Okumura: Th-That wasn’t what we were talking about ...

text.Post-Festival MC: My, she’s quite flustered! IS this a hot scoop!?

text.ACTION: Someone call in Newspaper Club Member, stat!

text.Post-Festival MC: But I’m a gentleman. It hurts my heart to bully such a sweet girl! Well, did you all enjoy our blushing beauty? Thank you very much, Okumura-san!

text.ACTION: The crowd moans, and someone yells, “Just when it was getting interesting!”

text.Haru Okumura: It turned out to be more like an interview party, huh? I still can’t believe you said that ...

Huh ... ? Right ...  At any rate ...  I’m not sure what I would have done without you. Thank you for saving me. You’re a mysterious person, but you’re so reliable. I think the two of us will get along quite well in the future ...

text.ACTION: What? Well fuck you too, I guess!

text.Haru Okumura: Who knows what may lie ahead. For now, I’m worried about what happened with Akechi-kun ...  But I have to say, my first post-festival party was quite fun. Though ...  I guess it’s my last too. Here, I’d like you to have this.

text.ACTION: The Sakura Amezaiku restores 100 SP to one ally.

text.Haru Okumura: I ...  bought it earlier ...
(giggle) Now then, let’s go home.

text.Chatter: Yeah, there’s been a sudden increase.
I bet it’s because of that Phan-Site.

text.Whisper: I heard the victims were on the rankings there.

text.Chatter: We should really be blaming the people who requested it.

text.Futaba Sakura: You took off somewhere during the festival, huh ...  I tried to find you, but I gave up pretty quickly.

text.Morgana: Futaba? What are you doing here in front of the store ... ?

text.Futaba Sakura: Not just Akechi, but other stuff too. We’re in deep trouble unless we can do something soon. But anyway, I was just thinking about going inside, so your timing is perfect. Let’s go.

text.ACTION: How convenient for the upcoming scene!

text.SIU Director: "No Countermeasure for the Phantom Thieves," "The Sorry State of the Police," "Destruction of Safety" ...  They’re saying whatever they want. So, how’s the investigation progressing? Any clues yet?

text.Sae Niijima: Nothing that leads to a firm conviction yet ...

text.SIU Director: What’s going on here? Didn’t you say that you were sure about closing this case? And I thought I told you that failure won’t be tolerated.

text.ACTION: It’s been like a week, dude. Chill the fuck out.

text.SIU Director: Well, this is troublesome. If things continue at this rate, never mind a promotion ...  we’d have to let you go entirely.
I had high expectations for you, but it seems this task was too much to handle for someone so young.
We may need to reform the operation as well since the selected personnel for this--

I know that you’ve been at this for a while now, even before the police spared us the staff for it. If you can manage an arrest, I’ve made special arrangements so that you can question them personally. ...That’s what you want, isn’t it?
I’ll make myself clear again: Failure isn’t an option. We need results.

text.Sae Niijima: ...I understand.

text.SIU Director: You’re allowed to take some ...  bold measures if you need to. We need good results, no matter what.

text.Sae Niijima: (nods)
...To you, sir?

text.SIU Director: ... I said that failure isn’t an option, didn’t I?

text.ACTION: holy fucking shit look at his goddamn face aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahaahaha
Oh shit, time for it to really go down!

text.Sojiro Sakura: This is a calling card, right? I’ve read about it online too.

text.Futaba Sakura: Y-You went into my room without my permission!?

text.Sojiro Sakura: I’ll apologize as much as you want later. ...So, what is this?

text.Futaba Sakura: That’s ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: Is it something to get flustered over? I knew it. This isn’t just some "game" you’re playing. Why aren’t you saying anything?

text.Futaba Sakura: I mean ...  it was memorable ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: Explain.
Is it something that you can’t explain?

text.Futaba Sakura: Ex...plain ...

text.ACTION: Futaba sounds like she can barely speak, and is clearly on the verge of tears.

text.Morgana: Hey, if this keeps up, Futaba’s--

text.Sojiro Sakura: You will, huh? I’ll get right to the point. ...Is this a "real" one? Was a ...  well ...  a "change of heart" triggered in you?

text.Futaba Sakura: (sob)

text.Sojiro Sakura: How about it?

text.ACTION: Chief Hardass here is gonna (further) traumatize his daughter, holy shit.

text.Futaba Sakura: ...Ever since ...  Mom died ...  there was ...  no exit ...   ... I was trapped ...  in a labyrinth of ...  my heart ...

text.ACTION: Overly poetic language is maybe the wrong choice to get through to Sojiro. No offense to the dude, but he seems like the kind of guy whose brain would explode if he looked at a sufficiently daring painting. No offense to the “Sayuri” intended.

text.Futaba Sakura: I knew I ...  had to leave it ...  but I ...  I couldn’t do it ...  by myself ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: Futaba ...  (shakes head) Here ...  Sit down. I can at least listen to what you have to say.

text.Futaba Sakura: It’s the same as Mom’s research ...  They changed ...  my cognition ...  (sobs)

text.Sojiro Sakura: Seriously ... ?  ...  ...  Wakaba’s research about altering one’s cognition ...  I wondered about it myself too, but still ...
When she said she was gonna go to the beach out of nowhere. Even the doctors had thrown in the towel.

text.Futaba Sakura: (quiet crying)

text.Sojiro Sakura: At first I just chalked it up as other kids being a better support for you than any adult. But as I kept watching the tabloid shows here day in and day out, a thought crossed my mind ...  I thought ...  your case kind of seemed similar to what those Phantom Thieves were doing.

text.Futaba Sakura: ... Wow.

text.Sojiro Sakura: I’m still your guardian, you know. I’d never overlook such a drastic change in your behavior.

text.Futaba Sakura: Sojiro ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: But to think that Wakaba’s research and the Phantom Thieves changing hearts were about the same thing.

My job was to be the bridge between the country and the lab that Wakaba worked at. It’s around that time that I got to know her. She said something odd when we were out drinking ...  That ...  she might soon die in an odd way. Who wouldn’t take that as a joke? I just laughed it off ...

But ...  it happened exactly as she said. If anything were to happen to you, I’d feel like I let her down. There’s something I want to ask you, Maaku. Judging from your attitude, you knew about this calling card, didn’t you? You should’ve known that Futaba had a change of heart through the Phantom Thieves as well. ...Is there a connection between you and them? The first incident of a change of heart was a teacher at your school. The kid who brought that painting here was a pupil of that artist who had a change of heart, wasn’t he? And then there’s Futaba ...  These scandals always seem to find their way around you ...  What do you have to say?
...  ...  These people are called criminals by the general public. Why did you introduce such dangerous people to Futaba!?

text.Futaba Sakura: I asked them! That’s why Maaku saved me! He stole my heart!

text.ACTION: Welp, the cat’s outta the bag now, I guess.

text.Sojiro Sakura: ...Asked? Stole?
Wait, are you saying that he’s the one who changed your heart?

text.ACTION: If we started a drinking game for the word “heart” we’d get plastered in this scene faster than in a fucking Kingdom Hearts game.

text.Sojiro Sakura: So, he’s not connected with the Phantom Thieves, but is one himself ... ? You’re pulling my leg, aren’t you?
You ...  really are a Phantom Thief? For crying out loud ...

text.Futaba Sakura: Sojiro ...

text.Sojiro Sakura: So basically, I’ve been sheltering a Phantom Thief for the last six months? And on top of that, Futaba’s involved too ...

text.Futaba Sakura: I ...  I want to find the culprit who killed my mom ... !

text.ACTION: Oh, we’re just gonna lay it all out there, huh? I should probably confess the teacher-maid thing, then, even if it’s over at this point.

text.Futaba Sakura: She was killed! I ...  remember it now.

text.Sojiro Sakura: Stop this nonsense!

text.ACTION: Dude, you just said she died in a ludicrously suspicious manner.

text.Futaba Sakura: Why won’t you believe me!? Are you the same as everyone else? Didn’t you know already!? The way Mom died wasn’t normal! Didn’t you notice that her research was stolen by someone!? Sojiro ... !

text.Sojiro Sakura: ...When she passed away, I did think it was odd. It was awfully fishy. But what could I do? ...All I was able to do was run from it all. And the outcome of that ...  was me spending my retirement here. Also the reason I took custody of you was ...  me trying to selfishly atone for what happened to Wakaba. It’s basically my fault that you got burdened with all this crap.

text.Futaba Sakura: It’s not your fault, Sojiro.

text.Sojiro Sakura: I acted all big, lectured, even yelled at you kids ...  And in the end, I’m the one being consoled. I’m hopeless and a laughingstock, aren’t I?

text.Futaba Sakura: I mean, the one who killed Mom is the one at fault!

text.ACTION: Fuck yeah. This is a top-tier Fake Dad. Dojima was an all right Fake Dad, but he was too suspicious of us. And then who the fuck is P3’s Fake Dad? Akihiko? No. Ikutsuki? Gross.

text.Sojiro Sakura: I mean, who would believe such a story? Unless they catch you red-handed, it’s impossible to explain that you’re the Phantom Thieves. Let me just say one thing though. Immediately back out of a fight that you can’t win.
Don’t you get it? If by chance you pissed off the same guys that killed Wakaba ...  Then they’re not someone that kids like you can deal with. Listen to reason, all right?
Let’s eat. I’m so hungry ‘cause I raised my voice so much ...

text.Morgana: ...Still, we should tell the others about what just happened.

text.ACTION: Ryuji! You said (well, typed) fuck again! That’s two strikes! You know what’ll happen if you violate the court order!

text.Ann Takamaki: Wait, are you OK? Did he report you or anything?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: We likely wouldn’t be receiving these messages if Maaku was not OK. I had a feeling that Boss was no ordinary man ...

text.Haru Okumura: But he didn’t recommend you turn yourself in, did he? I think in that case we can consider him a new ally.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I’m more curious about what he mentioned to you.

text.Haru Okumura: You mean how our enemy might be the same people who targeted Futaba’s mother?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Yes. She was killed by mental shutdown, the same method used by the culprit we pursue now.

text.Ann Takamaki: Wait a second though ...  Didn’t you say Boss had to "run from it all" ... ?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Ain’t you letting your imagination run wild a bit?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: But it would make sense.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Wait a sec! If you’re right, then wouldn’t the police be working for ‘em too!?

text.Makoto Niijima: ...That’s not impossible.

text.Ann Takamaki: This is getting too big for me to even think about ...

text.Haru Okumura: Can we really win this?

text.Futaba Sakura: We’re gonna win, no matter what!
(nods)

text.ACTION: Oh man, with that wide anime mouth I’m sure he could review the shit out of that amiibo

text.DTD Reporter: All the food’s so good, it’s hard to choose! This is the place to go when you splurge in Shibuya!

text.DTD Co-host: I heard all sorts of celebrities and even political big shots go there undercover to eat. The man who everyone says will be the next prime minister goes there too. I’d love to go try it out!

text.Futaba Sakura: All this happened because I kept the calling card ...
Is Sojiro still awake? This is kind of awkward ...

text.Morgana: Wait, shouldn’t you sleep on the sofa, so that Futaba can go ahead and sleep on the bed?

text.ACTION: shut up dude I have back problems

text.Futaba Sakura: ...  ...  ...I’m gonna go home. Night.

text.Newscaster: We now resume our coverage of the Phantom Thieves, the suspects for Mr. Okumura’s death and others. The police have designated the Phantom Thieves as the country’s most wanted fugitives ...  And have decided to reward anyone with information leading to the capture of the Phantom Thieves.

text.ACTION: Thirty million!? Hold on, I need to make a phone call.

text.Newscaster: And considering the high amount, it shows how extraordinary the situation has become. Reward money will be supplied by the police and the families of the victims, further--

text.Sojiro Sakura: I hope you understand the situation you’re in. Even people who didn’t have an interest before will be on the lookout for the Phantom Thieves. And it’ll happen every day, even at school. ...Why did this happen?

This isn’t about me. Well, how do I put this ... ? I’m sorry I didn’t realize it. It’s also my responsibility that this happened. All I can do now is give you shelter. Just don’t become desperate and do something reckless, all right?
I won’t sell you out. As long as you’re here, there’s nothing to worry about.

text.Morgana: I feel bad about what we’ve done to the chief. I’m responsible too.

text.SIU Director: With this, the Phantom Thieves have become public enemy number one.  ...  ... . (chuckle) Exactly. ...That will be when their curtain falls.

text.ACTION: Why even have these scenes at this point? They’re all the same and we’re not learning anything new.

text.Boy 10: Akechi suggested they go to this school, right?

text.ACTION: Oh hey, it’s Pallid Fella again.

text.Dissatisfied First-Year: It’ll probably be the end of us if we start sniffing around now.

text.Boy 10: But ...  30 million yen, man. Just let me dream a little.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I had braced myself for this possibility ...

text.Ann Takamaki: Actually having a wanted notice out for us feels kinda weird ...

text.Futaba Sakura: I’m not sure we’re gonna get away this time.

text.Haru Okumura: Our backs are truly against the wall now.

text.Makoto Niijima: Discussing it here won’t do us any good though. Let’s talk about it more in person.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: And the reward’s thirty million yen? What is this, a comic book? Haha, it feels so unrealistic, I can’t help but laugh ...

text.Ann Takamaki: We’re finally being treated as actual criminals ...

text.Makoto Niijima: I’m positive now ...  Remember all of those what-ifs I mentioned before ... ? All of this was truly set up. How President Okumura ranked first, the fad before that, even Medjed ...  It was all to make the Phantom Thieves famous. On top of that, we were lured to target Okumura ...

text.Morgana: Yeah ...  The enemy likely planned to lay the blame on us from the start, after we gained popularity.

text.Ann Takamaki: Then, what about everything we’ve done until now? Are the people whose hearts we changed and thought were corrupt actually not?

text.Makoto Niijima: No. Because of Yusuke and I, the Madarame and Kaneshiro cases were coincidental ...  Wasn’t that the case with Kamoshida too? Considering what happened with the rankings, only the previous target would have been used to lure us ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: What a cheap trick to use ...

text.Makoto Niijima: Cheap ... ? It’s nothing of the sort ...  There’s the fake Medjed and the site’s altercation. They might have even engineered the fad around us. So much time and effort has been put into this ...  President Okumura probably wasn’t their only target. Perhaps they intend to place all blame of past and future psychotic breakdowns on our group ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: And there was that thing with Haru at the time. How’re we s’posed to ignore that, huh!?

text.ACTION: That’s actually a really solid point, game! We couldn’t very well ignore that and to be honest we had little solid reason to, but let’s keep throwing blame at each other for this shit, sure!

text.Haru Okumura: ...I’m sorry. This was all because I one-sidedly decided that my father was a criminal. All I could think about was my fiance. If I had only been able to cope with it more calmly ...

text.Makoto Niijima: Haru ...

text.Ann Takamaki: It’s not Haru’s fault. I should’ve spoken up too when Principal Kobayakawa died ... !

text.ACTION: Ryuji takes his frustration out on the poor couch.

text.Ann Takamaki: Ryuji! Taking out your frustration on things doesn’t help anyone!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey, what do you think, Maaku? ...Why did we lose? What did we do wrong?

text.Morgana: It’s probably because ...  we weren’t acting like ourselves.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: ...Agreed. At the time, we only cared about the opinion of the general public.

text.Ann Takamaki: Yeah ...  that really is it. I was ...  so caught up in making a name for ourselves. I’m such an idiot ... ! I became a Phantom Thief because I hated those same kinds of adults ... !

text.ACTION: Oh god, that’s certainly a sentence.
What the hell are you talking about, Haru? This was your first one. You don’t get to talk like that.

text.Makoto Niijima: I’m so irritated with myself ... !

text.Futaba Sakura: Makoto ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I know that we’ve been set up, and that I was a complete idiot too. But still ...  it’s so damn frustrating! Of course I wanna do something about this ...

text.ACTION: Max Mittelman sells the hell out of this scene as Ryuji, for the record. I have some qualms with the way it’s written but it’s some top-notch voice work.

text.Morgana: Yeah. We’ll be in deep water at this rate ...  However, we have no idea who we’re up against ...  and whether they’re an individual or an organization.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Furthermore, they must be in a position of power, or have powerful backers, if they can go so far.

text.Ann Takamaki: Are we really a match for this ... ?

text.Futaba Sakura: Should we ...  end this now?
I mean, things might get worse for everyone ...

text.Ann Takamaki: Hey, what should we do ... ?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Running away with our tails between our legs is exactly what they want ...

text.ACTION: Another questionable use of the word “aesthetics” when “ideals” would work fine, but whatever.

text.Futaba Sakura: ...I see.
Absolutely not like this!

text.Morgana: Looks like we’re settled on "what" we want to do. All that’s left is "how" we go about it ...

text.Makoto Niijima: Yeah ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Um ...  About me yellin’ earlier. Bein’ framed, and the added bounty ...  It all felt like such bullshit. I lost it ...  I’m sorry.

text.ACTION: That’s nice. You gonna apologize to the couch you punched repeatedly?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: ...You too? It is confusin’. We’re wanted criminals now ...  Maybe I haven’t changed at all since that time we went up against Kamoshida ...  I wanted to be a phantom thief because I thought even someone like me could be a hero ...  It made me so happy to be depended on. Guess it all went straight to my head. I thought I could do anythin’ if it was for justice. But that’d make me no different from our targets ...  I called them shitbags, but I must be the shittiest of shitbags. I can’t even joke about it ...

Maaku ...  Heh, you’re right. I can start by changin’ who I am now. Thanks, Maaku. I feel like I can think straight now. Oh ...  I scared Haru and Futaba, didn’t I ...  I’ll have to apologize to them soon. Seeya!

text.Makoto Niijima: He wants us to gather at Leblanc tomorrow after school.

text.Futaba Sakura: Who does he think he is, trying to boss us around like that!?

text.Haru Okumura: Tomorrow ... ? That’s sudden.
Yeah. We’re going to overcome this, together.

text.Makoto Niijima: Regardless, I don’t want anyone disturbing our pace anymore. Let’s go about this calmly. Well, see you all tomorrow.

text.Morgana: ...We’ve reached a crucial moment. There’s no point fretting about it now though. Let’s just stay calm and wait for tomorrow.
I wouldn’t have expected anything less from you. I knew making you our leader was the right call.

text.Newscaster: We consulted a profiling expert for his analysis. He determined that "they’re either in their 20s to 30s, or in their 40s to 50s."

text.ACTION: That’s a wide fuckin’ net, and it’s still totally wrong!

text.Morgana: They’re so far off the mark ...  Were they even trying?

text.Anon: lol this place went to shit
This should make em show up

text.Masayoshi Shido: Only now does the government speak of taking countermeasures ...  but their actions are too little, too late! The government as it stands has been left behind the times. It is obsolete! If this is a ship that’s bound to a rotting dock and destined to sink, we might as well destroy is once.

text.Older Employee: I heard they’re splitting up to form a new party, so an election might come before the year’s end.

text.Younger Employee: I’m gonna vote this time for sure! This man has my support.

text.Older Employee: You haven’t voted until now? That’s problematic as a member of society, you know ...

text.Younger Employee: Politics just never interested me before, but this politician seems pretty amazing. He’s passionate and thinks of the future. I mean, someone like that should be prime minister. I’m definitely voting for him.

text.Older Employee: Well, I suppose that makes sense since the other politicians seem so unreliable ...

text.Goro Akechi: That’s a good question, but might I have a cup of coffee first?

text.ACTION: It’s not too late to just kill this dude, you guys.

text.Makoto Niijima: Please keep this short.

text.Goro Akechi: There’s a bounty for information in addition to the arrest warrant ...  Those are quite desperate measures.

I’m referring to Sae-san’s actions. I assume all of you are at your wit’s end as well. She must be considerably vexed if she’s gone that far. Make headlines with the arrest warrant, then use incentives to get testimonies. It’s not a bad method.

text.Futaba Sakura: The police have nothing on us. There’s no way they can make an arrest.

text.Goro Akechi: True. I’m the only one who’s ascertained your true identities. However, the groundwork for fabricating testimonies and concocting a culprit are underway.

text.Futaba Sakura: We don’t care about that self-gratification. Get on with it.

text.Goro Akechi: I’ll be blunt.

text.Haru Okumura: Huh? Really ... ?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Is this to prevent the investigation agency’s recklessness?

text.Goro Akechi: Precisely.

text.Ann Takamaki: Still, there’s no need to change her heart just for that ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Indeed. It’s hard to believe that a single person can fabricate all that.

text.Goro Akechi: Unfortunately, that’s not the case. What if I told you that those around her would turn a blind eye to false evidence?

text.ACTION: The police!? Do a bad!? Noooooooooo!

text.Goro Akechi: It seems they’re more trusted than I thought. Their priority is settling the situation. They don’t care who the supposed culprit is.

text.Haru Okumura: No ...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: They’re completely rotten!

text.Goro Akechi: My objective is to find the true culprit. That must be the case for all of you too. However, the current situation is extremely bad.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: If worst comes to worst, someone unrelated will be set up as the culprit, huh ... ?

text.Goro Akechi: Our only solution to this is to make Sae-san come to her senses. If she’s in her right mind, she can stop this situation. Her sense of justice wouldn’t allow it.

text.Haru Okumura: So that’s why ...

text.Goro Akechi: The truth will be covered up, and an innocent civilian’s life will be destroyed ...  I can’t allow such a thing to happen. My own ethics won’t stand for it.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I mean, I guess I can understand how you feel.

text.Goro Akechi: And changing Sae-san’s heart will be to protect her as well.

text.Makoto Niijima: How do you mean?

text.Goro Akechi: If the true culprit were to learn that she’s responsible for the investigation ...  what would happen? I’m certain they’ll aim for her life. She’s the perfect target to place blame on the Phantom Thieves.
So how about it? Will you agree to my plan?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Even though you’re particular about being just, you’re willing to get your hands dirty?

text.Goro Akechi: It can’t be helped in order to ascertain the truth. There is also one more merit in changing Sae-san’s heart.

It will become a warning to not mess with us. They can’t go public if someone in the investigation has a change of heart. It’d show their corruption. All that’s left from there is for me to discover the identity of the true culprit.

text.Ann Takamaki: What do you mean ... ?

text.Makoto Niijima: You’re gonna tell us to announce our disbandment once the real culprit is arrested ...  aren’t you?

text.Goro Akechi: As expected from a Niijima. So, what do you say? I don’t think it’s a bad deal for either of us.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Makoto ...  what’s your take on all this?

text.Makoto Niijima: ...It’s a well-made plan. ...It even takes putting an end to our team into consideration.

text.Goro Akechi: I’m flattered to hear that.

text.Haru Okumura: Why are you willing to do all this, Akechi-kun? Why do you seek justice?

text.Goro Akechi: Yes. My contempt for such people drives my sense of justice. It isn’t some grand reason like society’s sake or some lofty ideal. It’s simply an absurd grudge ...  and extremely personal.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Dude ...

text.Ann Takamaki: You know, doesn’t he remind you of us ... ?
Yeah ...  like how some disgusting adult pissed him off.

text.Goro Akechi: We’re similar, hm ... ? Maybe that’s why I thought that I could ask this of you all ...  Won’t you cooperate with me on the mission to change Sae-san’s heart?
...Thanks. I was actually rather worried there. This mission can’t succeed without your cooperation, after all.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: The Phantom Thieves will be disbanded, and everything will work out ...  I pray it does.

text.Haru Okumura: Mako-chan ...

text.Makoto Niijima: I’m OK. I never brought it up until now ...  but the reason I joined the Phantom Thieves is ...
I’ve also known for quite some time that she has a Palace.

text.Ann Takamaki: Why didn’t you tell us?

text.Makoto Niijima: It was too selfish of a reason ...  Though, I was too scared to look any further into it on my own ...

text.Goro Akechi: Why don’t we try going there now to scope the place out? A lot of this will be new to me, so I’d like to get myself accustomed to it too.
I see. That’s unfortunate.

text.Haru Okumura: Will you tell your sister about this?

text.Makoto Niijima: Of course not. It’s just ...

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: You seem awfully evasive today. Is something the matter?

text.Makoto Niijima: I just can’t make time today.

text.Goro Akechi: Let’s call it a day then and resume this tomorrow.

text.Makoto Niijima: I’m sorry, everyone.

text.Morgana: Well, I guess that can’t be helped ...  Regardless, it all starts tomorrow. ...I hope this goes well.

text.Sae Niijima: Not only that, Goro Akechi ... ? Then the Phantom Thieves targeted me as per his advice ... ? And he had already experienced the Metaverse by the time of the Okumura case? That can’t be ...  I mean, he never said a word ...  Although, his attitude did change suddenly around that time. Akechi-kun kept quiet about the most important details, and my own sister may be a Phantom Thief ...  If this is all true, I’m appalled as the commander of this operation. I alone was kept in the dark ...
And if you were apprehended while falsely accused of those crimes, that villain would still be loose. That’s why you targeted me ... ? Not for your own preservation?

text.ACTION: Well, it was kinda both, you see...

text.Sae Niijima: Believe you? I’m just considering it as a possibility. Then again, if you wanted to evade capture, triggering my change of heart wouldn’t guarantee anything. Your actions as Phantom Thieves would still be met with hostility.
If this villain does exist and is setting up your group ...  ...I would be targeted next. ...Did Makoto come up with that speculation?
Perhaps I’m overthinking things ...

text.ACTION: Maaku’s vision gets hazy once more...

text.Sae Niijima: You need to keep your focus!
But the look on your face isn’t one of defeat ...  Why is that ... ?
...I’m amazed. It seems you can still talk.

text.ACTION: Oh, yeah. To be honest, that was like eighty hours of game and fourteen real-life months ago, so I kinda forgot.

text.Sae Niijima: Those words normally hint at the existence of a traitor ...  However, if your story till now is true ...  one reason can be concluded. It’s frustrating to admit, but at a certain point—no, most likely from the start—I was a mere puppet ...  ...Someone set up only to bear responsibility later. Someone "intended" your arrest, and the minimal staff directly involved were in their pocket. And if that’s the case, true integrity would side with you ...

text.Joker: Sae is slowly starting to accept the truth ...  I feel like my bond with Sae is growing deeper ...

text.Sae Niijima: No, I’m jumping to conclusions. I don’t believe your story yet. There’s something I need to confirm with you ...

text.ACTION:
Part 140: 10/28-10/29: Straight As An Arrow
	Part 132: 10/28-10/29: Straight As An Arrow

text.Morgana: We’ll be going to Niijima’s Palace, so I want to look into her. Things like her work ethic and relationships. It doesn’t matter whether it’s public or private.

text.ACTION: It’s kind of fucked up that we’ve basically just identified a likelihood that Sae is going to do some bad shit, Minority Report-style, and we’re already actively working to undermine her privacy. For some reason this bothers me more than the fact that we plan to brainwash her. She hasn’t actually done anything wrong yet besides be a total shit to Makoto, is what I’m saying.

text.Morgana: Those would help us come up with countermeasures in case we hit a roadblock in her Palace.

text.ACTION: I mean, I guess that’s a decent excuse, though Makoto would probably know a lot of what we’d need anyway.

text.Futaba Sakura: I can look up more, you know. Stuff like her repertoire of underwear.

text.Morgana: You tell her too!

text.Futaba Sakura: I thought you’d like that ...

text.ACTION: I’m not a sex pest, Futaba. This game’s weird enough about that stuff already.

text.Morgana: Ahem! Also, I may be overthinking it, but my voice--

text.Futaba Sakura: Same as always.

text.Morgana: Let me finish first! (sigh) ...There’s something else we want you to look into.

text.Joker: My memory is a haze...

text.Anon: id bet money on the arrest

text.Train Monitor: First off, the investigation team has announced new progress in the search for the Phantom Thieves. Secondly, the opposition party has submitted a vote of no confidence regarding the current Cabinet. That along with Legislator Shido’s plan for a new party has sparked fears of governmental disbandment.

text.ACTION: Oh my god THE GOVERNMENT HAS DISBANDED

text.Haru Okumura: Oh right, we were never told where to meet up.

text.Makoto Niijima: At the courthouse.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Where’s that?

text.Futaba Sakura: Hint: The government office district.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Kasumigaseki...

text.Makoto Niijima: Indeed.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Oh, I’ve heard of that place. Never been there though.

text.Ann Takamaki: Me neither.

text.Haru Okumura: It’s not somewhere normal people usually go.

text.ACTION: You know, all those weirdos in civil service.

text.Futaba Sakura: Whoa. Just looking at the map is impressive. The Police department, Ministry of Justice, Public Prosecutors Office, AND Public Security. The Diet Building is right near there too.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: For real!? What kinda scary place are we going to!?

text.Ann Takamaki: We won’t get caught, right ... ?

text.Makoto Niijima: According to Akechi-kun, our identities haven’t been discovered yet.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: So we are jut going to plunge head-first into enemy territory ...  Has anyone contacted Akechi?

text.ACTION: Akechi already had his Persona, so no fancy awakening for him, sadly. Akechi is pretty damn useful, though.
Akechi uses fucking lightsabers as melee weapons...
...and for a gun, he has a laser pistol with six shots.

He’s the only party member with access to the neutral Almighty element (Megidola is Heavy Almighty to all foes), can use Megaton Raid for Severe Physical damage to one foe, and can use a variety of Bless and Curse skills. He starts with Kouga and Eiga, single-target Medium Bless and Curse, as well as Hamaon and Mudoon, which are medium chances to instant-kill any non-boss with Bless or Curse.

He starts with seven of his eight skill slots taken, with the one we can’t see right now being reserved for Fortify Spirit, a passive skill that reduces the chance of suffering a status ailment. He also learns all kinds of other shit. Almost too much, I’d say. He can revive people. He learns an automatic Tarukaja spell. In the endgame he gets Debilitate, which lowers all three stat parameters for a single foe (which can lead to some stupid damage numbers if you set it up correctly).

He’s pretty versatile, is what I’m saying. He is weak to Curse, but his ability to use Curse anyway is great. His only real downside is that he’s something of an SP hog due to his starting lack of multi-target skills outside of Megidola, which can’t hit any weaknesses. If we want to knock anyone down with him, we’re gonna have to do it one at a time.

Speaking of which, we actually can’t knock this guy down with Akechi. He resists everything except Curse, which he blocks, and Bless, which he’s neutral to. It’s kind of annoying because we can’t see his cut-in or his finisher in this fight, but the fight’s also really easy, to the point where I won’t bother uploading a video.

text.ACTION: Well, we're ready to start our Palace infiltration whenever we choose. But before we go:

This is Akechi’s Persona, Robin Hood. You fucking know who Robin Hood is. Merry Men, Sherwood Forest, Maid Marian, robbing the rich and giving to the poor, apparently fought in the Crusades which I didn’t know but is pretty fucked up, etc.

For real though, Robin Hood was a legendary outlaw of English folklore, a skilled archer and swordsman, who fought against the Sheriff of Nottingham, who took his lands for Prince John, who usurped the throne from the rightful King Richard. Sometimes he fought in the Crusades, sometimes he was just born a noble, it’s not terribly consistent and there’s tons of theories about its actual veracity, including one that posits he was a stock alias of English outlaws in general. Modern legends have updated some of this, too, but the legends are generally always that he fights injustice (like giving to the poor and stealing from the rich, of course) and remains loyal to the rightful king like the filthy monarchist that he is.

Also the game wants to keep Akechi being a party member “secret” despite the fact that he’s on the fucking boxart, so there’s no official Soejima portrait of Robin Hood like the other party member Personas. Instead, we have to use this concept art. Looking at it makes me realize that holy shit, Robin Hood is just All Might.

text.ACTION: So, we’re going to regret Futaba’s decision to make us come alone here pretty much immediately. Virtually every advantage we have in combat evaporates fighting solo: we have less time to capitalize on the power of buffs, debuffs, and status ailments, have to use our only turn to heal in between attacks, and we just generally have fewer opportunities.

There’s also the fact that this boss is kind of hilariously overtuned. All this adds up to make this fight legitimately one of the most annoying fights in the entire game. The one thing we have going for us is that unlike Girimehkala, the Persona it shares a model form with, it doesn’t have any resistances—so no repelling Physical and Gun. That’s it.
Though given how this thing is capable of depleting 1/3 of Maaku’s health on a bad day in one attack, we’re not really going to be using attacks that are cast from HP.
Once or twice I managed to get a lucky Burn or Shock ailment off an Agilao or a Zionga.

Unfortunately, I was unable to capitalize on this because it fucking knows Fast Heal, that skill Haru started with that heals status ailments in half the regular number of turns. That’s not even the biggest fuck you, though:
See, I decided to switch to a Persona that’s immune to Physical to see if maybe I could cheese the fight, or at least get some relief.
Nope! If you do that, it switches to spamming Almighty attacks at you!

(I also in the process of writing this update went back and discovered that he doesn’t switch to Megidola if your equipped Persona is only resistant to Physical instead of immune. I had two Personas that fit this criteria, but unfortunately they’re both relatively weak and had bad skill lineups so I didn’t use them. Whoops!)
(edit- Apparently you can use Physical-immune Personas, just not ones that reflect it. Aw geez, one more mistake immortalized in the LP!)

Anyway, I eventually managed to win by just spamming attacks, only healing with Beads (full health restores) when I was about to die. It sucked and I wasted some items I’d rather have kept. This is your fault, Futaba! Curse you for not being emotionally ready to tell your friends about the horrific abuse and neglect you suffered at the hands of a relative!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You didn’t hafta add that last part!

text.ACTION: Before we even get into a target area, Morgana levels up and learns Wind Boost to replace the useless Wind Break. His Wind attacks will now be 25% stronger.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Somethin’ about this guy tells me he’s nuts. I guess I shouldn’t be surprised.

text.Makoto Niijima: He’s threatening Iwai ...  He’s doing this because he’s getting desperate, right?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: He seriously intends to kill someone. We’d better change his heart immediately.

text.Ann Takamaki: It’s scary, but we gotta do it!

text.ShadowTsuda: Who said you could come in here? This is my territory! I’m the Hashiba Clan’s second-in-command! Don’t come in without my say-so! Don’t talk, don’t breathe, not without my permission. You guys aren’t yakuza, so you obey me! You hear me? Those are the rules of this world!
Did I give you permission to say no? Dammit, you’re not taking me seriously, either. No one takes me seriously! You, the Hong Kong mafia, Iwai, even the guys in the Hashiba Clan!

text.ACTION: Having fun listening to this grown-ass yakuza dude squeal like a little kid about how annoyed he is that he’s not being taken seriously.

text.ShadowTsuda: Well, forget that! I’m not a joke! I’ll show you alllll!

text.ACTION: (We take him down in three moves, he gets off a Bufudyne or whatever. He can use Evil Smile to inflict Fear and then Ghastly Wail to instant-kill anyone with the ailment, but he obviously never gets the chance to do any of that)
We trade Mind Slice for Heat Wave (Heavy Physical to all foes).

text.ShadowTsuda: Once they find out I’ve been letting them down, I’ll be demoted from second-in-command ...  I’m just a relic from an old era. The young, college graduates in the Hashiba Clan laugh behind my back. Hehehe ...  Even the world of the yakuza’s been taken over by the intellectuals. That’s why I had to make this transaction work, no matter what. Even if it meant taking advantage of my subordinate ...  Mune ...  The Hong Kong mafia pulled the carpet under me. It’s what I get for breaking the yakuza code.
Yeah ...  I’m done with being pathetic. Sorry, Mune ...  I wish I could have a drink with you one more time.

text.Joker: Tsuda seems to have had a change of heart. I’ll go check with Iwai later...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: He looks super shady.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Well, he’s selling useless rocks and those brainwashing seminars to his followers, right?

text.Ann Takamaki: If we let him go on like this, so many more people will end up unhappy!

text.Makoto Niijima: Let’s go and strip this wolf of his sheep’s clothing.

text.Shadow Yuichi Fukurai: Give me your money or you’ll suffer grave misfortune! You could even die!

Oh, are you that maiden’s apprentice? You’re so very naive. People really believe this holy stone will save them if the maiden predicts bad fortune! Even if it doesn’t actually work, what does it matter if it makes them happy? People want to be deceived! Don’t you see? They’re all desperate to feel safe!
Shut up, shut up! Don’t you get in the way of me giving sublime salvation to the masses!

text.ACTION: So, this guy uses a lot of Psy and Curse moves, including the instant-kill Mudoon, which is very annoying. Thankfully, Ryuji has both Endure and Protect, meaning that he can survive one instant-kill and take one for Maaku if need be. He’ll also use Brainwash on people, but everyone in the party has Harisen Recovery so status ailments are not the debilitating factor they once were.
Here’s Akechi’s cut-in, by the way.

text.Shadow Yuichi Fukurai: I was going to join a vocational school when I first came to Tokyo, but I ended up getting scammed ...  I spent all that money on what I thought was tuition. I was all alone, hopeless in the city ...  The police just laughed. "Those ads are obvious scams. You were dumb enough to fall for them?" That’s why I vowed to not let myself get tricked like that again. I won’t be a victim anymore. If it ever happened again, I’d be the one doing the deceiving!

I ...  I never really thought about it much. I guess when it comes right down to it, I really am just a dumb guy ...  Hahaha ...  haha ...  The maiden’s powers are real. That’s why I brought her on. I’m the only one guilty of lying. And I took advantage of the two of us happening to meet again.
I’ve been wanting to apologize to her for a while ...  I’m so sorry, Chi-chan...

text.ACTION: The Prophet’s Hand is a weapon for Makoto with only 10 Attack, but a high chance to cause Brainwash. Speaking of Brainwash, I’ve heard people say it’s a good idea to Brainwash enemies to make negotiation easier, but every time I’ve tried this they haven’t joined me. Weird.

text.Joker: I wonder if Chi-chan is supposed to be Chihaya...

text.ACTION: OH GEE, YA THINK? NEVER OCCURRED TO ME

text.Joker: Either way, Yuichi Fukurai seems to be a changed man. I should report back to Chihaya...

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: He looks so suspicious.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: Well, he is obstructing a news investigation to keep some incident hidden under the rug.

text.Makoto Niijima: People died in that incident. He should be ashamed to call himself a journalist.

text.Ann Takamaki: We’ll have to make him see the truth!

text.Shadow Honyo: Screw you guys. Snooping around together where you shouldn’t be ...  What’ll happen if this draws negative attention to me from the higher-ups!? Stop meddling around!
It’d be better for the organization if we didn’t have rebels like her around! You must not care about dying if you oppose me! Just obey those with power if you wanna live!

text.ACTION: He does not. This is actually kind of an interesting fight mechanically, though. See, he’ll start the fight by casting Megidola, which will deplete almost all of his SP. Then, he’ll use party-wide Physical moves (or just do nothing) until Invigorate 3 restores his SP so he can do it again. He also blocks or straight up absorbs a lot of elements, so he’s kind of tricky.

text.Shadow Honyo: I can’t oppose the higher-ups. It’s easier to not rock the boat. Mass media is just another corporation, really. Passion for journalism won’t pay the bills. It’s useless, just useless to chase after your ideals ...

...She’s really incredible. No matter what people say to her, she’ll never give up on finding the truth ...  I found her naive passion to be so annoying. It reminds me of all that pain I felt in the past. Back in the past, before I gave up. Before my passion rotted away and my wife cheated on me ...

text.ACTION: Just casually dropping the adultery thing at the end there with no context, okay sure.

text.Joker: Honjo’s Shadow disappeared. I should go see Ohya...

text.Makoto Niijima: It looks a little anxious.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I hear he’s been repeatedly changing his name and face with plastic surgery to escape debt.

text.Ann Takamaki: The police will never catch him, so it’s up to us.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Yeah. Let’s go!

text.ACTION: The heroic and noble Phantom Thieves act today on the behalf of creditors everywhere!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Hey, we’d never accept any help from a guy as bad as you.

text.Makoto Niijima: You better return all the money that you stole from others!

text.Akitsu: Shut up! Why should I? Banks are always taking money from people unfairly. I’m stealing back from the people who stole first. I’m doing what’s right! I’m carrying out justice!

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: I disagree. You’ve been running away, always hiding behind a new name and face.

text.Akitsu: Hmm? You guys hide your identities too. You know what? That makes you all hypocrites! I’m gonna take off those masks and see who you guys really are!

text.Morgana: Let’s do this!

text.ACTION: This dude will use more Curse, including instant-kill moves, which is something of a problem as Akechi is weak to Curse despite his ability to use those skills. He’ll also use Stomach Blow to inflict Hunger, multi-hit party-wide Physical attacks, and Life Leech to steal our HP. It’s weak to Electricity, though. I switch out Akechi for Yusuke in an attempt to capitalize on this for Baton Passes, but it dies before I am able to.

text.Akitsu: This whole time ...  I was a bad guy.

text.Ann Takamaki: So, you were saying the Phantom Thieves were hypocrites?

text.Akitsu: I was wrong to have said that. I’ve realized my own mistakes, thanks to all of you. I’m ashamed of myself. I’ve worked so hard to fool the world, living only for my own greed. I’ve changed my face and name many times, but for the first time ...  you’ve changed my heart.

text.ACTION: Thermopylae is a garbage skill that increases the entire party’s Attack, Defense, and Agility for three turns. How is that garbage, you ask? It certainly sounds amazing, but it’s only usable while you’re ambushed. Considering how infrequently you get ambushed in this game combined with the fact that most of the time at this point Futaba will just Position Hack us out of it, it’s an obscene waste of a skill slot. Why the hell would you need to be raising all three of the party’s parameters in a non-boss fight anyway!?

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: From now on, live your life with an open heart with nothing to hide.

text.ACTION: He can’t fuckin’ hear you, Yusuke. He already turned into a useless item.
This is the cheater, for the record.

text.Ann Takamaki: All right! We have a plan this time!

text.Shadow Nejima: No one can defeat me in the Gun About world! Hm? You guys again? I didn’t think you’d come back. You should’ve learned by now ...  Don’t think I’ll let you get away this time. Once the match starts ...  I’ll dash at you with an infinite combo loop! I’ll MURDER YOU before you can try to sabotage the match! I am the god of the Gun About world! I am invincible! No one can ever hope to defeat me! No matter how many come against me, no one can ever wound me!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: I’m countin’ on you! We’ll get ‘em this time!

text.ACTION: Shadow Nejima Revengeance (His voice is still really good, you should click on this)

text.Futaba Sakura: A gamer taught you the moves to take him down, right? Teach that stupid cheater a lesson!

text.ACTION: You actually don’t even have the choice of doing anything else here.

text.Shadow Nejima: A gunshot that surpasses my cheats!? That can’t be true! Dammit! I’m the strongest! I’m supposed to be king! Me ...
N-No ...  It’s not my fault! The company that laid me off ...  It’s all because of them! I have the skills and experience, but they want to "make the organization younger"!? D-Dammit! Dammit!

text.ACTION: That’s rough, buddy. Still, don’t… cheat at video games? I guess?

text.Morgana: Don’t do this again! You better make amends for the wrong you’ve done!

text.ACTION: Yeah! ...What!? What’s he gonna do, sponsor a young, scrappy, underfunded esports team? Yeah, he better fuckin’ make this shit right with all the people he hurt. Forgive me father, for I have wallhacked.
An actually good skill, this time!
And now that we’re done with that waste of time, let’s move on.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: All right, we can’t be losin’ our nerve now! We’re goin’ in!

text.ACTION: Haru learns Makarakarn (block the next magic attack for one ally) to replace Psy Break.
We also get a chance to see Warning Shot in action here. Instead of negotiating properly, we can just hit Square...
And he’ll join automatically! I’m fairly certain there’s at least a chance this won’t work, but hey, it hasn’t let me down so far!
edit from the future: in the rare chance it doesn't work it will enrage the target and they'll act again. Still worth it to always do it, though.

Now, this next tradeoff is kind of a hard one. Some would suggest I get rid of Defense Master (automatic Rakukaja at the start of battle), but instead I’m getting rid of Flash Bomb (Medium Physical to all enemies with a chance of Dizzy). While it means she’s going to be dealing solely Nuke damage outside of her melee attacks due to her lack of a Physical skill after Flash Bomb, that skill was already pretty obsolete. Besides, now her Nuclear skills will do 25% more damage.

text.Ann Takamaki: I get chills just looking at him.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: He’s an ex-mercenary who is now a professional assassin. He’s no ordinary person.

text.Haru Okumura: If even the police can’t handle him, then it’s up to us to take care of him.

text.Morgana: Let’s approach him with caution.

text.Shadow Kiritani: Sorry, but I don’t plan on going away. You kids playin’ hero should go home to your mommies.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We can’t just let someone dangerous like you go around, killin’ people.

text.Shadow Kiritani: You guys are more dangerous from my point of view. Look ...  As a mercenary, I’ve seen a lot of torture. And torture is all about killin’ the heart and soul. You’ve been destroyin’ the parts you don’t like in people’s character. To me, that’s evil.

text.Ann Takamaki: Evil? Don’t be ridiculous! We’re doing our best to do what’s right!

text.Shadow Kiritani: It’s my policy to only kill on the job, but I’ll destroy you if you’re gonna get in my way!

text.ACTION: Oh no! We have to save our friend Homeless Man!
This guy doesn’t have a lot of tricks up his sleeve. He can increase his attack and critical hit rate, but that’s kinda it.

text.Shadow Kiritani: The people I kill are all criminals! They escape the law, and the police can’t touch ‘em. I’m just like you Phantom Thieves! I’m working to get rid of evil in this world! So let me go!

text.Morgana: Sorry, but we’re not the same. The Phantom Thieves would never murder people.

text.Shadow Kiritani: N-No ...  Help me! I don’t want to disappear!

text.Ann Takamaki: How can you say that after you murdered so many people!?

text.Futaba Sakura: You better accept that you lost already. Prepare yourself.

text.Shadow Kiritani: ... Fine. Do what you want. Remember though: Evil that oughta be erased will just keep poppin’ up after I’m gone.

text.Makoto Niijima: We’ll destroy evil in a way that’s different from yours. You can disappear without worry.

text.ACTION: We’re gonna want to hold onto this skill card for a very specific reason.

text.Yusuke Kitagawa: We can now expand the range of our exploration.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Then let’s get goin’!

text.ACTION: Adyeschach comes from the Hebrew word “Adishut,” meaning apathy.

text.Futaba Sakura: Wow ...  This place is a lot bigger than what I’d heard.

text.Morgana: I expect the Shadows here will be strong, too. Be careful!

text.ACTION: This is Legion. It’s weak to Bless and uses Physical moves, including ones that can inflict Despair.

text.Morgana: Even I don’t know that. The only thing I can say is ...  The sheer scale of this place ...  is astronomical.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Well, yeah, but c’mon. We all knew that already.

text.Ann Takamaki: Oh, Mona ...  You’re always trying to act cool in front of Noir.

text.Morgana: Th-That’s not true! I just wanted to make sure she knew!

text.ACTION: Now HARU is my target of affections

text.Haru Okumura: Hehehe.

text.Makoto Niijima: Why are there so many parents who try to control their children?

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: Don’t overthink it. Let’s worry more about helpin’ their daughter.

text.Ann Takamaki: We have to change their hearts if we want to save Futaba’s friend!

text.Futaba Sakura: L-Let’s go!

text.ACTION: It feels like 40% of the requests in this game involve gambling debts.

text.Shadow Mr Magario: Why are the two of us so unlucky!? It’s bad luck we’re poor all year round!

text.Shadow Mrs Magario: We can’t let Kana go to school. She needs to make money for us. Her sex appeal, her innocence as a young girl, whatever ...  She should sell it for us ...

text.ACTION: Can we pleeeeeeeeeease give these guys just a little baby mental shutdown? It won’t even hurt! Probably!

text.Futaba Sakura: You call yourselves parents!? Kana-chan’s suffering so much because of you!

text.Shadow Mrs Magario: ...It’s too bad. But she needs to make us money!

text.Shadow Mr Magario: Kana needs to make money. Otherwise, our family will be broken up!

text.Incubus: It’s not our fault! It’s all because we’ve got some bad luck!

text.Succubus: Kana should just suck it up. Eventually, we’ll hit the jackpot. Then all of us will be happy!

text.Futaba Sakura: ...I knew it. These two are rotten to the core! Joker, please save Kana-chan!

text.Succubus: Keep your nose out of other people’s business!

text.ACTION: These guys can be a bit tricky, but most of the difficulty for me came from trying to exploit the money grinding trick. Not because I need the money (and with the hit rates for Confuse it’s honestly more annoying than it’s worth at this point), just because there’s something specific I wanted to show off.
If you confuse Mrs. Magario, she’ll give a tidy sum, same as usual. But Mr. Magario will only ever give 1 yen. I have no idea why this is the case.

Anyway, these guys can put you to sleep, or just use extremely powerful Gun attacks to make you "sleep." The Mrs. can even use Spirit Leech to steal one hundred of our precious SP away! Outside of that, the dude uses Curse and the lady uses Fire. Simple enough.

text.Shadow Mr Magario: ...I know. I have to change my ways. I won’t make Kana do that kind of work anymore.

text.Shadow Mrs Magario: I’m sorry, Kana ...  We’ll reorganize our debt. We’ll be responsible for paying it back, not her. I’ll quit gambling. And I’ll start working. I’ll pay back all that debt, bit by bit ...

text.Futaba Sakura: You HAVE to! Don’t hurt Kana-chan ever again!

text.Shadow Mr Magario: I started gambling to make some cash. Before I knew it, I forced Kana to do those shameful things. To think, I used to be a father who only wanted his daughter to be able to eat nice things ...

text.Shadow Mrs Magario: You’re right, dear. Before anything else, let’s do our best to make Kana happy ...

text.ACTION: Remember how I said Sunset Bridge almost made me cry last time? I hate it forever now after all these dumb confession scenes.
Growth 3 gives the Persona who has it the ability to gain full experience even when not being used in battle.

text.Futaba Sakura: Thank you, Joker. I think Kana’s going to be all right now.

text.Joker: The Magario couple seems to have had a change of heart. I should go check on Kana’s situation...

text.ACTION: Here’s Akechi’s finisher screen, for the record. Now, this doesn’t tell the whole story, because the lead-in animation is really something to behold:
Witness the dance of my people. What a goddamn dorkus malorkus.

text.Futaba Sakura: We’re halfway there, guys. Let’s plow the rest of the way through!

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: You’re pretty good at navigatin’. Sure is nice to have reliable info!

text.Morgana: Why are you looking at me!?

text.ACTION: Here, Robin Hood learns Kougaon, a Heavy Bless skill.

text.Futaba Sakura: You’re getting close to the end ...  No doubt about it.

text.Makoto Niijima: We’ve got to keep going just a little longer.
She looks like she would bite us if we even tried to speak to her.

text.Ann Takamaki: I heard she’s the definition of a helicopter parent. She’s really selfish too.

text.Ryuji Sakamoto: We gotta do something about this! Kids really look up to their parents, you know?

text.ACTION: We have to stop her, you guys! She did a bad! ...No, I can’t elaborate!

text.Morgana: Let’s go, guys!

text.Shinya Oda: No one will help a single mother! Everyone just looks at me coldly! Everyone is my enemy! I have to fight them! I have to smash them before they can smash me!
